decisions.label: Service#Queue
decisions.evidence: 几次没有预约直接冲过去，结果就是等等等等
decisions.text:
原来78一个人，后来88，再后来就一路飙升直到现在的128，要是工资也这么长法就好了，虽然价格一路上扬，食材和味道倒是一路下滑，从当初觉得超有性价比到现在觉得一般般，其实也没多长时间....
锦延路是条很低调的路，饭店不多且都很小，但是生意都非常的好，每家店一半的客人都是日本人，走在路上前后也是私密马赛不停，停车方便，车位充足，以前不要钱，不过现在就要钱了囧....
几次没有预约直接冲过去，结果就是等等等等，生意那叫一个好，加座也坐过，在2楼过道处搬个塑料桌子感觉就像在居酒屋里吃起了排挡，有点错位了，隔壁包房台湾人日本人全家聚餐小孩奔来奔去吵闹程度完全不输本国熊孩子....
3.4年前刚吃到时候发现原来寿喜锅的锅底是要先用洋葱等爆炒热锅后，再加薄薄的一层酱油便可涮肉，涨姿势同时发现味道确实比一般的好
牛肉刺身，很赞的招牌菜，薄切大块，没有筋来的口感，略冰配上酱油瓦萨米，冰冰凉凉的嫩滑，还带有微甜，入口生津
啤酒牛肉，有很淡的啤酒味，也是很薄啦，大块也好吃
羊肉猪肉，这个就是配角了，可点可不点
其他蔬菜更是跑龙套了，因为到后面甜到屎实在吃不下，最后直接到白开水进去了
服务的话，真的有点看人，外国人台湾人笑脸相迎，自己人嘛：喝什么⊙﹏⊙b

pass1.label: Service#Queue
pass1.why: The review says it walked in without a reservation and 'waited and waited', which fits the Queue rule's 'people must wait' case, but the rule excludes waiting for food and the text does not say whether the wait was for a table or the meal; the rulebook gives no way to settle that, so all arms reached the same reading.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note: waiting with no specified object after walk-in without reservation counts as Queue when it is about getting a seat, and add a few such cases of 'no reservation, had to wait' labelled Queue to show the convention.

pass2.label: Service#Queue
pass2.why: The review says it walked in without booking and 'waited, waited' (等等等等), which does describe waiting for a table, so the agent's label fits the rule's '人多要等' and 等位 cues; the gold omits it, though 6 of 6 arms made the same call, suggesting the gold may be inconsistent with the rule's wording.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case where walk-in without booking followed by a waiting description is labelled Service#Queue, to settle the convention.

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The review never comments on how dishes look, yet the gold marks Appearance; the only visual cues are the beef sashimi being 'thin-sliced large pieces' and the cold, glossy presentation, which the rule's '摆盘/造型/色泽' wording could arguably cover, so the gold is debatable and all arms missed it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule clarifying that cut shape and presentation of sashimi count as Appearance only when the reviewer explicitly praises the look.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The review never mentions how dishes look; the only visual cue is the 'bland' kitchen description, so the gold label appears unsupported by the item's own words and the rule's cues (卖相, 摆盘, 颜值) are absent, yet all six arms also missed it, pointing to the gold rather than the model.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous or check the gold label against the item text; the rule already excludes unmentioned appearance so no rule edit needed.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The reviewer says the meat side dishes are optional and vegetables are 'just extras' and that they got too sweet to eat, which is not a quantity judgement, so the Portion rule's 'does not apply when only dishes are listed' exclusion fits; the gold appears to rest on 'can order or not' reading as portion, which the rules do not support and is inconsistent with the rule's exclusion.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; clarify in the Portion rule that 'optional / can skip' about a dish is not a portion judgement unless quantity is mentioned, and review the gold for this item.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review only lists the dishes and says lamb and pork are side dishes that can be ordered or skipped, and the rule explicitly excludes listing dishes without evaluating quantity, so the gold label is debatable; the reviewer's 'vegetables are extras' and 'too sweet, could not eat more' comments are also not quantity judgments.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a clarifying example that 'can order or not' and 'could not finish because too sweet' are not portion judgments unless quantity is stated.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 冷菜点了...很精致味道也不错
decisions.text: 原来只知道南长街的一缕炊烟文艺主题餐厅，谁知还有一家湖滨路店，就在中建溪岸观邸别墅售楼处旁，旁边就是仙蠡墩公园，这家店环境很幽静，装修很雅致，确实具有浓浓的文艺范儿，一楼是散座，二楼则是包厢不过。不过上菜的顺序有点乱，服务员解释做冷菜的只有一位师傅，请我们谅解。冷菜点了酸爽黄瓜、我家凤爪、炊烟佛手、椒麻口水鸡、关东酱牛肉、酸辣藕苗、枣香糯米藕，很精致味道也不错。手打鱼目酿油条很抢手，一眨眼就光盘了，油条酥脆，鱼肉鲜美。秘制乳牛排很嫩，奇幻椒盐猪手很香，秧草臭鲑鱼很配我们的口味，富贵金钱蛋其实是普通的鸡蛋一切二烧的，味道超好，蟹粉青稞豆腐也很好吃，芥兰鲜贝很清爽，芥兰比较嫩，茶香虾味道还可以，虾挺新鲜的。外婆红烧肉感觉一般，肉质太老，炊烟大鱼头感觉鱼头有点土腥气。总体用餐感觉还是不错的，环境不错、味道不错，但菜的量不是很多，可能跟文艺餐厅这个定位有关。吃完下来走到一楼看到还有吉他手在弹唱，真不错，确实是亲朋好友聚餐的好地方。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The rule lists 精致 as a trigger, but here 精致 describes the cold dishes in general and is tied to taste ('很精致味道也不错'), not to visual presentation, and the reviewer never comments on how the dishes look.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt note: 精致 counts for Food#Appearance only when it is about looks or plating; when it is paired with taste or quality, label Food#Taste only.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The phrase 精致 appears in the rule as an appearance cue, but here it modifies the cold dishes overall and sits alongside 味道也不错, so the review is praising the dish quality as a whole rather than how the food looks; the gold omits appearance, and the agent's reading is defensible but not what the gold labelled.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note: 精致 counts as appearance only when it refers to plating or look; when it is a general quality praise paired with taste words, label only Food#Taste, and add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Service#Hospitality
decisions.evidence: 服务员解释做冷菜的只有一位师傅，请我们谅解

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The waiter's explanation about the single cold-dish chef is about the kitchen's capacity and the ordering delay, and it is not a judgment of the staff's attitude, though the 请我们谅解 apology is a courteous gesture that many labellers would read as hospitality.
pass1.fix: Document as ambiguous, or add a rule example that an apology or explanation about kitchen delay is Service#Timely or none, not Service#Hospitality, unless the review praises or criticises the staff's manner.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The complaint is that the cold-dish chef was the only one, a kitchen-staffing explanation; the waiter explains and asks for understanding, which is a service-staff interaction, but the review judges the kitchen capacity and order sequencing (Service#Timely territory), and the rule's boundary with Service#Timely does not say how to handle an explanation about pacing.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the Service#Hospitality boundary that apologies or explanations about kitchen delays are labelled Service#Timely only unless the staff's attitude itself is praised or criticised; add this example to the boundary section.

decisions.label: Ambience#Space
decisions.evidence: 座位也非常多
decisions.text: 去之前搜了下线路，估计也要走一小段路，就选择打车了。悦河咖啡厅自助餐就在一楼敞开式的，旁边有竹林的很漂亮，座位也非常多，我昨晚到时大概七点多，客人不多。水果种类挺多的，小蛋糕也有好多种呢，服务员非常热情，能够及时地拿走吃完剩的空盘。由于人不多，我就烤了秋刀鱼要了两份羊排，师傅速度也挺快的，很想吃龙虾的，由于迟了没有了很遗憾呀。由于八点半就收东西了，服务员也会细心地喊客人可以弄点放到桌上慢慢吃，整体感觉很好。

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists "位子多" as applying to Ambience#Space, and "座位也非常多" is a direct paraphrase, so all six arms reading the rule reached the same label and the gold omission looks like an incomplete label rather than an agent error.
pass1.fix: Check the gold label for this item and add Ambience#Space; if the gold is intentionally left out, add a rule note that a bare remark on seat count is not labelled when it sits inside a list of other aspects.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The rule explicitly lists 位子多 as an Ambience#Space trigger, so "座位也非常多" plausibly fits; the agent applied the rule correctly, and the gold omitting it looks like an inconsistency with the dataset's own convention, since 6 of 12 arms made the same call.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add the example "座位也非常多" to the Ambience#Space positive examples so the gold convention is explicit.

decisions.label: Service#Queue
decisions.rejected_reason: 排队只是对饭点的假设，本次去得早没有排队
decisions.text: 去了厦门，自然少不了要品尝下美食，这天刚好在火车站附近，搜到了比较热门的咏蛙田鸡，去吃的时间比较早，自然人也少，一般到饭点肯定需要排队的。问了服务员现在已经没有2人套餐了，估计当时是打知名度吧，点了一份干锅田鸡，因为在宁波，这样的做法比较少见，所以打算尝试下。水果跟小食可以自助吃，个人觉得爆米花味道比较好，是现做的。等了大概10分钟左右 菜上来了，没怎么看到田鸡，上面满满的铺了土豆片，藕片，撩了下，才在下面看到田鸡，味道倒还可以，微辣能接受，只是干锅太干了，一边狂饮水，一边吃，吃到最后都没吃完，性价比也就一般吧

pass1.label: Service#Queue
pass1.why: The agent never read the Service#Queue rule, whose Applies-when list explicitly includes 去得早没排队, so it judged queueing only from the reviewer's 'at peak hours you'd need to queue' assumption and missed that the early visit with no queue is itself covered.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step requiring the agent to check every label's Applies-when list against the whole review, including negated or hypothetical mentions such as 不用排队 and 去得早没排队, before finalising.

pass2.label: Service#Queue
pass2.why: The agent never read the Queue rule, which explicitly lists "去得早没排队" as an applies case, so it dismissed the label by assuming queuing only happens at peak times.
pass2.fix: Add a flow step requiring the agent to read every rule for each candidate label before deciding, including the Applies-when lists, and to check explicitly for 'went early, no queue' phrasing.

decisions.label: Service#Timely
decisions.rejected_reason: “等了大概10分钟”只陈述时间，没有对上菜快慢做评价
decisions.text: 去了厦门，自然少不了要品尝下美食，这天刚好在火车站附近，搜到了比较热门的咏蛙田鸡，去吃的时间比较早，自然人也少，一般到饭点肯定需要排队的。问了服务员现在已经没有2人套餐了，估计当时是打知名度吧，点了一份干锅田鸡，因为在宁波，这样的做法比较少见，所以打算尝试下。水果跟小食可以自助吃，个人觉得爆米花味道比较好，是现做的。等了大概10分钟左右 菜上来了，没怎么看到田鸡，上面满满的铺了土豆片，藕片，撩了下，才在下面看到田鸡，味道倒还可以，微辣能接受，只是干锅太干了，一边狂饮水，一边吃，吃到最后都没吃完，性价比也就一般吧

pass1.label: Service#Timely
pass1.why: The review states a bare wait of about 10 minutes before the dishes arrived with no evaluation; the rule covers 菜等了很久 and 上菜快或慢 but is silent on a neutral duration statement, so the gold neutral label is defensible yet not clearly required.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit and cases: a stated dish wait time with no evaluative word counts as neutral Service#Timely, or document this case as ambiguous and do not force a label.

pass2.label: Service#Timely
pass2.why: The review gives a neutral duration for waiting on food ("等了大概10分钟") without evaluating speed, so careful labellers could reasonably disagree; the gold is defensible under the rule's "等的是菜" boundary but the rule does not say whether a bare duration counts.
pass2.fix: Document as ambiguous, or add a rule example that a stated wait for food with no evaluation is labelled neutral under Service#Timely.

decisions.label: Ambience#Noise
decisions.rejected_reason: 未评价嘈杂；“环境很正宗日式”只具体说了风格，不是笼统评价环境，不标噪音
decisions.text: 去年寒假和我妈一起去吃的...我真的是好拖延症到现在才写评论...很赞的店！店门有一种禅的感觉，环境很正宗日式，真是高大上，坐在炉端边吃边看着厨师小哥们烧烤很有意思~喜欢金吉鱼，很难想象这么大的火可以烤出这么细腻的口感，外皮酥酥鱼肉细腻鲜甜肥美，还配了很特别的柚子盐，实际上我却喜欢什么都不沾着吃，我想这种烤法应该别的鱼也会好吃吧~当时还有冬季的年糕锅，汤汁浓郁，年糕是日式的很糯米，我还挺喜欢的~还有烤肉也很好吃~就是不大喜欢味增饭团，其实吃挺有米香味儿的，平时也爱喝味增汤，但是这个还是不喜欢，吃饭还是要配肉啊！~反正以后来上海的话一定会来吃的~

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The agent never read the Ambience boundary rule, so it skipped the convention that general praise of 环境 tags all four environment labels, even though all six arms made the same miss.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt step: whenever a review evaluates 环境 (any positive or negative environment judgement), open the Ambience boundary section and check whether it is general before deciding on Decoration, Noise, Space and Sanitary.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: The agent never read the Noise rule, so it skipped the boundary section that tags all four ambience labels when 环境 is judged in general, and the same miss occurred in all six arms.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt step: whenever a review evaluates 环境 or 环境 plus an adjective, read the Ambience boundary section and check all four ambience rules before deciding.

decisions.label: Ambience#Sanitary
decisions.rejected_reason: 未评价卫生；“环境”指的是风格，不是卫生
decisions.text: 去年寒假和我妈一起去吃的...我真的是好拖延症到现在才写评论...很赞的店！店门有一种禅的感觉，环境很正宗日式，真是高大上，坐在炉端边吃边看着厨师小哥们烧烤很有意思~喜欢金吉鱼，很难想象这么大的火可以烤出这么细腻的口感，外皮酥酥鱼肉细腻鲜甜肥美，还配了很特别的柚子盐，实际上我却喜欢什么都不沾着吃，我想这种烤法应该别的鱼也会好吃吧~当时还有冬季的年糕锅，汤汁浓郁，年糕是日式的很糯米，我还挺喜欢的~还有烤肉也很好吃~就是不大喜欢味增饭团，其实吃挺有米香味儿的，平时也爱喝味增汤，但是这个还是不喜欢，吃饭还是要配肉啊！~反正以后来上海的话一定会来吃的~

pass1.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass1.why: The agent did not read the Ambience boundary rule and so did not apply the general-environment convention that tags Sanitary alongside the other environment labels.
pass1.fix: Same flow fix: require the agent to consult the Ambience boundary rule for every 环境 evaluation before finalising the four environment labels.

pass2.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass2.why: The Sanitary rule was never read, so the agent did not apply the general-環境 convention that tags 卫生 alongside the other ambience labels.
pass2.fix: Same flow fix: trigger reading of every ambience rule and its boundary note whenever 环境 appears in the review text.

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The agent read the rule but judged 环境很正宗日式，真是高大上 as a style-specific comment, while the gold follows the convention that a general 高大上-type environment verdict counts as general; the rule does not say whether praise of style alone counts as specific.
pass1.fix: Clarify the boundary text: an evaluation that names only a style or theme (正宗日式, 高大上, 有格调) without naming a specific dimension counts as general and tags all four environment labels; add 3-5 such cases to the library.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The boundary rule tags all four ambience labels for a general 环境 judgment, but "环境很正宗日式" is a qualified statement about style, so the test for general versus specific is unclear and 5 of 6 arms made the same call.
pass2.fix: Edit the boundary note to say that 环境 plus an evaluative word with no named sub-aspect (including a style qualifier like 正宗日式 or 高大上) counts as general and tags all four, and add a few cases of this wording.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 菜品质量还不错，也算物有所值
decisions.text:
去广州之前就听人说过广州酒家有名循着地图顶着大太阳走了很远才找到这里，一进门就吓一跳，熙熙攘攘门口全是人，以为要排队很久呢。仔细一问才知道，原来都是买月饼的，这才松了一口气。按照服务员指的路坐电梯上三楼吃炒菜，据说二楼专坐喝茶的。
茶位费每人八块，还是最便宜的茶叶，是在广东几天以来最贵的一次。不过菜品质量还不错，也算物有所值。
点了烧鹅，皮脆肉嫩，就是有点肥，本来打算多吃几块，最后还是作罢了。
一个什么烧鱼嘴，名字忘了，就是把鱼下巴裹上面炸炸，然后酱焖，味道还行，就是不够咸，入乡随俗吧，广东菜就是这么清淡。
咸鱼茄子煲，好吃，咸鱼小爪粒，很下饭。
最后发现能用点评买单立减，没想到这么老牌的饭店还这么现金，不错。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review says the dish quality is decent and that it is 'also worth the price' (物有所值), which fits the rule's 物超所值 cue, so the agent's label is defensible; the gold omits it, which suggests the gold is inconsistent with the rule's listed cues rather than the agent misreading.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that 物有所值 is a cost-effectiveness cue so gold annotators label it consistently.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says 菜品质量还不错，也算物有所值, which literally matches the rule's 物超所值-style value wording, yet the gold omits it, so the gold appears to treat this lukewarm remark as not a real value-for-money judgment.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that tepid 物有所值 phrasing with no explicit price-quality comparison in the gold is not labelled.

decisions.evidence: 最后发现能用点评买单立减，没想到这么老牌的饭店还这么现金，不错

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The reviewer praises a point-review checkout reduction (买单立减), which the rule would count as a discount, but the gold does not label it, so the gold seems to exclude payment-app reductions not described as a restaurant promotion.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; alternatively clarify in the rule whether 点评买单立减 counts as 折扣力度 and add cases either way.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review never judges the amount of food; the only food-quantity remark is about the fat content and not wanting to eat more, which the agent reasonably rejected, so the gold seems to rest on a loose reading of 'wanted to eat more'.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The rule for 分量 was not read, so the agent rejected the case on its own reasoning, yet the gold reflects a judgment about the meal's size-related value that the agent did not connect to the portion rule.

decisions.rejected_reason: “按照服务员指的路”只是陈述指路，没有对服务员态度的评价

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The reviewer only reports following the waiter's directions and gives no judgement of the staff's attitude, which matches the rule's requirement for an evaluation, so the gold label looks inconsistent with the rule.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case where neutral pointing directions by staff is not labelled as hospitality unless the attitude is judged.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The rule for 服务态度 was never read, and the agent judged that merely recounting the waiter's directions was not an evaluation, while the gold treats the helpful guidance from staff as hospitality.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: force a read of every label's rule before deciding, and add a rule example that helpful staff guidance (指路, 引导) counts as 待客 service attitude.

decisions.label: Service#Queue
decisions.rejected_reason: 排队担心来自门口买月饼的人群，不是等餐厅的位子；点评人没有对餐厅的等位做评价

pass1.label: Service#Queue
pass1.why: The waiting remark concerns the crowd of mooncake buyers at the entrance rather than waiting for a table at the restaurant, so the agent's rejection follows the rule, and the 排队 cue is misleading here because the phrase appears in many cases with a different meaning.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add contrast cases where 排队 refers to a shop-front crowd or a separate queue so the cue is not over-applied.

pass2.label: Service#Queue
pass2.why: The queue remark concerns crowds at the bakery entrance buying mooncakes rather than waiting for a table, which the rule excludes, but the gold labels it anyway and the 排队 keyword is strongly tied to this label in the case library.
pass2.fix: Rule edit: add a boundary note that crowds queuing for takeaway or other shop sections do not count as 排队等位, or add cases to show this, so the gold and the rule agree.

decisions.label: Location#Transportation
decisions.rejected_reason: The bus stop is given only as a landmark for finding the shop, with no judgement on how convenient transit is.
decisions.text: 一直听喜欢吃锅贴的，所以之前在某个帖子里看到推荐发现又离家不远，果断来拔草啦~不过这个位置么，虽然不妖，但是真的很容易就会错过，就在李惠利中学的斜对面，18路公交车站旁边，那天一大早去买的，虽然是周末的大清早，还是有2个人在排队，因为锅贴是现包现煎的，所以等了一会。不过事实证明还是挺值的一吃的，原来对于王中王的锅贴就已经很满足了，这家比王中王好吃多了，皮子不厚，但是煎的底刚刚好，而且里面汁水也不腻，总之很好吃呀，就是稍微有点小贵，另外店里的品种有点单一，记得好像除了锅贴就是蛋皮汤？而且营业时间好像是早上到中午的，所以特地想去尝尝味道的吃客们记得看好时间哦。

pass1.label: Location#Transportation
pass1.why: The bus stop is mentioned only as a landmark to find the shop, which the rule's '离某站几分钟' pattern could cover, but the rule's boundary sends 'how to get there' to Easy_to_find, so the gold's Transportation label is debatable and the model's reading (landmark only, no transit judgement) is defensible.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note: a transit stop named as a route landmark ('X路公交车站旁边') counts as Transportation only when accessibility is judged; otherwise treat it as Easy_to_find, and add a few such landmark-only cases to the library with explicit labels.

pass2.label: Location#Transportation
pass2.why: The review names a bus stop (18路公交车站) as a landmark for finding the shop, which is the Easy_to_find boundary case, yet the rule explicitly lists 公交 as an applies-when cue and the training set labels 公交车站 as Transportation in all 9 cases, so the gold is consistent with the dataset while the agent's reading of landmark-only mentions was defensible.
pass2.fix: Add a boundary note to Location#Transportation: a bus stop named as a landmark still counts as Transportation when it is the way to reach the shop, and document this case as borderline in the rulebook.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: 只评价了门口装修，没有评价菜品的卖相或摆盘，属于装修
decisions.text:
吃牛排的地方，点了牛排以后其他菜品就是自助，听着还挺有噱头的，门口的装修也很有特色，一个满是涂鸦的火车车厢，每次排队人都不少，我们领了个号被告知还有40分钟，于是去了酷圣石耗点儿，还好20多分钟时候过来看了看，差点儿过号。
三个人，每个人都点了最便宜的99菲力牛排，一分黑胡椒的，两份蘑菇的，七成熟。牛排烤地还不错，很嫩很入味，好久没吃了，切了一块都觉得手酸了，两小块儿的量不多不少刚刚好，其他自助菜品基本吃不下什么了。
自助的品种不算太多，也基本够了，中式菜没怎么拿，鸡腿肉和西兰花好吃，披萨和比格的几乎一个水准，蛋挞很惊艳很好吃，大爱里面的红豆，冰虾没什么味道，个头儿也不大，冰激凌是雀巢的，只吃了巧克力和抹茶的，饮料一般，所谓的酸奶就是酸酸乳那类的饮料，有几种果汁可以喝喝，水果还都不错，火龙果西瓜哈密瓜都有，还有个巧克力喷泉，第一次体验，饮料对面有小蛋糕，吃不动了没尝试。  
服务员收完钱基本没影，想收盘子基本靠喊，我们的座位靠窗户，吃饭过程就一直听外面叫号。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The review never judges how the dishes look or are plated; the only appearance-like remark is about the restaurant's graffiti train-car decor, which the rule assigns to Ambience#Decoration, and all six arms missed it, so the gold label looks unsupported by the text.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or remove Food#Appearance from this gold item after checking whether the annotator meant the decor remark.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: No sentence in the review praises how the food looks; the only visual praise is for the decor, and "很惊艳" on the egg tart is about impression and taste, so the gold appearance label is debatable and all six arms missed it.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a boundary note that unspecified "惊艳"/"好看" praise of a dish counts as appearance only when the text names looks, plating or colour.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: “最便宜的99菲力牛排”只是菜品标价，没有价格高低的评价

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The rule lists 便宜 as a trigger word but also says a menu price with no high/low judgment does not count, and "最便宜的99菲力牛排" sits between those two clauses, so the agents reasonably read it as a plain menu price.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit saying that choosing a dish explicitly as the cheapest option ("最便宜的", "选了便宜的") counts as a price-level judgment, and add a few cases of this wording with gold labels.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The rule lists 便宜 as a keyword that applies (88%) but also says a menu price with no high/low judgement does not apply, and "最便宜的99菲力牛排" sits between the two, so the agent reasonably excluded it while the gold labels it.
pass2.fix: Rule edit: state that a superlative or comparative choice such as "最便宜的"/"最贵的" among menu items counts as neutral price level (gold polarity 0), and add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.rejected_reason: “服务小姐”只是转述满168元半价的优惠，没有对服务态度或待客的评价，不标

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality

pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a boundary note that merely relaying a staff member's words about a promotion does not count as Service#Hospitality unless the reviewer evaluates the staff's attitude.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a case showing that a bare staff mention relaying info without evaluation is not labelled Hospitality.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 西贝家的菜每一分端上来都是小悠悠的
decisions.text: 和想象中的西北菜差好多，作为一个北方人一直觉得南方菜才做的精致，北方菜应该粗狂，可是西贝家的菜每一分端上来都是小悠悠的。两个人也没点太多菜，烤羊腿味道很赞，价格也实惠，羊肉串也超级正宗，牛棒骨全是骨头肉很少，酱汁味很浓，拌饭吃应该很下饭，就是手拿骨头直接啃一点也不淑女。本来还点了一份汤，可是迟迟没上，一开始还在揣测桌上那个小沙漏要是流完了菜没上齐会怎样，和服务员讲明少个汤时就明白了。且不说菜的味道就服务的态度简直让人泪流满面，得知我们要退掉未上的汤，服务员很干脆就答应了还一直道歉，送了我们一人一罐酸奶，后来汤又端上来，我们也因为已经推掉而没喝。我相信有这样的服务这家店一定能够长盛不衰

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review says the dishes are "小悠悠的" in the context of contrasting delicate Southern-style presentation with rough Northern food, so it describes dainty style rather than quantity, and the quoted phrase does not support a portion judgment even though the Portion rule was read.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt note that describing presentation or style words such as 精致 or 小巧 is not portion unless the text evaluates how much food there is, and add a contrastive case where small-looking dishes are described as delicate rather than small in quantity.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The phrase '每一分端上来都是小悠悠的' is a metaphor about the dish arriving small-looking and delicate, which the reviewer frames as a style mismatch rather than a judgement of how much food there was; the rule's listed cues (分量, 量大, 量少) are absent, so the agent's reading is plausible but the gold omits it.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that figurative remarks about dish size without quantity words (e.g. 小小的, 精致) do not count as Food#Portion unless they judge the amount.

pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists 实惠 as a Cost_effective trigger and the text says "价格也实惠", so the agent's label follows the rulebook, yet the gold omits it, and all six arms made the same call, which suggests the gold is inconsistent with the dataset's own convention.
pass1.fix: Check the gold for this item and add Price#Cost_effective if the convention holds that 实惠 triggers the label; if the gold is kept, document in the rule that 实惠 alone without a value comparison does not count as Cost_effective.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: '价格也实惠' is an explicit cue listed for Price#Cost_effective (实惠 66%), yet six arms also rejected it, meaning the rule's 'does not apply' clause (no comparison of price against quality) is being read as overriding the lexical cue, so the rule is ambiguous about whether 实惠 alone suffices.
pass2.fix: Edit the rule to state that 实惠 or 划算 alone count as Cost_effective when they judge value for money, and clarify that a bare 价格也实惠 maps to Price#Cost_effective while Price#Level is only added when price height is also discussed.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.rejected_reason: The 推荐 here is the colleague's recommendation of 红米肠; the reviewer only confirms it was right. The rule says a bare 推荐 mention does not count, so drop it.
decisions.text: 一直想去的，没想到开到了五角场，就在单位附近，特方便。又看到大众有券团购，立马就团了。基本上点的都是他们家的招牌，咖喱鱼蛋同事们都说，虾饺，烧麦都是每次吃港式茶餐厅，必点的，吃下来果然没让我失望。那个红米肠是同事推荐的，里面包着脆脆的油条，外面的糯米很糯，果然没推荐错。正好还有皮蛋瘦肉粥和牛肉球特价，感觉性价比更高了！流沙包虽然很甜，但是的确好吃，没放糖的奶茶，感觉味道更浓了。总之，有了团购券，既让我到了美食，价格上又划算了很多，好！

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The reviewer clearly endorses the dishes overall ("没推荐错", "必点" context, "吃下来果然没让我失望"), yet the rule says 推荐 attributed to a colleague does not count and 必点 is usually unlabelled, so the gold's Food#Recommend is debatable and the agent's drop was defensible.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a boundary case showing that a reviewer's own confirmation that a colleague's recommended dish was right ("没推荐错") is or is not a Food#Recommend, so the rule is explicit.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The reviewer clearly endorses the dishes (咖喱鱼蛋 and others are their 招牌 choices, and 红米肠 was '没推荐错'), so the gold label's recommendation reading is defensible, while the rule's bare-推荐 exclusion and the 'no-recommendation-wording' convention make the agent's drop a reasonable call; the case sits on the boundary between the rule's examples and the gold.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that a reviewer explicitly validating a colleague's recommendation ('没推荐错', 'the dish was right') counts as an explicit endorsement.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 5块钱一个，很值
decisions.text: 和爸爸一起吃的，点了菌菇莜面鱼鱼、番茄莜面鱼鱼各一小份，感觉莜面鱼鱼还不错，蛮好吃的，无论什么味道，小小一碗不会腻，点了3个蒸饺。。。感觉还可以，但是6块多一个，有点小贵，虽然里面有虾肉，但是真的一点点啊，其余都是韭菜鸡蛋。。。但是有一点饺子的皮真的很软，吃起来很舒服，然后还点了2串羊肉串，羊肉串不错，至少是真的羊肉，而且5块钱一个，很值，最后还点了羊排，78块一份，4块排条，味道还不错，尚可，但是对于我这种经常吃羊肉早市的吃货来说，多说会有油腻的感觉，下次试试189一份的羊腿吧。。。总的来说，莜面很赞！

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review says 5块钱一个，很值 for the lamb skewers, which matches the rule's '值' trigger for Cost_effective, so the gold omitting it looks inconsistent with the rule's own examples and the dataset's convention that 值 phrases get 性价比 (the rule says '值不值' labels 性价比).
pass1.fix: Add a rule note clarifying that a single item praised as 很值 with a price figure counts as Cost_effective, and add several cases like this to the case library; if the gold stays as is, document as ambiguous.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says "5块钱一个，很值" which matches the rule's "值" cue and is a price-to-quality judgment about the lamb skewers, so the agent's label fits the rule; the gold omits it, though the rule's own cue list and 'worth it' wording make it a defensible reading that every arm also made.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that explicit '很值' judgments on a single item count as Cost_effective, and add cases to settle this convention.

pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous (or add a rule note that mentions of photographing a dish alone do not count as appearance, plus a few such cases to the library).

pass2.label: Food#Appearance

The review praises the sushi's 外表 (the crispy beef on the outside), which is a dish-appearance judgment the rule would have caught, and all six other arms made the same miss, which points to the flow rather than the model.
pass2.fix: Require the agent to open the rule text for every candidate aspect before it rejects one, and add 外表、外形、样子 to the Food#Appearance cue list with a positive-polarity example such as a review praising how a dish looks on the outside.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.rejected_reason: 上汤娃娃菜量不大只是提及，整体分量评价不明确
decisions.text: 四川饭店可是有名的老字号，位置很好，积水潭医院对面，新华百货星街坊旁边，交通便利，位置好找。装修传统，大灯笼都是菜名，有点江南的感觉。桌椅均为木质，质感强，有档次。中午人不算太多，大堂有不少空位。安排落座后开始准备点餐。点了海鲜锅巴，上汤娃娃菜，干煸豆角，糍粑和汤圆。特别喜欢锅巴，酸甜口味酱汁，锅巴脆脆的，吸汁入味，配着海鲜和竹笋特别好吃。上汤娃娃菜中规中矩，量不大，但清淡美味～干煸豆角很棒，不会很油腻，但是选料精良，够嫩，够入味，麻麻的口感很棒。糍粑特别可爱，圆圆的一个，配着黑糖汁，有嚼头，香甜可口。汤圆一碗四个，大小适中，黑芝麻馅料，一口下去，特别香，满嘴黑芝麻很满足。本次就餐很舒适，没有点辣的菜，吃的很舒服！

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review explicitly says 上汤娃娃菜 has a small quantity (量不大), which matches the rule's 量少 trigger, yet the agent treated it as a mere mention because the overall portion verdict was unclear and did not apply the rule's trigger words.
pass1.fix: Add to the Food#Portion rule that a dish-level statement such as 量不大/量少/量足 counts as a judgment even when only one dish is evaluated, and add cases of single-dish portion remarks labelled Food#Portion.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review explicitly says 上汤娃娃菜 量不大 but also 清淡美味, which is a portion judgment matching the Food#Portion rule's 量少 wording; the agent read the rule but rejected it as mere mention, so it misapplied an applicable rule rather than a rule conflict.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a case-library note that a stated 量不大/量少 about a specific dish counts as Food#Portion even when the overall portion verdict is not stated.

decisions.label: Ambience#Space
decisions.evidence: 二楼卡座三个人坐坐正好
decisions.text: 因为特意去看远方来的朋友，所以就定在他附近请他吃湘菜，一进去的时候店里没啥人，二楼卡座三个人坐坐正好，后来据说来了好几桌人，导致上菜速度严重变慢，我们点了四个菜等了好久，每个菜上来感觉都吃的差不多了下面那个菜还没上，这家店看来厨房的队伍不够强大，来店之前看大众有团购的，可是店员说已经不做大众了，最近这是怎么了，大众的产品好像好几个都这样，菜的味道还可以，最先上来的酸菜鱼，看上去辣椒超多，但其实并不是很辣，还有水蒸蛋刚开始以为量好足，没想到碗浅浅的，给我们造成了一种假象，铁板日本豆腐味道也不错，点的扬州炒饭一直上不了，后来干脆上了白米饭，这速度，只好快点吃完找其他店再吃一顿了！

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The rule lists 座位大小 as in scope yet excludes simply sitting somewhere, and "三个人坐坐正好" sits on that boundary, so five of six arms reasonably applied it while the gold did not.
pass1.fix: Add a boundary case to the Ambience#Space rule: comments that a table or booth fits N people count as seat size only when they judge it roomy or cramped, otherwise none.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The rule was read and says Ambience#Space covers seating size and whether a space fits people, but the review's phrase about a booth fitting three people only describes where they sat and is not a judgment of the space; the rule's own "does not apply" clause excludes simple seating mentions, so the agent misapplied it.
pass2.fix: Add a clarifying example to Ambience#Space: "坐得下/坐着正好" for a party counts only when the reviewer judges the space itself; a plain statement of where the party sat is not labelled.

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The clerk is only reported as stating a policy with no evaluation of manner, yet the gold labels hospitality neutral, and all six arms read the rule and declined, so the gold is inconsistent with the rule's wording on evaluating staff.

pass2.why: All six arms and the rule were read, and the staff member only stated that group-buys were no longer offered without judging their manner, so the gold's hospitality label looks inconsistent with the rule's requirement that service staff be evaluated.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a boundary note that neutral reports of staff statements do not count as Service#Hospitality unless manner, attitude or helpfulness is judged.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 摆盘很漂亮
decisions.text: 团购了一个经典套餐，双人套餐为什么只有一杯水-_-||。摆盘很漂亮，份量很足。选择了芝士肋排和辣鸡肉的混合版，待芝士融化后裹着吃，排骨留到最后实在没塞下，强烈建议要先吃排骨，要不实在浪费啦！周围的小盘里面有千叶豆腐，奶酪，土豆泥，还有南瓜汤，都很棒。南瓜汤很好喝，注意不要烧干了。要了金枪鱼饭团，也是只吃了一半，玉米粒沙拉一般，另外还配了一些小份的水果沙拉和玉米，橙子什么的。锅上烤了两个火腿面包，味道也不错，可惜实在吃不下了。饮料要的夏日青柠，饮料是个问题，只有几类饮料可选，不太满意。总得来说，很值得一吃，味道还是不错的。服务么？开始的时候很好，不过久了以后其实可以过来帮我调小一下火，最后芝士都烤焦了。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The review says 摆盘很漂亮, which matches the rule's own examples of 摆盘 and 漂亮-type praise, so the label looks right by the rule text; yet the gold omits it, and the case library shows 摆盘 phrases with 0 share of this label in the single case, so the gold seems to follow a convention the rulebook does not state.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add cases showing whether 摆盘很漂亮 is labelled Food#Appearance and state the convention explicitly in the rule.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The rule explicitly lists 摆盘 as a core appearance cue, so 摆盘很漂亮 plainly fits; the tag is not wrong by the rulebook, and the gold omitting it looks like an incomplete annotation rather than an agent error.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or have gold annotators re-check that 摆盘很漂亮 is in scope for Food#Appearance (the rule itself names 摆盘 as a trigger).

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.rejected_reason: The praise 很值得一吃 is about the meal overall and is a 值得 phrasing, which the rules say does not by itself count as a dish recommendation.

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The rule says 值得 alone does not count and 很值得一吃 is a 值得 phrasing, but the gold labels it as a recommendation, while the self-check dropped it; the rulebook gives no clear answer for 很值得一吃 versus 值得一试, which it lists as a recommendation trigger.
pass1.fix: Add an explicit rule edit: 很值得一吃 / 值得一试 / 值得一去 about the meal count as Food#Recommend, and add a case of this exact phrasing so the self-check does not drop it.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The rules say 值得 phrasing alone does not count, and the review gives no explicit recommendation, yet the gold marks positive recommendation; the agent's self-check dropped it, which matches the rule, so the gold label is the questionable element.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case where '很值得一吃' with praise for the meal overall is labelled Food#Recommend if the dataset convention is to count it, or clarify that 值得 only counts when it names a specific dish.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.evidence: 已经给你们优惠这菜的一半价了
decisions.text: 在华通这片算是小有名气的饭店了，但是服务水平真是一年比一年差。以前过年去只出包桌菜味道差服务差也能理解，但这季节又不是特别旺季，口感一般就不提了，以老板娘为头的服务水平真叫人无法忍受！点的烤鸭，只上了鸭架，肉都上别桌去了！去找她们理论，老板娘就低头算账甩一句已经给你们优惠这菜的一半价了，还想怎样！谁家卖烤鸭这鸭肉跟鸭架是一个价的？而且你这样是生意人该有的态度吗！！！反正就冲这一点，这一片的饭店都关门了我也不会再去这家吃了！

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The review mentions a half-price discount only as the owner's justification in a dispute about a bad dish, not as the reviewer judging the restaurant's deal, and the rule's applies-when list (优惠) matched on surface wording without checking whether the review judges the discount.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt check: label Price#Discount only when the reviewer evaluates the discount or deal itself; add a rule note that discounts quoted as a seller's argument in a complaint are not a judgement of discount strength, plus a few cases of this pattern.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The rule was read and the keyword 优惠 is present, but the reviewer only reports the owner's excuse sarcastically and does not judge the discount's size or fairness, so the model applied the keyword match without reading the context.
pass2.fix: Add a rule edit and a few cases: a discount mentioned only as a quoted or reported excuse inside a complaint about something else (such as service or portion) does not trigger Price#Discount unless the reviewer evaluates the discount itself.

decisions.label: Location#Easy_to_find
decisions.rejected_reason: 没有提到是否好找
decisions.text: 在南北广场近宝岗大道中公交车站附近，有无面对隔壁新开了一家面馆搞大促销抢了不少客人，所以该店也用减价打折优惠街坊进行反击，对于喜欢吃传统的鲜虾云吞面的街坊来说，这里是不错的选择，大地鱼清汤，相对新鲜的虾仁云吞，分量分量充足的韭黄，竹升面分量悄悄少了些，味道够经典，不错，新品筒骨浓汤叉烧拉面感觉是酸汤肥牛面的叉烧版本，因为没有加辣味，汤底基本一样，只是酸菜上没有辣椒油，不过叉烧卤得比较入味，感觉也不错，还有一只卤蛋状的温泉蛋，虽然其貌不扬，看上去就是卤蛋的样子，但是蛋黄是温泉蛋的半生熟的质感，但是卤水汁也很入味，这很不错，还有荔枝红茶随意添加，服务员会主动拿茶水给客人，隔壁面店促销人很多，不过试过出来的听说味道麻麻地，所以冠一应该能赢对手的。

pass1.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass1.why: The agent never read the Easy_to_find rule, so it did not check whether the sentence describing the store's position (near 南北广场 and a bus stop on 宝岗大道) answers how easy the store is to find, which the rule's '位置' cues cover.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step that checks every sentence describing the store's position or landmarks against the Easy_to_find rule, and add a few cases where a landmark-based location description is labelled easy to find.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The agent never read the Easy_to_find rule, so it did not check whether the sentence describing the restaurant's position near the square and bus stop counts as a location/findability remark, even though the rule says 位置-type descriptions usually get this label.
pass2.fix: Add a flow step requiring the agent to read every Location#* rule whenever the review describes where the restaurant is, and to check the 位置 and 位置偏/显眼 cues before deciding.

decisions.label: Location#Transportation
decisions.rejected_reason: 公交车站只用来定位店的位置（附近），没有评价公交或交通是否方便，也没有写离站几分钟，规则不适用

pass1.label: Location#Transportation
pass1.why: The rule was read and lists 公交 as a direct trigger (94%), and the 公交车站 cue has 0.952 precision with 9 of 9 cases labelled, yet the agent wrongly treated the bus-stop mention as a mere landmark and applied the '只说附近有什么' exclusion.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note that naming a bus stop or metro station as the access point counts as Transportation even when it is also used to locate the store, and clarify that the '附近' exclusion covers only non-transport landmarks such as malls or shops.

pass2.label: Location#Transportation
pass2.why: The rule was read and covers 公交 mentions (94%) and the cue 公交车站 has 0.952 training precision, but the agent over-applied the 附近 exclusion and treated the bus stop as mere location, misjudging a rule that clearly fits.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note that naming a bus stop or metro station as the way to reach the restaurant counts as Transportation, and add a few cases where 公交车站 near the restaurant is labelled Transportation so the 附近 exclusion is not applied to transit stops.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.evidence: 就餐环境不错
decisions.text: 一直都很喜欢豆捞坊，就冲着吃完后身上没有一丁点的火锅味这一点，不像去别家吃，味道可重了，就绝对愿意每次去吃豆捞要排队的怨念，没办法，味道也是真的很好呗！这次还好，就等了20分钟，环境依然很干净舒适，我点了依旧最爱的咖喱锅底，汤底味道浓郁，虾丸很新鲜，牛肉肉质细嫩软滑，蔬菜的新鲜度也不错，摆盘也很精致，量也特别多，服务员的服务态度都很好，吃了那么多次的豆捞坊，依旧不变的是上菜速度快，自助水果新鲜，就餐环境不错，且东西又超级好吃。今后和同事会一直都来光顾的。真的超级棒，赞赞赞！

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The rulebook says a generic evaluation such as 就餐环境不错 should carry all four environment labels (Decoration, Noise, Space, Sanitary), yet the gold tags only Noise and Sanitary, so the gold is inconsistent with the dataset's own convention.
pass1.fix: Correct the gold to add Ambience#Decoration and Ambience#Space for generic 环境 praise, and add a worked example of 就餐环境不错 to the rule so the convention is explicit.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review says only "就餐环境不错", a generic environment judgment, and the rulebook says such praise should tag all four environment labels (Decoration, Noise, Space, Sanitary). The gold tags Noise and Sanitary but omits Decoration, which is inconsistent with the dataset's own convention, so the agent's label matches the rules.
pass2.fix: Correct the gold to add Ambience#Decoration for this item, or document generic 环境 praise as an ambiguous case; also add a rule example showing that the four-label convention applies to bare 环境不错.

pass1.why: The same generic 就餐环境不错 wording falls under the rule's four-label convention for Space, but the gold omits it, and the agent did not read the boundary note that would have settled the question.

decisions.label: Service#Hospitality
decisions.evidence: 服务员的服务态度都很好
decisions.text: 一直都很喜欢豆捞坊，就冲着吃完后身上没有一丁点的火锅味这一点，不像去别家吃，味道可重了，就绝对愿意每次去吃豆捞要排队的怨念，没办法，味道也是真的很好呗！这次还好，就等了20分钟，环境依然很干净舒适，我点了依旧最爱的咖喱锅底，汤底味道浓郁，虾丸很新鲜，牛肉肉质细嫩软滑，蔬菜的新鲜度也不错，摆盘也很精致，量也特别多，服务员的服务态度都很好，吃了那么多次的豆捞坊，依旧不变的是上菜速度快，自助水果新鲜，就餐环境不错，且东西又超级好吃。今后和同事会一直都来光顾的。真的超级棒，赞赞赞！

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The review explicitly says 服务员的服务态度都很好, which matches the rule's keywords 服务员 and 态度 and was read by every arm, so the omission from gold looks like an incomplete gold label rather than a rule gap.
pass1.fix: Correct the gold to add Service#Hospitality for this review and audit other gold items where 服务态度 or 服务员 praise was left unlabelled.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: "服务员的服务态度都很好" directly matches the Hospitality rule (服务员 plus 态度), the rule was read, and all six arms made the same call, so the gold omission is what conflicts with the rules.
pass2.fix: Correct the gold to add Service#Hospitality for this item and review other gold labels from this annotation batch for similar omissions of explicit staff-attitude praise.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: 只说品质不错，没有对卖相的评价
decisions.text: 在商场里边，周末人很多，平时的晚上也需要等位。扶梯处就有服务员引导接待了，门口准备了好多等位的小桌和座位，小食饮料还有游戏棋之类的，服务员很热情，带到位置，如果这个时候人少，还会提醒坐在哪里更方便离小料台近，熟练点单，会为戴眼镜的客人主动提供眼镜布，按位的水加的很及时，都有点不好意思，非常有眼力见，又不会过，让人很舒服的服务。锅底还是人多一些吃比较值也不浪费，小吧台提供多种调料选择，还有水果零食和汤之类的， 食材很新鲜，毛肚鸭血一看品质就不错，总体吃下来是很好的体验，只是每次吃完结账走的时候，就没人理了，反差有点大，不过服务已经很好了，推荐的地方，非常值得吃吃。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The review's only visual cue is "毛肚鸭血一看品质就不错", a look-based judgment of ingredients, while the rule only excludes "新鲜" and says nothing about visual quality judgments, so the agent reasonably read it as taste/freshness and the gold label is debatable.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit to Food#Appearance stating that visual judgments of food quality ("一看就好", "看着新鲜", "品相好") count as appearance, with a few such cases added to the library.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The agent considered the label but never read its rule, and the review's "毛肚鸭血一看品质就不错" is a visual judgement of the dishes that the rule's scope would cover, so the flow skipped a rule it needed.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: before rejecting any candidate label, read its rule file and check its Applies-when list against the text. Add a rule example that visual judgements of dish quality ("一看就...", "看着很新鲜") count toward Food#Appearance, while bare freshness claims with no visual cue stay out.

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The rule lists "商场" as a direct trigger (77%, and 93% of cases with this word carry the label), but the agent never read the Location#Downtown rule and wrongly required an explicit evaluation of the location before tagging.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step that scans for venue-type keywords (商场, 广场, 百货, 步行街, 购物中心) and reads the matching location rule before deciding, and state in the prompt that a mere mention of such a place counts for Downtown without any evaluative wording.

pass2.why: The rule explicitly lists 商场 as an Applies-when cue (77% label rate), yet the agent never read the rule and treated "在商场里边" as a bare location statement, which is the flow failing to apply a rule that was available.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to match each mention of a place or cue word (商场, 广场, 步行街) against the Applies-when lists of every label in the taxonomy before deciding that a label does not apply.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 他家的日料缺少日料精致
decisions.text: 在国瑞城对面的小楼里，进门上电梯四层！新开业没有多久，环境还是很新，有包间但是不太隔音！榻榻米很可爱，我们选择了团购两人餐，298元！我个人感觉一般，不会再来第二次！团餐种类多，但是总体感觉每份的量少，不知道单点是不是也是这个量，如果是更不值得吃了！明太鱼籽薯条味道不错，南瓜蛋挞是放在刺身盘里一起端过来的，你家是多缺盘子啊，生食和甜点放在一起了！南瓜蛋挞味道和我口味！其他吃食太一般了，尤其是葱爆扇贝，香辣鸡排，吃起来很像像一般馆子的炒菜！总之，他家的日料缺少日料精致！

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The rule was read, but the label was added only by the self-check, and "缺少日料精致" is a judgment about the restaurant's overall Japanese style and quality, not about how dishes look or are plated.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: the self-check must not add a label that was unsure in the first pass unless the quoted text describes dish presentation (卖相, 摆盘, 造型, 颜色). Add a case where 精致 refers to overall cuisine quality and is not Food#Appearance.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The rule was read, but "缺少日料精致" is a judgment about the cuisine's refinement overall, not about how dishes look; the 精致 cue alone was over-weighted and the self-check kept it.
pass2.fix: Add to the Food#Appearance rule that 精致 must refer to the dishes' visual presentation or plating, and that general quality or authenticity judgments such as 日料不地道 or 缺少精致感 do not count.

decisions.evidence: 如果是更不值得吃了

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The rule does list 不值, but "如果是更不值得吃了" is a hypothetical about single-order portions rather than a verdict on this restaurant's value, so the gold omitting it is debatable and five of six arms still made the same call.
pass1.fix: Document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that conditional hypotheticals (如果是…就不值) do not count as a value judgment unless the reviewer's own verdict is stated.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: "如果是更不值得吃了" is conditional and tied to portion size rather than a price-to-quality comparison, and the rule was read yet the self-check still added it.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the rule that 值得/不值得 counts only when it weighs price against what is received, and that a conditional remark driven by portion size should be labelled Food#Portion instead.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 价格便宜味道不错分量还很足
decisions.text: 在松树桥中学读了6年书，后来毕业到现在，这家店已经在那很久了，虽然店面不大，但是价格便宜所以生意一直挺好，主要是价格便宜味道不错分量还很足，最喜欢的就是他们家的烧仙草和双皮奶了，烧仙草的料很足，里面有仙草、花生、葡萄干、红豆，然后搭配他们家的奶茶，超棒，有时不是很饿的时候一杯下去就饱了，还有双皮奶也很好吃，我最爱的是红豆双皮奶，红豆和双皮奶混合好，虽然不好看，但确实绝配，还有夏天可以试试他们家的冰沙，分量真的很惊人！

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review says the place is cheap and also has good taste and generous portions, which implies value, but it never explicitly sets price against quality, so the gold excluded it and careful labellers could split on this.
pass1.fix: Add a case-library example of 'cheap plus good taste/portion' without 性价比/划算/物超所值 wording and record the gold convention, or document as ambiguous.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says 价格便宜 and 味道不错 and 分量还很足 separately, with no explicit value-for-money comparison or cue word like 性价比, 划算 or 实惠, so the rule's 'does not apply' case (only saying cheap or good without comparing price to quality) fits, though the agent's reading is arguably defensible.
pass2.fix: Add a case library entry showing that 'cheap plus good taste/large portion' in one sentence is labelled Cost_effective only when the reviewer links price and quality; otherwise document as ambiguous.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 招牌烧白色香味俱全
decisions.text:
在西永天街数得上的美食不多，九九江湖食府绝对排得上前5了，川菜做得十分地道，位置也很好找，主公路旁边就能看到，西永天街站下车，交通便利。
九九家的菜大开大合气势如虹，首先份量十足，招牌菜味道突出，远胜一些大排档。江湖鱼、火爆肥肠、石锅牛肉、铁板鱿鱼须都是推荐菜品。招牌烧白色香味俱全，就是太长太大，一块儿能抵其他馆子的2-3块儿，用餐人数少的话就不推荐了。
装修是典型的中式风格，突出江湖的气息，大长条板凳，包房内也适合商务洽谈。消费也不算太高，性价比不错。服务员训练有素，应答如流。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The quote 招牌烧白色香味俱全 praises colour and aroma together, which is a taste/smell judgement; the rule's appearance cues (卖相, 摆盘, 色泽, 颜值) are not present, and the self-check added the label although the rule was read.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The rule was read, but the self-check added this label from 香味俱全 (aroma and flavour), which is not about appearance; the self-check changed the decision and the other six arms did not make this error.
pass2.fix: Add to the self-check that labels added during checking must quote wording about looks (卖相, 摆盘, 色泽, 精致, 颜值), and that smell or taste words such as 香味 do not count as Appearance.

decisions.label: Location#Easy_to_find
decisions.evidence: 门头很显眼
decisions.text: 在金水路南，晟业小区旁边，门头很显眼，无停车位，不过离下王埠东公交车站几步之遥，所以交通还算方便！是东北馆子，主打各种烧烤和家常炒菜！价格便宜，菜量大，环境卫生的话不咋滴，当然了这也几乎是所以东北菜馆的通病，好在我们就是几个大老爷们喝酒吃肉，所以也不在乎那么多了！原浆25一扎，味道还行。炒大肠，大肠好少，是不现在大肠比较贵的缘故呢。醉蟹钳还有虾酱芸豆比较赞，尤其醉蟹钳，味道特别好。烧烤类的中规中矩吧，基本可以算无功无过！烤鲜鲅鱼挺好吃的，58一只，挺大的。三五小伙伴约酒的好去处。

pass1.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass1.why: The rule lists 位置显眼 and 招牌明显 as applying, so 门头很显眼 fits literally, but the review is about the storefront being visible, which the rule set does not explicitly cover; all arms applied the same reading, pointing to the rule's wording rather than the model.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note: 门头显眼/招牌醒目 counts as easy-to-find only when the reviewer judges whether the place is easy to locate; add 3-5 gold cases of 门头显眼 labelled with and without this tag to settle the convention.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The rule explicitly lists 位置显眼 and 招牌明显 as applying, so 门头很显眼 fits the rule's own wording, and the gold omitted it even though the rulebook supports it.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that 门头显眼/招牌显眼 counts as easy-to-find so the gold and rule agree.

pass1.why: The review states 无停车位, which literally matches the 车位 trigger, and the rule says Service#Parking applies to 车位 with no polarity restriction, so the gold omission conflicts with the rule's own trigger list.
pass1.fix: Either add to the rule that a bare statement of no parking spaces is labelled as parking, or add cases showing that negative parking-absence remarks are unlabelled; confirm which convention the gold follows.

pass2.label: Service#Parking
pass2.why: The rule applies to 车位 and 停车 mentions, and 无停车位 is a direct parking judgment, so labelling it is consistent with the rule; the gold omitted it without a stated exclusion.

pass1.why: The review says 环境卫生的话不咋滴 with no decor comment, and the rule's general-environment clause is about unspecified 环境 judgments, yet the gold tags Decoration as negative, which is inconsistent with the rule's own 只具体说某一方面则只标那一方面 convention for hygiene remarks.
pass1.fix: Clarify in the boundary section that a specific hygiene remark (环境卫生/卫生) labels only Sanitary, and add cases of 环境卫生 complaints to show whether Decoration is expected; otherwise document as ambiguous.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review gives a general 环境 judgment only through 环境卫生, and the rulebook's convention says a general environment evaluation labels all four environment tags, yet the agent never read the Decoration rule and rejected it on the narrow hygiene reading.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to read the Ambience#Decoration and boundary rules whenever a 环境 word appears, and to apply the general-environment convention before rejecting a tag.

decisions.evidence: 很好的一家店、推荐推荐推荐
decisions.text: 地理位置非常的优越！ 千岛湖风景区 新安大街18号-1-2-3(绿城度假酒店、喜来登酒店大门正对面)！和朋友又一次去千岛湖的时候特地去吃的、因为之前朋友在这边吃过、觉得味道非常赞、价格也算是比较便宜的、4个人才花了两百不到！记得前年来千岛湖的时候也吃了鱼头、千岛湖的特色鱼头！当时觉得味道还不错、只是价格太贵了、人均一百多！这次来吃的不止点了鱼头、而且还点了其它的很多小菜、味道都很好、比较特色的鱼头汤烧的很棒！淡淡的鱼香、一点不油腻、很有胶原蛋白！店里店面装修不错、只是只顾着吃了没有拍门店的照片！店面装修设计给人一种很舒服的感觉、一点压力都没有！店里服务态度很好、店里服务员形象都还不错！进店以后就有服务员来安排座位、倒水、之后推荐了店里的特色菜、很好的一家店、推荐推荐推荐

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The rule says a bare repeated 推荐 counts only when the reviewer clearly endorses the dish, yet the closing line recommends the restaurant overall, not a dish, so the rule's scope on restaurant-level recommendation is unclear and the agent applied the word match.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit: restaurant-level recommendations (推荐这家店) do not count as Food#Recommend unless a dish is named; add a few cases of 推荐这家店/推荐推荐推荐 labelled without Food#Recommend.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The review ends with an explicit 推荐推荐推荐 after praising the restaurant, which matches the rule's 'explicit recommendation' cue, yet the gold omits it; the rule's own examples of non-applying cases (bare 推荐 wording) do not clearly cover a direct self-recommendation, so the gold looks inconsistent with the dataset's convention.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case where a reviewer's closing 推荐 with overall praise is labelled both ways to settle whether a restaurant-level recommendation counts as Food#Recommend.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 喜欢甜品的朋友可以去尝尝喔
decisions.text: 夏芝朵店的门店开在泰星现代城的对面那条街，就是原来的猫空咖啡现在开的夏芝朵，门店上个超级大的门面牌写着“ 夏 芝 朵 ”三个大字，位置很好找，离的很远就能看见了。店门口空地很大，还有几十个停车位，大大滴方便了开车去买蛋糕滴吃货同胞们。店内和店门口都设有座位桌子，可以买了就在那吃了也可以带走，随个人喜好。一直偏爱吃甜食的我，今天路过夏芝朵，看到了大大的门店牌，本来没想买但最后还是没忍住，杀了进去。进去挑花了眼，有好多品种，小蛋挞、小甜点、还有各种蛋糕和饮料，最后买了窝最爱次滴提拉米苏和蛋挞外加两个小蛋糕，三十块钱用的代金券才25，还是很划算的。店里的环境不错，卫生也干净，服务也到位，态度很好。真滴是顾客就是上帝的感觉。结完账迫不及待的次了提拉米苏，好好次。喜欢甜品的朋友可以去尝尝喔！！！！

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The rule requires an explicit recommendation but does not say whether a soft suggestion like "可以去尝尝" counts, and it only names "值得一试" as an example, so the agent and the gold split on this wording.
pass1.fix: Add to the Food#Recommend rule that suggestions such as "可以去尝尝" or "推荐大家试试" count as recommendation, or list them under the does-not-apply examples, and add several labelled cases of each.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The agent read the rule, which requires an explicit recommend or not-recommend stance, yet treated the soft suggestion "喜欢甜品的朋友可以去尝尝" as a recommendation; only 4 of 10 arms made this error, so the rule was available and the model over-applied it.
pass2.fix: Add contrastive cases to the Food#Recommend rule showing that "可以去尝尝" or "喜欢X的朋友可以试试" without explicit 推荐 or 值得一试 is not labelled, and tighten the rule so only explicit endorsements count.

pass1.why: The agent marked the item as not mentioning a commercial area without reading the Downtown rule, which says a location inside or beside a mall or plaza counts, and the review places the shop opposite 泰星现代城, a mall.

pass1.label: Price#Discount

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective

工作餐到这里吃提前点菜不用排长队，因为服务员不多但菜品上的非常快，米饭点一份上来一桶，自己挖不会浪费还保温，感觉老板花了心思在追求方式简便菜品不简单。

pass1.fix: Prompt edit: when a sentence praises the environment without a cleanliness word (干净, 卫生, 整洁), do not label Sanitary; add the rule to the checklist for every ambience decision.

pass2.fix: Add a prompt step that reads each Ambience rule before labelling, and clarify in the Sanitary rule that a generic 环境 praise with no hygiene words gets only the decoration and space labels where those words appear, not sanitary.

酸菜鱼片量很大价格实惠，鱼片厚薄适中很入味，古法蒸香肠没想到一盘是密密麻麻一圈香肠，下面铺着肉末，蒸的够火候香肠不是很油咸香很下饭。随便吃吃的话三四个人也够了。
工作餐到这里吃提前点菜不用排长队，因为服务员不多但菜品上的非常快，米饭点一份上来一桶，自己挖不会浪费还保温，感觉老板花了心思在追求方式简便菜品不简单。

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: Five of six arms also labelled Space from the same phrase, and the rule does allow the general-environment tag only when 'space' is meant; 环境格局 may well be read as layout, so the gold's silence on Space versus the agent's reading is debatable.
pass1.fix: Rule edit: state whether 格局 or 布局 wording counts as Space, and add a few cases where a layout word is used without size or seating comments.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The 'comfortable layout' wording is a general environment praise, and the rule's general-environment clause applies four labels, but the review gives no evidence about seat size or crowding; the 'simple layout' phrase reads as decoration rather than space.
pass2.fix: Rewrite the boundary note so that the four-label expansion applies only when the review evaluates the environment as a whole with several facets, and give a case where 格局 praise maps to Decoration alone.

pass1.label: Location#Transportation
pass1.why: The phrase only names a nearby station as a location landmark, and the rule's 'Does not apply' note on 附近 conflicts with the 地铁 trigger, so the self-check added the label under the 地铁 cue.

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: All six arms labelled 价格实惠 as Cost_effective, but the gold omits it and treats the phrase as price level only, so the gold conflicts with the rule's own listing of 实惠 as a cost-effectiveness cue and with its 66% share in the case library.

pass1.label: Price#Level

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The gold tags hospitality, but the only staff-related text is 服务员不多, a headcount remark, and no attitude is stated, so the agent's rejection follows the rule's wording about attitude and the gold looks inconsistent with it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that staff count with no attitude does not trigger Hospitality.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The review says the waiters are few but the dishes come quickly, and the gold's negative polarity for hospitality is not supported by any attitude statement, so the gold looks inconsistent with the rule that requires judging the staff's attitude or hospitality.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 真的值得吃货们去体验一番
decisions.text: 宁波首家顶级日料自助餐，398元/位，享受的绝对是最顶级的食材，最尊贵的服务，真的值得吃货们去体验一番[强]#刺身拼盘#新西兰进口的敖虾足足有一只手那么大！肉质紧致口感鲜甜。#雪花生牛肉#顶级牛肉切片单面经过炙烤，蘸着秘制酱料一口塞，与生俱来的鲜令人无法用言语形容。#冰鱼炉端烧#采用的是原始的炉边炭烤，保留了鱼本身的原汁原味（普及一下，冰鱼是一种南极的，也是最挑食的，一生只吃南极虾一种食物）所以其肉雪白，肉质紧实，难得的美味#桌边秀寿司#，很荣幸能让厨师长为我们表演这场如艺术般的制作过程，左口鱼寿司最为惊艳，吃到嘴里完全感觉不到鱼肉的存在，用入口即化一词形容一点也不为过[OK]！甜品柚香水果奶酪，甜而不腻，清香犹存！

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The phrase '真的值得吃货们去体验一番' is a 值得 phrasing, which the rule says is mostly unlabelled (38%), yet the rule's boundary also says 明确说“值得一试” adds Recommend, so the two clauses pull in opposite directions and the agent followed the looser reading.
pass1.fix: Add an explicit example to Food#Recommend: '值得去体验/值得一试' applies only when it is a direct recommendation of the restaurant's food, and add a contrasting case of '值得' alone being unlabelled; add more cases of 体验一番/去试试 phrasing with gold labels.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The review says 真的值得吃货们去体验一番, which is an explicit recommendation to try the restaurant; the rule's 值得 exclusion (38% labelled) conflicts with the rule's own boundary that 明确说“值得一试” adds recommendation, so the gold omission is debatable.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule example that 值得去体验/值得一试 aimed at the restaurant as a whole counts as recommendation while bare 值得 about a dish does not.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: '其肉雪白' describes colour as a feature, but there is no 卖相, 摆盘 or 颜色好看 judgement, so it does not meet the rule.

pass1.why: The agent and the gold disagree on '其肉雪白', which describes colour of the fish; the gold labels it as appearance while the rule's examples only cover 卖相, 摆盘, 色泽 and 颜色好看, and five of six arms rejected it, so the gold seems to stretch the rule.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that a described colour of a dish (如 雪白、鲜红) counts as 色泽 when the reviewer evaluates it, with a few labelled cases to settle the convention.

pass2.why: The model correctly read the rule and rejected 其肉雪白 as colour without a 卖相 judgement, but gold marks positive appearance; five of six arms also missed it, so the gold looks inconsistent with the rule's own 颜色好看 criterion.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; alternatively add a rule clarifying that positive colour description of a dish (如雪白、色泽诱人) counts as 外观 positive.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: The review does not contain 贵. '398元/位' is only a stated price with no high/low or value judgement, and the rule does not label bare prices.

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: '398元/位' is a bare stated price with no high/low judgement, which the rule explicitly says is usually unlabelled, but the gold labels it, and the review's '顶级' framing around the price may be what the gold annotator counted as a value judgement.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; clarify in the rule whether a per-person price stated alongside 顶级 or 最尊贵 praise counts as a level judgement, and add cases where a bare 人均 figure in a premium-framed review is labelled.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The bare 398元/位 with no high/low judgement is excluded by the rule, but the review's 顶级 framing and 最尊贵 context make a price-level judgement plausible; gold labels it positive while the rule says bare prices are usually unlabelled, so the gold departs from the stated convention.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and add a case-library note on whether a stated price in a premium-positioning review counts as 价格水平.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.rejected_reason: 「年糕片都挺厚」describes thickness/shape, not portion size.
decisions.text: 家附近的香酥鸡小摊，偶尔馋了回来解解馋，为了不胖不常吃，毕竟是油炸食物嘛。他们家的酱油调料调的蛮好的，有点甜的。年糕串是儿时的回忆，这家年糕片都挺厚的，就是那种小年糕条，其实大年糕切成小薄片会更糯更好吃呀，可能没有那么多人力去切吧。香酥鸡也不知道多少钱一两，反正买了10块钱的。豆腐衣包韭菜好好吃啊，韭菜老嫩的，豆腐衣么口感也很好。掌中宝2块5一串，也挺好吃的。开了也很多年的小摊了，生意一直都蛮好的，虽然是路边摊但希望品质不要降低。

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The gold labels Food#Portion, but the only candidate text is 「年糕片都挺厚」 and 「买了10块钱的」, which describe thickness and price rather than quantity; every arm missed it and the rule's list of cues does not match these phrases, so the gold looks debatable.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a case library entry showing that purchase amount plus comments on thickness/size of pieces count as Food#Portion when the reviewer implies quantity value.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The gold tags Food#Portion, but the review only describes thickness of the rice cake slices and the 10-yuan purchase without any explicit judgement of quantity; every arm missed it, and the rule's exclusions point the same way, so the gold looks debatable.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a case showing that purchase amount plus 'thick/thin' description alone does not count as a Portion judgement unless quantity is evaluated.

decisions.label: Ambience#Noise
decisions.rejected_reason: '环境' is praised only as refined; no noise comment, so the general-environment four-label rule does not apply.
decisions.text: 就在北新桥地铁站口出来就是，总体来说整个感觉就是棒棒哒~服务一流，菜品干净，环境考究，江浙菜为主，也有麻小，价位虽然不便宜但是也不算很贵，有团购劵可以享受85折，吃的真是很精致，主要说说服务，第一次去的时候是乌龙事件，跟朋友说先帮忙定个桌我们一会过去，结果他定的是簋街另外一家店我以为是这家，过去就问有没有刘先生定的座位，服务员指了一个房间，我们去了已经有人坐了，所以让服务员协调，协调了好久我们也有点烦躁了，结果朋友电话打来说我们走错饭店了…那个尴尬…结果服务员笑了说没关系，还特别给我们送到了店门口详细的为我们指路，真心是良心服务~！！！而且这家服务好不是偶然，后来每次去服务的每个服务人员，态度都非常棒~~~~

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The agent never read the rule, and its flow treated '环境考究' as a specific decoration remark, so it missed that general environment praise triggers all four environment labels.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step: when a review praises '环境' in general terms (including 环境考究), check the general-environment boundary rule and tag Decoration, Noise, Space and Sanitary together.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: The general-environment boundary rule was never read, so the agent did not apply the convention that praising 环境 without specifying an aspect tags all four environment labels, which the gold follows.
pass2.fix: Add a flow step: whenever a review praises 环境 or ambience at all, read the Ambience boundary section and apply the four-label convention unless a single aspect is explicitly named.

pass2.label: Ambience#Sanitary

pass2.fix: Have the self-check re-run the general-environment boundary before removing an environment label, and state explicitly that 环境 praise without a named aspect keeps all four environment labels.

pass1.label: Food#Taste
pass1.why: The rule says Taste applies whenever any dish is evaluated and is almost always tagged, but the only food remark here is about appearance ('精致') and the rulebook does not say whether appearance-only food praise triggers Taste.
pass1.fix: Add an explicit rule and cases: when food is praised only for appearance or refinement with no taste word, tag Food#Taste if the dataset convention is to tag it, and give examples.

pass2.label: Food#Taste
pass2.why: The rule says taste applies only when a dish's taste is evaluated, but the gold and the stated 95% base rate imply that food-focused reviews always carry Food#Taste, which contradicts that wording.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: 音符巧克力“真是可爱”出自小侄子的玩笑，不是对蛋糕卖相的明确评价，证据偏弱，去掉
decisions.text: 已经第四次来买格丽思生日蛋糕了吧，每次自己或家人过生日需要买蛋糕都会选择格丽思，觉得比其他家品牌连锁的好吃，几款里最喜欢的还是黑岩骑士，口感好，夹层有蓝莓酱，吃多了也不会腻。8月自己过生日，就去买了个，电话预约so方便快捷。因为想吃新鲜点的蛋糕，怕隔夜的奶油变味，于是就和店家约好，第二天早上九点去拿蛋糕。我们刚好九点到那，发现蛋糕已经做好了，就在展示柜里。对上手机号后店员就很利索地帮忙包装起来。并送了生日蜡烛，我拿的18。包装很好到家也没有坏。由于冰箱冷藏室里放不下，冷冻柜又不能放，只能放在外面。好在隔了三小时才吃，吃的时候也没有太影响口感。来的小孩子们都很喜欢吃，都有点不够吃。我小侄子看着装饰的音符型巧克力说，一，这有个蚊香巧克力。哈哈乐死我了。真是可爱。不知道格丽思下次充值优惠的活动什么时候开始啊？距离上次宝龙店开业充了一次，等了好久了。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The rule covers 造型 and 颜值 praise, and the review praises the 音符 chocolate decoration as 真是可爱. The self-check dropped this on a weak-evidence argument even though six other arms kept it, so the check overrode a correct label.
pass1.fix: Edit the self-check so it does not drop an aspect for being voiced by a companion or as a joke when the praise targets the cake's decoration or shape; add a note that decoration praise counts as Food#Appearance.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The only appearance-like comment is the nephew's joke about the music-note chocolate looking like a mosquito coil, followed by '真是可爱'; the rule covers 卖相/造型 but this is a playful remark rather than a judgement of the cake's look, so the agent's drop was defensible, though the gold's 'cute decoration' reading is arguable.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous (cute decorative remarks by a third party), or add a rule note that decorative figures/chocolate praised as 可爱 count as Food#Appearance.

decisions.label: Service#Timely
decisions.rejected_reason: “等了好久”指等下次充值优惠，不是等菜；店员利索包装是服务态度，不是上菜快慢
decisions.text: 已经第四次来买格丽思生日蛋糕了吧，每次自己或家人过生日需要买蛋糕都会选择格丽思，觉得比其他家品牌连锁的好吃，几款里最喜欢的还是黑岩骑士，口感好，夹层有蓝莓酱，吃多了也不会腻。8月自己过生日，就去买了个，电话预约so方便快捷。因为想吃新鲜点的蛋糕，怕隔夜的奶油变味，于是就和店家约好，第二天早上九点去拿蛋糕。我们刚好九点到那，发现蛋糕已经做好了，就在展示柜里。对上手机号后店员就很利索地帮忙包装起来。并送了生日蜡烛，我拿的18。包装很好到家也没有坏。由于冰箱冷藏室里放不下，冷冻柜又不能放，只能放在外面。好在隔了三小时才吃，吃的时候也没有太影响口感。来的小孩子们都很喜欢吃，都有点不够吃。我小侄子看着装饰的音符型巧克力说，一，这有个蚊香巧克力。哈哈乐死我了。真是可爱。不知道格丽思下次充值优惠的活动什么时候开始啊？距离上次宝龙店开业充了一次，等了好久了。

pass1.label: Service#Timely
pass1.why: The only waiting mention, 等了好久, refers to waiting for the next recharge promotion, and the pickup at 9am is a scheduled collection, not a dish being served slowly. Four arms rejected it on the rule's own terms, so the gold label looks inconsistent with the rule's definition of 等菜.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or recheck the gold; the rule should state that waiting for a promotion or a scheduled pickup does not count as 上菜速度.

pass2.label: Service#Timely
pass2.why: The rule covers 等菜 and 出餐快, but the review's '等了好久' refers to waiting for a recharge promotion and the packing speed is a service-attitude point, so the rule's boundary does not clearly fit; the agent read both rules and correctly rejected them, yet the gold still marks timeliness, which suggests the gold may be loose about what 'timely' covers.
pass2.fix: Add a rule clarification: speed of staff handling a customer's request (e.g. 利索/很快地包装, 很快就拿到) counts as Service#Timely when the reviewer comments on how fast it was done, and state explicitly that 等 about non-meal matters (promotions, waiting for future events) does not count.

decisions.label: Ambience#Space
decisions.evidence: 包厢的环境特别好
decisions.text: 年终实验室小伙伴们聚餐，选了学校里的这家餐厅，跟我们办公室只有几步之遥。餐厅主要是江浙菜，暂且认为是学校食堂的高端升级版，口味相比食堂确实也好多了很多。印象最好的是酱牛肉，劲道入味，还有黑米汁，香甜醇厚，暖胃提神。老馒头挺有特色，特别松软，看起来是酵母放的太多了。包厢的环境特别好，壁画很精致，包厢里有单独的卫生间，干净整洁没有异味，而且与包厢之间有屏风隔断，布置得细心周到，另外卫生间的隔音效果不错，大家在外面吵闹，在躲卫生间里打电话完全不受影响。

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The Space rule says general praise of 环境 should carry the environment labels, but its boundary note reads 'same as above' and never says whether Space is one of the four labels that must be marked, so the self-check's addition of Space and the gold's omission are both defensible readings.
pass1.fix: Rewrite the boundary note to list the four ambience labels explicitly and state whether a general 包厢/环境 praise marks Space; add a few cases of general praise with and without Space in the gold.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The rule says a general evaluation of 环境 is tagged with the environment labels, so "包厢的环境特别好" is a generic environment praise; the self-check added Space on top of Decoration, and the rule's wording on general environment praise is ambiguous enough that a careful labeller could go either way, but the review's specific space content is absent, so the check changed a reasonable answer.
pass2.fix: Edit the Ambience#Space rule to say a generic 环境 praise tags only the aspects with concrete evidence (e.g. decoration, sanitary, noise) and not Space unless size, crowding or seat count is mentioned; add contrast cases of 环境很好 alone versus 包间很大.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.rejected_reason: 「很幸运中了点评的试吃聚会」只是陈述获得试吃的事实，没有评价折扣或优惠力度，不符合规则。
decisions.text: 很幸运中了点评的试吃聚会，菜品很丰富，点评几个自己觉得印象深刻的：#二指禅# 非常棒的仿荤菜，仿的是烤肠，无论是外形还是味道，包括里面的肥瘦肉粒都清清楚楚，太逼真了！#芝士咖喱牛肉# 很浓的芝士可以拉丝的，不过咖喱的药味略重。#素三文鱼刺身# 非常逼真，据说是海藻提取物制作的，肉质的纹理都很清晰，有种三文鱼入口即化的口感。#特色肉饼# 外焦里嫩，馅料十足。#鲜花饼# 热腾腾的鲜花饼还是第一次吃到，可以看到玫瑰花瓣。不是很甜，推荐！

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists 大众点评的霸王餐、免费试吃 as applying to Price#Discount, and the review says it won a Dianping tasting party, but the agent never read this rule and rejected the label on a narrow reading that ignored the free-tasting clause.
pass1.fix: Add an explicit flow step: before finalising, check every 'Applies when' item (including 霸王餐/免费试吃 and 赠送) against the review text, and add a worked example where a free tasting event is labelled Price#Discount.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The rule explicitly lists 免费试吃 and 大众点评的霸王餐 as applying to Price#Discount, and this review is a free tasting event, so the gold label follows the rulebook's own convention even though the agent reasonably read the sentence as a bare statement of fact.
pass2.fix: Add an explicit example to the Price#Discount rule: a review that says it got the meal free via a tasting event or 霸王餐 gets Price#Discount, even without a price comparison, and add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.rejected_reason: The 活动 is a free tasting event; no discount strength is judged.
decisions.text: 很幸运抽中廉江鹿圣酒家的试食活动，鹿圣酒家位于廉江建设路位置交通方便环境安静，酒家内部装修偏中式设计但又不失活泼，酒家服务员热情大方礼貌规纪服务好评。本次酒家推出十三个菜式试食，风味独特，本人十分喜爱当中的烧汁茄瓜，秘制红烧肉，巴戟杜仲鹿骨汤，可乐焗排骨，海参扣红腰豆。烧汁茄瓜酸甜可口适中茄香满满，秘制红烧肉肥而不腻入口即化口感满而香滑，巴戟杜仲鹿骨汤香滑清甜丝丝中带有淡淡的草本味另人再来一碗，可乐焗排骨香甜可口、可乐的甜与排骨的肉香完美容入一体甜中带香大伙一致认为是满分的菜式，海参扣红豆海参爽脆弹牙清淡松脆我很喜欢。还有特别喜欢他们的甜酒，酸甜适中开胃消食口感顺喉舒服。还有两个菜我想建议下:手撕牛肉虽然香气十足但不够脆嫩口感偏硬韧。虫草花白鸽草本味过重。整体酒家有特色有服务，值得推荐。

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists 免费试吃 and 霸王餐 under Applies when, so the gold is supported, yet the agent rejected it as 'a free tasting event with no discount strength' and the rule was never read, so the rule text and the agent's reading conflict with the gold; all six arms made the same miss, pointing to the rule's framing as the source.
pass1.fix: Add an explicit example to the Price#Discount rule: 'a free tasting (免费试吃/霸王餐) mentioned as the reviewer's reason for the visit counts as Price#Discount with positive polarity', and add a few similar tasting-event cases to the case library.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The rule explicitly says 免费试吃 (free tasting) and 活动 apply to Price#Discount, so the gold is supported by the rule, yet the agent rejected it as no discount strength being judged and never read the rule (rule_read false); the rulebook's wording for free tastings is easy to read as not a discount, so the agent's reading conflicts with the rule text.
pass2.fix: Add an explicit prompt line: 'Free tasting events (免费试吃、霸王餐、试食活动) count as Price#Discount even without a stated discount amount; check this rule for any 活动 or 试吃 mention before rejecting.' Add 3-5 cases of 试食/试吃 reviews labelled Price#Discount.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: The only candidate, 精美的瓷盘, describes the plates (tableware), which the rules assign to decoration, not dish appearance; no evaluation of the dishes' presentation is given.
decisions.text: 上海1号，前几年去过一次。记得有一个大厅，放满了餐桌，食客人头济济，生意蛮好。这次去，不见了大厅，里面尽是大大小小的包厢。现在的散客，只得在门外的走道上就餐，可见就餐主渠道已是包厢的食客们。从上海特有的石库门进入，通过悠长的走道，在服务员的引导下，寻到你所定的包厢，包厢的名称都是上海的地名。走道两侧和包厢内悬挂着老上海的照片，浓重有点“艳”的装饰，再现了旧上海三四十年代虚浮奢华的情调。毕竟再现是虚幻的，老上海人一看就觉得有点“过”有点“俗”。老上海的味道以及上海人温润的气质，不是靠装饰出来的。上海1号，名谓“上海咪道“，其实是改良的上海菜，是几十年沿袭下来的上海屋里厢家常菜，红烧肉、油爆虾、鳝糊、梭子蟹、生煎馒头、油墩子……这些上海美食元素，在这里放入精美的瓷盘，卖出了好价钱。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The rules explicitly route praise of tableware and plates to decoration and say nothing about dish presentation, and the review gives no evaluation of the dishes' look, so the gold Food#Appearance rests on the word 精美 applied to plates rather than dishes, which careful labellers could dispute.
pass1.fix: Document as ambiguous or add a rule edit stating that 精美 describing tableware alone does not trigger Food#Appearance unless the dishes' presentation is also judged; add contrastive cases of 精美瓷盘 labelled Decoration only.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The only candidate phrase 精美的瓷盘 describes tableware, which the rules explicitly send to decoration, and the review never evaluates how the dishes look, so the gold label for dish appearance rests on a weak reading that other arms also rejected.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a rule note that 精美 applied to plates or dishes is only Food#Appearance when the dishes themselves are described as presented or plated attractively.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.rejected_reason: 加量的是白葡萄酒，不是菜品分量，且没有评价菜品分量
decisions.text: 很正宗的意大利菜，一个正宗的披萨折合人民币50，比广州便宜一半了（不是必胜客那种美式披萨），意粉也很好，下次试试沙拉和饺子～店老板是个意大利人，貌似是爱上了个本地姑娘，然后留下来了～旁边两个老外（估计也是意大利人，就是不明白为什么他们 说会英文说会意文…）也是不停称赞～好想试完这家的东西～我们还点了white wine，由于跟老板说我今天生日，他就免费给我们加了量，然后我了一般就wing了……菜单会有推荐的菜品，非常值得一去再去～见面ciao，要说再见时ciao ciao～哈哈

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The only quantity mention is the free top-up of white wine (加了量), which the rule's 'does not apply' spirit excludes since it is not a dish portion, yet the gold marks Food#Portion, so the gold appears to rest on a loose reading of 加量 that the rulebook does not support and the other six arms also missed it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; alternatively add a rule note that 加量 referring to drinks or free extras is not Food#Portion, or add a case showing when 加量 counts as portion.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review says the owner added portion (加了量) of white wine, which the agent correctly read as not a dish portion, and the rule excludes non-food quantity; the gold label looks inconsistent with the rule and with what the text actually judges, though all six other arms also missed it, pointing to the gold rather than the agent.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that 加量 referring to a drink or free extra does not count as Food#Portion unless it describes dish quantity.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.evidence: 餐具也很精致，还配有蜡烛，纸皮外包装，大气又好看
decisions.text: 很荣幸又再一次被抽中大众点评的霸王餐活动，这次又是一个蛋糕，看到团购价都要159元一个，糕，实在是高。对于榴莲控的我来说当然是选榴莲果肉芝士蛋糕啦。提前一天预约，临时推迟时间也就算了，还给我迟到，好，看在是这么可爱的小美眉送货的份上我就不计较了。这个榴莲果肉芝士蛋糕份量的确是很足的，大概有1.5磅了，芝士蛋糕的部分比较厚实，中间铺满榴莲果肉那层大概有1cm厚，所以对比之下榴莲的份量显得并不算多。仔细品味芝士蛋糕的部分的确是有很香的芝士香味，榴莲果肉也很新鲜，很有很粗的纤维，果然是用果肉来制作的，的确是真材实料。蛋糕上面用巧克力粉描绘出简单的图案，还挺可爱的。餐具也很精致，还配有蜡烛，纸皮外包装，大气又好看。看到出是一间用心做蛋糕的蛋糕店。今次体验感觉不错，值得推荐。

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The review praises tableware, candles and packaging, which are product presentation rather than the venue's decor style, though the rule's wording on 布置 could plausibly cover it.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note that describing tableware or packaging for takeaway/delivery items is not 装修, and add cases of similar delivery-item praise labelled without Ambience#Decoration.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The sentence praises tableware, candles and packaging, which are product presentation rather than the restaurant's decor style or setting; the rule covers 装修 and atmosphere, and the reviewer never discusses the shop's environment.
pass2.fix: Add a boundary note to Ambience#Decoration: tableware, packaging or cake presentation do not count as 装修; only shop décor, style or atmosphere does, and add cases of product-packaging praise labelled without Decoration.

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The rule says 值得 alone and 推荐 without a clear reviewer stance do not count, but the review's closing 值得推荐 is a clear stance, so the rule is applied inconsistently by all arms.
pass1.fix: Clarify in the Food#Recommend rule that an explicit reviewer 推荐 or 值得推荐 at the end of the review is a stance and should be labelled, while 值得 alone is not.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The rule says 值得 alone is usually not labelled and a recommendation must be an explicit 推荐 stance; here 值得推荐 is an explicit endorsement, so the rule is ambiguous about whether it applies to a whole experience versus a dish.
pass2.fix: Clarify in Food#Recommend that an explicit 值得推荐 / 推荐 stance by the reviewer counts even when it refers to the overall experience, and add a case of 值得推荐 labelled positive.

pass1.why: The review says the price is high and the cake is fine on quantity and quality, which implies a value comparison, yet the rule requires explicit value-for-money wording and the gold treats it as value judgement.
pass1.fix: Add a case rule: when the reviewer states a high price and then justifies it with quantity or quality, label Price#Cost_effective.

pass1.why: The lateness concerns cake delivery rather than dish serving, and the rule's scope is dishes, so the gold's extension to delivery timing is debatable.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally state in Service#Timely that delivery lateness for takeaway orders is labelled here.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: 没有评价菜品外观卖相，只描述了肉与酥片分离的状态，属于口感问题
decisions.text: 德克士在宁波时间还是蛮久的，至于味道嘛，也就那样吧。我是在大众有活动的时候买了份立减五元的，原价要40多的手枪鸡腿套餐。那天刚好去看电影，看完电影大概11点了，路上已经没有什么店铺营业了。看到德克士就进去了。吃的是天一乐购那家德克士，手枪鸡腿的确很大只，但是食材不新鲜，完全没有鲜味，而且肉跟外表的酥片是分离的，吃着肉跟骨头也分离了，可想而知放的时间之久远。还有椒盐鸡肉条，口感干涩，又老又没有鸡肉味，而且很硬很咸。勉强中评吧。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The agent never read the Food#Appearance rule, so it treated the 外表的酥片 separation as texture and skipped the appearance check, even though all six arms made the same miss.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step that checks every dish for appearance-related wording, and extend the Appearance rule to cover the coating or outer shape of a dish being intact, separated or broken, with a few such cases.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The review describes meat separating from the crispy coating and bones detaching, which is a texture and freshness issue; the rule's examples (卖相, 摆盘, 颜值) are absent, and the gold label appears to over-read a physical-state description as appearance, though the other arms also missed it, so the gold is debatable.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a rule note that describing a food falling apart or separating is texture (Food#Taste or Food#Texture), not appearance unless the review judges looks.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The agent read the rule and first flagged 很大只 as portion, but its self-check then dropped it as a generic 很大 that does not describe the amount of food, which changed a defensible right answer.
pass1.fix: Narrow the self-check so it does not drop a size adjective when it is applied to a dish or its main ingredient, and add cases where 很大只 or 很大块 on a dish is labelled Portion.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The rule was read and the review says 手枪鸡腿的确很大只, which is a judgment on the chicken leg's size that the other six arms read as portion; the agent's self-check then dropped it, so the agent's reasoning was the error, not the rule, which is weakly applicable here.
pass2.fix: Add a case to the Food#Portion rule showing that '很大只' applied to a single dish item in a set meal is a portion-size judgment, and tell the self-check step not to drop a portion label that was originally supported by a positive size adjective about a menu item.
