pass1.why: The review only quotes the original price of a set meal (原价40多) and gives no high or low evaluation, which the rule says is usually not labelled, so the gold label is debatable and every arm agreed against it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review only states the original price of over 40 yuan without any high or low evaluation, which the rule says is usually not labelled, and all arms including the agent missed it, so the gold conflicts with the rule's own convention.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 虽然一大碗，但是我和老妈喝的一滴不剩
decisions.text: 心里长草大排档许久，每次拿到号看到前面排70多个我就不舍的放弃了，这次依旧到晚了，前面53个，但是真是下定决心再久也要等，必须要吃到，吃货就是这么坚定和执着。排了一个多小时，在门口和服务员聊天，她们建议我以后要么四点半顶门，要么八点多人少时去，最好的方法是拿完号去别处逛，即使过号也没关系，可以顺延三个号。接下来说说菜品，因为是和老妈两个人去的，两个人都是小胃口，就从大众点评上看了看网友们的推荐，『天府泡椒鸡』：这个真心好吃入味儿，甜甜的酱汁配上微辣的口感中和了鸡肉的油腻，很爽口『天王烤鸭包』：最后才上，已经吃的很饱了，所以说实话已经没太多食欲了，但是还是要尝尝，确实肉馅超大皮儿薄有嚼劲儿，里面有一大口油汤，确实和我以前吃的鸭油包不太一样。『金牌煎饺』，老妈想尝尝就点了，但是这个却是很意外滴好吃，一定要点。『美龄粥』这个虽然一大碗，但是我和老妈喝的一滴不剩，豆浆和粥熬制的新鲜口味，很棒。『桂花糕』，老妈一个人吃了三块儿，因为她特别爱吃，口感Q弹又不不失绵软，尝尝吧。『鸭血粉丝煲』这个可能是我个人口感问题，我不喜欢，下次也不会再点了。整体很棒，环境很好，听着苏州评弹，吃着江南小吃，感觉仿佛真的置身那无人打扰闲散惬意滴南方市井生活，价格实惠，不妨亲自体验，一探究竟

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The quote "一大碗" with "一滴不剩" is a quantity judgement that fits the rule's 量大 wording, yet the gold omits it and 6 of 8 arms also left it out, so the gold looks debatable.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous (or add a rule example that a stated large serving with the diner finishing it counts as Food#Portion).

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The phrase 一大碗 describes the portion size but the reviewer is judging only that they finished it, and the rule for Food#Portion requires evaluating quantity, which 一大碗 plus finishing arguably does; six other arms did not label it, so the rule's application to a bare size mention is debatable.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note: a bare size description with a finish/leftover remark counts as portion only when the reviewer evaluates sufficiency; otherwise document as ambiguous and keep the decision flagged for gold review.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 价格实惠，不妨亲自体验
decisions.text: 心里长草大排档许久，每次拿到号看到前面排70多个我就不舍的放弃了，这次依旧到晚了，前面53个，但是真是下定决心再久也要等，必须要吃到，吃货就是这么坚定和执着。排了一个多小时，在门口和服务员聊天，她们建议我以后要么四点半顶门，要么八点多人少时去，最好的方法是拿完号去别处逛，即使过号也没关系，可以顺延三个号。接下来说说菜品，因为是和老妈两个人去的，两个人都是小胃口，就从大众点评上看了看网友们的推荐，『天府泡椒鸡』：这个真心好吃入味儿，甜甜的酱汁配上微辣的口感中和了鸡肉的油腻，很爽口『天王烤鸭包』：最后才上，已经吃的很饱了，所以说实话已经没太多食欲了，但是还是要尝尝，确实肉馅超大皮儿薄有嚼劲儿，里面有一大口油汤，确实和我以前吃的鸭油包不太一样。『金牌煎饺』，老妈想尝尝就点了，但是这个却是很意外滴好吃，一定要点。『美龄粥』这个虽然一大碗，但是我和老妈喝的一滴不剩，豆浆和粥熬制的新鲜口味，很棒。『桂花糕』，老妈一个人吃了三块儿，因为她特别爱吃，口感Q弹又不不失绵软，尝尝吧。『鸭血粉丝煲』这个可能是我个人口感问题，我不喜欢，下次也不会再点了。整体很棒，环境很好，听着苏州评弹，吃着江南小吃，感觉仿佛真的置身那无人打扰闲散惬意滴南方市井生活，价格实惠，不妨亲自体验，一探究竟

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The Cost_effective rule explicitly lists 实惠, and the Price#Level rule also lists 实惠, so the phrase "价格实惠" fits both rules and the gold chose only Level, which makes the boundary unclear.
pass1.fix: Rule edit: state that 实惠 maps to Cost_effective when it compares price with quality or value, and to Price#Level when it only signals a low price; give "价格实惠" as a worked example.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: 实惠 is listed as a Cost_effective trigger, so the agent applied the rule correctly by keyword, yet six other arms made the same call, suggesting the gold omitted it despite the explicit trigger word; the error is consistent across arms and points to the rule and gold rather than the model.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or confirm gold against the rule's listed trigger 实惠 and add a case showing 价格实惠 labels Cost_effective.

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The waiters' advice on when to visit is an interaction with service staff that a careful labeller could count as hospitality, but the gold omits it and only 3 of 9 arms labelled it, so the gold is debatable.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a boundary note that advice given to the diner by staff is not a hospitality judgement unless it is praised or criticised.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The staff chat and their suggestions about queue timing describe advice rather than an evaluation of staff attitude, and only half the arms labelled it, so the gold reading as not hospitality is defensible.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note: advice or conversation with staff counts as hospitality only when the reviewer evaluates their attitude (warm, helpful, rude); add cases of neutral staff interaction labelled as not hospitality.

pass1.label: Service#Timely
pass1.why: The rule for Service#Timely excludes plain descriptions of dish order without a speed judgement, but the agent never read that rule and labelled the sentence about being served last as timeliness.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: when a review mentions 上菜, the flow must read the Service#Timely Does-not-apply clause before labelling, and check for an explicit speed word.

pass2.label: Service#Timely
pass2.why: The rule says 上菜 alone without a speed judgment does not count, and the reviewer only states the dish came last, which is a sequence description, but the agent read 最后才上 as slowness without the rule being read.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to read the Timely rule's 'does not apply' clause before labelling any dish-timing phrase, and add a case where 最后才上 with no speed judgment is not labelled.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: 价格实惠 is value-for-money, covered by Cost_effective; the review does not discuss whether the price is high or low.

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The agent considered Price#Level and rejected it, but it had not read the rule, which lists 实惠 as a Price#Level trigger (82%), so the flow skipped a rule it needed.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: whenever 实惠, 性价比 or 划算 appears, the flow must read the Price#Level rule and apply both labels when the price level is also judged.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review never judges whether the price is high or low, only value-for-money, and the rule says 性价比 alone is Cost_effective; the gold's Price#Level seems to rest on 实惠 being listed under Level too, which conflicts with the Cost_effective-only reading.
pass2.fix: Rule edit: state explicitly whether 实惠 alone triggers Price#Level or only Cost_effective, and add cases to settle it so gold and rule agree.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.evidence: 本来看到一个很便宜的小份团购
decisions.text: 忽然去泰安玩，搜到这个店，济南万达还没有，很有兴趣尝尝。本来看到一个很便宜的小份团购，耽搁了一会儿竟然下架了。某团套餐也不错，我们可是排了34桌才等到啊！万达新开各种促销，外头虽然人头攒动，店里还蛮安静的，小煲中辣完全不辣的，里头螃蟹也不少呢，大夹子也有肉。年糕豆皮玉米豆腐都好吃，还有海量的鸡爪子。酱汁味道咸甜口，光是蘸饼就很好吃。小凉菜清爽，辣藕符合我的口味，当时吃不下了，打包后更加入味晚上全吃光。

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The self-check added this label after the first pass, and the item judges only a group-deal price that was already delisted, not the restaurant's overall price level, so the self-check overturned a defensible first answer.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: the self-check may only add a label when a rule's trigger is clearly present in the text, and it must not add Price#Level from a single deal or set-menu price; add a case where a cheap group-deal mention is not a price-level judgement.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The phrase 本来看到一个很便宜的小份团购 is a Discount-type mention (团购) with a cheapness remark, and the rule's boundary says a 团购 price with an evaluation of cheap adds Price#Level, but the review's judgement concerns a group-buy that was then delisted, so the cheapness is only background and the rule's 'only a menu price with no level judgement' exclusion is ambiguous here.
pass2.fix: Add a rule edit to Price#Level stating that a cheapness adjective attached to a group-buy or small-portion offer counts only when the reviewer judges the restaurant's overall price level, otherwise label Price#Discount alone; add a few cases of this pattern to the library.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.rejected_reason: 「济南万达还没有」和「万达新开各种促销」说的是万达商场及其他分店，不是这家店位于商圈之中。
decisions.text: 忽然去泰安玩，搜到这个店，济南万达还没有，很有兴趣尝尝。本来看到一个很便宜的小份团购，耽搁了一会儿竟然下架了。某团套餐也不错，我们可是排了34桌才等到啊！万达新开各种促销，外头虽然人头攒动，店里还蛮安静的，小煲中辣完全不辣的，里头螃蟹也不少呢，大夹子也有肉。年糕豆皮玉米豆腐都好吃，还有海量的鸡爪子。酱汁味道咸甜口，光是蘸饼就很好吃。小凉菜清爽，辣藕符合我的口味，当时吃不下了，打包后更加入味晚上全吃光。

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: All six arms rejected the label while reading the rule, because the rule does not say whether a review that places the restaurant in the crowd and promotions of a nearby mall ('外头人头攒动', '万达新开各种促销') implies the restaurant sits beside that mall, so the implicit adjacency went unlabelled.
pass1.fix: Rule edit: add to Location#Downtown that a review describing the restaurant's surroundings as a mall's crowds or promotions counts as beside the mall, with this review as an example.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown
pass2.why: The review mentions 万达 only as the chain's other branch and a promotion there, which the rule's 'in or beside a mall' test does not directly cover, but the gold reads the 万达 mentions as placing this restaurant downtown; every arm missed it, so the gold is debatable against the rule's wording.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and clarify in the Location#Downtown rule whether mentions of a nearby or same-brand mall branch imply the restaurant's own location.

decisions.label: Ambience#Space
decisions.evidence: 两个人坐那么大的一个圆桌，刷肉很不方便啊，桌子太大了，够不到啊
decisions.text: 总体来说还是不错的，就是有个别问题。第一，现在海底捞举办玩游戏赢代金卷活动。但是代金卷要次日生效，当时不能用这个代金卷，而且有效期就一个月。必须在本店使用。非常的又局限性，感觉不是太好。第二，等位时间较长，众所周知，海底捞等位时间长，但是等位过程中的服务是否可以跟上，其他店都还不错，但是个人感觉王府井店一般，等位坐在小桌那，没有人给送吃的，好不容易有瓶凉茶，最后还给拿走了。什么都要自己去前面拿，对于一个人先来排队的，非常的不方便。第三，我们两个人竟然安排到大桌，两个人坐那么大的一个圆桌，刷肉很不方便啊，桌子太大了，够不到啊！而且服务生一直在服务旁边的大桌，对于我们两人基本上都不怎么搭理，这点让人很不舒服。第四，前台的水果有一部分都烂了，觉得不是太好！随便吃吃180元。全都是点的半份。

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The review complains about a large round table being too big to reach for grilling meat, which is about table size and seating, and the rule explicitly lists 桌子挤 and 桌子太大-type space issues as Ambience#Space, so the label is arguably correct and the gold omission is the questionable part.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case clarifying that table-size complaints tied to usability count as Ambience#Space, or that they should be excluded when they concern seating assignment only.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The review complains that a two-person table was a huge round table that made hot-pot tending awkward, which is about table size and seating space, so the rule's '桌子太大' example arguably fits; but all six arms flagged it, suggesting the gold omitted a valid space judgment rather than the model misreading.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a note that table-size complaints in hot-pot reviews count as Ambience#Space.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.evidence: 代金卷要次日生效，当时不能用这个代金卷，而且有效期就一个月。必须在本店使用。非常的又局限性，感觉不是太好

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The review criticises a 代金券 activity with restrictions (next-day validity, one-month expiry, in-store only), and the rule lists 券 and 活动 as Price#Discount triggers, so the agent's label follows the rule's wording while the gold omits it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a rule note that evaluating a coupon's restrictions still counts as Price#Discount since the coupon is the discount being judged.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The review criticises a voucher's validity terms, which is a discount-related judgment, yet the gold omits it; the rule says 券 and 活动 apply, so the gold looks inconsistent with the rule, and the rule text itself does not settle whether negative remarks on promotion terms count.
pass2.fix: Add a rule clarification that negative judgments of coupon or promotion terms (validity, usage limits) still take Price#Discount, and add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: 未单独评价外观

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The review mentions rotten fruit at the buffet, which is a freshness/quality complaint; the rule says 新鲜 alone does not trigger Food#Appearance, and the gold seems to read rotten appearance as visual, a debatable reading.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a rule note that visible spoilage (烂、发黑) is a freshness issue, not appearance, unless the text describes look or presentation.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The gold marks negative appearance from a remark that some fruit had rotted, but rotten fruit is about freshness, and the rule explicitly says freshness alone does not count as appearance, so the gold conflicts with the dataset's own convention.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; or have labellers confirm that rotten or spoiled produce is freshness, not appearance, and correct the gold.

pass1.fix: Add a prompt step that checks store names and address mentions for commercial-district names (e.g. 王府井, 广场, 商场) against the Location#Downtown rule.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown

pass2.fix: none: correct the gold by removing Location#Downtown unless a mention of a mall or district exists in the source review.

decisions.text:
感谢DP！！让我有幸参加了这次十分难得的百人VIP聚餐大会。这次聚会地点在宝体附近的「味道顺德」，距离地铁站宝体站十分近，步行大概两三分钟就到了。可能一开始你会找不到它的招牌，因为这商厦的招牌实在太多，但是你看见M记图标的话就可以一个看见咖啡色底色的招牌了！！这家店，真的是从顺德开过来的，可切换佛山位置就能查到好多分店了！
「环境」
挺具有岭南风味的装饰，上了二楼有一个海鲜挑选区域。左手边就是大堂，右边就是包厢，大堂靠窗户的地方也有两个开放式的包厢位置，我觉得这靠窗的位置不错！大堂位置空间布局舒适，没有很拥挤的感觉。
下面说说吃的啦！！！
「养生保健益肾汤」
料好足！里头有核桃，花生，莲子，红枣，我是第一次用核桃煮的汤，没想到它吃起来口感是那么地像花生，整个汤的味道不会很咸，无味精味，挺甜的。好喝！
「爽滑无骨鱼片」
在吃这个之前，店家会先煮一锅姜丝水，待到水开沸腾一段时间后，服务员就会把鱼片倒在锅里，稍微涮几秒即可，然后沾下酱油姜丝酱料，风味佳，鱼肉无腥味，挺鲜的。
「凉拌鱼皮」
鱼皮挺鲜，挺爽口的，餐前来几口，很开胃。
「鱼肠煎蛋」
这个要趁热吃哦！因为感觉冷却的蛋饼会有略微鱼腥味，可是鱼肠吃起来挺爽口挺脆的。
「特色火焰鹅」
这是个上桌还要继续加热的干锅鹅，很入味！很香！鹅肉很有劲道。
「水牛奶蛋挞」
顺德是个可以把“牛奶”玩得非常666的地方，所以这个牛奶蛋挞也不例外，味道不错，蛋挞表皮十分酥脆！嗜甜者可一试。

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The agent never read the Ambience#Noise rule, so it missed the dataset convention that a section headed 环境 with no specific aspect is a general evaluation that also tags Noise, Sanitary, Space and Decoration.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: before finalising any Ambience label, read every Ambience rule's Boundary section, and when a review has a general 环境 heading or sentence, apply the four-label general-environment convention.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: All six arms missed it and never read the rule. The review has an "环境" section, but it only evaluates decoration and space specifically, so the rule's generic-evaluation trigger is at best a stretch, and the gold applies the four-label convention to a non-generic review.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule example stating whether a "环境" section heading with only specific sub-aspects triggers the four-label generic convention.

  位置：渝北鲁能新城五街区，位置还是很好找的，加麦名字是总部的，世纪这家店名是木偶森林！
  环境：店里面还是不错的，收拾的很干净，有专门做饮料的地方，跟做蛋糕的位置！外面的休闲地方也有几个桌椅，点一杯饮料一块蛋糕，可以静静坐一下午，主要是比较安静，绿化比较多！

pass2.label: Location#Downtown

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous (gold relies on a development name without any stated mall, plaza or commercial-district wording; add a case where a named residential/commercial complex alone is labelled or not labelled).

pass1.why: The review gives a concrete spend (3人吃了1000多) with a clearly negative reaction, which the rule covers, but the rule requires an explicit high/low evaluation and the judgement here is only implicit, so every arm missed it and the rule does not settle this case.
pass1.fix: Rule edit: state that a concrete spend figure followed by a complaint about the bill or value counts as a negative price-level judgement, and add cases of this implicit pattern to the case library.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review states a total spend (3人1000多) and then gives a negative judgment of the bill and value, but the rule's 'does not apply' clause for bare amounts conflicts with the gold, and the agent followed the boundary note that the value judgment belongs to Cost_effective alone, so the rule is unclear on whether a total spend plus a negative reaction counts as price level.
pass2.fix: Clarify in Price#Level that a stated spend (e.g. 人均/总共多少钱) accompanied by any negative or positive reaction to the amount is labelled Price#Level, even when Cost_effective also applies.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.rejected_reason: 没有提到折扣优惠
decisions.text: 拖了这么久才来写点评，诶，感谢大众让我替补成功，而且离得也近，没有跟专车自行公交车去的，很方便。现场去了100个V左右，气氛还是相当不错的，每一个人都在舅舅的住持下一一自我介绍了，认识了不少传说中的大神。再说服务态度，服务很不错，每桌都有一个人专门服务，经理也很热情，每桌的队长都记住了再说菜品，印象最深的是爽滑无骨鱼片，很滑，蘸着浆料吃很入味，服务员提供了几次，这个吃了最多，比较推荐；养生保健益肾汤也还不错，反正那种养身的，上汤生菜浸鲮鱼球这个就真不是我的菜了，顺德炸牛奶拼野鸡卷这个不错，吃了很多，特色火焰鹅还算入味，水牛奶蛋挞  65元这个味道很赞，可惜一人只有一个可以吃，鱼肠煎蛋  菜粒鱼肉茸粥，粥不错，13斤水库大鱼这个鱼没有之前的爽鱼润，餐前小食大良硼砂，之前的开胃菜还行，总之整体式是比较清淡的，环境不错，服务很热情，氛围也好，停车位也很充足，交通也好，店位置突出

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The review describes a Dianping 替补 (substitute) seat at a free event, which the rule lists under 大众点评的霸王餐、免费试吃, but the agent never read that rule and rejected the label because no explicit discount was named.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step that checks each candidate label's 'Applies when' list against the review, especially for free or event-based wording such as 霸王餐, 免费试吃, 替补 or 活动, before rejecting a label for lacking an explicit discount term.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The review says 大众点评 gave the author a free meal slot via 替补/霸王餐-style sponsorship ('感谢大众让我替补成功'), which the rule lists as applicable, yet the agent rejected it as no discount mentioned; all six arms made the same miss, pointing to the gold reading an event-based free meal as a discount rather than a model error.
pass2.fix: Add a worked example to the Price#Discount rule stating that 大众点评 free-meal or 霸王餐 events count as discount, and clarify whether a free event seat (not a price cut) is in scope, so the agent does not reject it as 'no discount mentioned'.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.rejected_reason: 未提及折扣优惠力度
decisions.text: 招行9积分加59兑换的蕉香风铃1磅的，这是第一次吃蜜时，之前把同类的积慕和微梦都尝过。很喜欢这种远程订购送货上门的模式，蛋糕够新鲜，服务感受也挺好。先说外形，看照片，个人不是很喜欢蛋糕盒子，质感不是特别好，刀是不锈钢，但叉子是塑料，这点不如积慕微梦，但是送的蜡烛很棒，造型感十足。蛋糕很素雅，买给妈妈过生日的，挺合适。再说说口味，香蕉味浓郁，就是个人感觉偏甜了些，蛋糕胚一层层，口感够绵密，整体的口味还是很有层次感的。最后说说服务，首先，送货小哥是很棒的，来之前先电话确认，送上门的时候礼貌热情。可是电话客服就不那么让人满意了，打了好几个都没接通，接通了客服各种抢话，好像巴不得赶紧挂掉。以上，就是这次的感受，希望蜜时越做越好吧！

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The agent never read the Price#Discount rule, so it rejected the label because the review does not mention a discount, even though the item says the cake was bought by redeeming points plus 59 yuan (a promotional deal, which the rule's 优惠/活动/赠送 triggers cover). Every other arm also missed it, which suggests the rule's trigger list does not clearly name points-redemption deals.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: before rejecting a label, check each rule's trigger list (优惠, 活动, 赠送, 券) against the review text. Rule edit: add 积分兑换 and 积分加钱购 as examples under Applies when, with a case like this one.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The agent rejected Price#Discount as 'no discount mentioned' without reading its rule, which lists 优惠 and 赠送 as triggers. The review's 积分加59兑换 is a points-plus-cash redemption deal, which is a promotional offer. The agent's flow let it skip a rule it needed.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: before rejecting any label, the agent must read that label's rule card and check its trigger words (优惠, 赠送, 券, 活动, 兑换). Add 积分兑换/积分加钱兑换 to the Price#Discount trigger list and add a worked example of this case.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 三千多块的房费，比不上火车站旁的民宿通铺
decisions.text:
提前一周预定，想来这里带孩子吃住玩，被告知只有静园可住，是个有三个卧室的别墅，榻榻米，想看房间图片被拒绝，不过看了点评的评论，觉得这里既然那么的高大上，应该不会有问题。于是组织孩子在幼儿园的小伙伴一共三家周末开赴这里。
位置还不算难找，但到了门口，足足憋了我们五分钟不让进，因为门卫手里的预约名单中没有我们，我赶紧出示与销售的微信聊天记录，并告知我们已经交了1000元定金，这才被放进去。这让我隐约感觉到本次游玩可能不会那么顺利。
进入里面，环境还是不错的，很大的草坪，有许多人看上去都是公司来这里组织活动的样子。
到了位于超市的服务台，交了住宿的费用，被告知3点才能入住，一看时间还有半小时，于是我们就在草坪上边玩边等
到了3点，在工作人员的带领下，我们又折回了门口的位置，原来就是门口左手的那个屋子，说实话，刚来的时候扫了一眼那个屋子以为是公用厕所。原来这个小木屋就是所谓的静园别墅。使用面积大约不到30平，一进门，对着小小卫生间，然后左边两个隔断，两张大床，右边一张大床，所有房间并排排列，没有门，没有家具，没有电视，中间只有一个木板隔开。这环境瞬间让我们愕然，这确实可以挤下6个大人和3个孩子，但落差真的太大，三千多块的房费，比不上火车站旁的民宿通铺。况且带了孩子，而且三家人也没有那么熟悉到可以睡觉不用门。
于是我们赶紧去找工作人员，换房间肯定是不可能了，只好试问可不可以退掉，还好，老板同意了。退款期间，一直在超市前台，可以看出来这里的问题，销售各自预约各自的，居然一个房间预约给了多人（这可能也是我们可以退掉房间的原因）
我们把情况和房间图片告诉了正在路上的第三家家庭，人家毅然决定返程，我们组织的活动就这样搞黄了，本来想给1星的，但想了想，草坪不错，老板还给退了房，又值一星吧，但一个美好的周末给弄成这样，心里也真是挺生气的。
这里没有吃饭，所以不能乱评论，但如果你是想有点儿品质的来这里住宿，特别是带了孩子，几家又没有特别的熟悉，一定不要选择静园。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review says 3000+ yuan is far too high versus a hostel dorm, which compares price against quality and so fits the value-for-money rule, but the reviewer is really expressing a sense of being overcharged; the rule's 'does not apply' clause for bare cost judgements is arguably triggered, and all six arms made the same call, pointing to a rule/gold question rather than a single model slip.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note: a price-versus-quality comparison that concludes the product is overpriced for what it delivers (e.g. 比不上, 落差大) is labelled as Price#Cost_effective negatively; add two or three such cases to the library so the boundary is explicit.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The reviewer compares the room price to a dorm-style bunk in a station hostel, which is a value-for-money judgement and matches the rule's '比' comparison, but the gold omits it; the gold appears to treat this as a complaint about the room rather than a cost-performance verdict, and all six arms made the same call.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a note that price-versus-quality comparisons of a poor product count as Cost_effective, with this review as a reference case.

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The agent read the rule and considered the staff interactions (the gatekeeper's list check, the boss agreeing to refund) but the self-check dropped it as merely factual; the rule's own trigger list includes 老板 and 态度-type evaluation, and the reviewer's complaint about being held at the gate for five minutes and the disorganised booking handling is a judgement of how staff treated them, so the self-check wrongly overrode a right label.
pass1.fix: Add to the prompt's self-check: do not remove a service label when the reviewer narrates staff conduct toward them with negative or grudging framing (e.g. being held outside, refund only after negotiation); keep it unless the mention is purely logistical with no evaluative wording.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The review contains no explicit evaluation of staff attitude; the staff actions described (checking the list, refunding after the reviewer pressed the issue) are factual, so the self-check dropped the label, which the gold keeps; four arms missed it and six did not, so the gold seems to read the staff handling of the complaint as hospitality.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule that a staff-handled complaint or refund that is narrated with an evaluative tone (e.g. '老板还给退了房') counts as Hospitality, with more cases of this kind.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: 只说总价68元，没有评价价格高低
decisions.text: 新开的一家店，位置不难找，从珠江路和进香河路交叉路口往北走一小段就看到了。比较中规中矩的和风装饰，移门、长灯笼、和风餐具这些元素都有的，光线也是偏暗的那种，总体环境不错~点了#刺身拼盘，三文鱼+北极贝+甜虾各两块，甜虾口感软软糯糯的，三文鱼最好吃，切片挺厚，总价68元还可以吧；#昭和卷# 可以点半份，这点很贴心，这个卷卷也是比较推荐的，最上面撒了一层细长的油炸丝，然后是一小块三文鱼，米饭里面还加入了一种吃起来比较像薯片的碎屑，口感软硬搭配，好吃；#寿喜锅# 份量也不少，青菜+胡萝卜+玉米+肥牛卷+豆腐+魔芋块+乌冬面，够丰富吧，搭配生鸡蛋一起吃鲜甜十足；这次尝鲜还点了一份纳豆沙拉，小小一盘，里面混有少量三文鱼、甜虾，纳豆应该比较正宗吧，夹起来会有长长的拉丝，但是入口偏苦，不是很习惯，不过想到网上传纳豆怎么怎么健康的说法，再本着不浪费的精神，还是基本上全吃掉了，我真是个好孩子，哈哈~对啦，申请他们家大众点评的会员，可以打九折，有时候回避满百减15划算哦，而且会送一小碟抹茶布丁，味道还是不错的

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review only states a dish total of 68元 with a mild "还可以吧" and no explicit high/low price judgement, which the rule says is normally not labelled, yet the gold label includes it and the case library shows this label is common (about half of cases), so the gold may follow a looser convention than the rule text.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a boundary example clarifying that a mild acceptability judgement on a stated total (如“还可以”“总价…还可以”) counts as price level, and add more such cases.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review only states a dish total of 68元 with a mild "还可以吧" and never judges price as high or low, which matches the rule's exclusion for bare menu amounts; yet the gold includes Price#Level, and the rulebook's Price#Level section is silent on whether a mild "还可以" about a stated amount counts as a level judgment.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a rule note that a stated amount with an explicit mild value judgment (e.g. "还可以"/"还行") counts as Price#Level, and add cases of this kind so labellers agree.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 如果按代金券来消费的话就会相对划算很多的
decisions.text:
2号唐厨位于猎德高德美居，可以搭乘地铁5号线至猎德站，从A出口步行大概3分钟左右可以达到，店铺招牌大大地挂在高德美居外墙上，十分的清晰，所以不难找到的，交通的话地铁能够达到的也还算是便捷了...
2号唐厨店内装修可谓是相当的高大上，还有水晶大吊灯、红地毯，而且整个大厅都没有柱子相当的开阔，用以举办婚宴是很不错的场地哦~总的来说中国风感觉很重，把投影幕收起之后还有一张龙椅放在那呢~~
这次还是我第一次到店消费的，整体环境和服务都是很不错的，我们是团购了代金券消费的，主要是喝夜茶为主，不过这边9点半就关门的了，所以要主要时间不能太晚~可能由于周中的关系吧，基本是不需要等位，当入座率也有95%的了！这边点心的价格算是中等偏上吧，如果按代金券来消费的话就会相对划算很多的...
喝茶来说，这边点心的品种还是蛮多的，我还发现有猪杂粥以及凉菜可以点，这个是很多餐厅没有的点~食物的摆盘是相当的精致，不过分量就一般，很多都是以3块点心为主的！虾饺几乎是每次喝茶必点的，味道不错也很弹牙，不过相比于点都德就小个很多；排骨拼凤爪，凤爪的味道调配得不好，分量也不多；蘑菇包的馅是冬菇，挺特别的，味道也挺好~不得不提的是【不是小笼包】，它的卖相很是小笼包，她是椰汁糕来的，挺新奇好玩的
总的来说，用团购的代金券来消费的话还是很不错的，无论是环境、服务还是出品都是挺不错的，如果是原价的话就相对贵一些了~

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The rule lists 划算 as a cost-effectiveness trigger, so the agent's reading is defensible, yet the review's "相对划算" is tied to the voucher discount rather than a value-for-money comparison, and the gold omits it, so the rule does not separate discount-driven savings from value judgments.
pass1.fix: Add a boundary note to Price#Cost_effective: 划算 or 便宜 that come only from a voucher, coupon or 团购 discount are labelled Price#Discount, not Price#Cost_effective, unless the reviewer compares quality against price; add 2-3 such cases.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says that using the voucher makes it "相对划算很多", which is a value judgement matching the rule's 划算 trigger, so the gold omission looks inconsistent with the dataset's own convention and the agent's label is defensible.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a gold-check note that 划算 with a voucher/discount counts as Cost_effective.

2号唐厨位于猎德高德美居，可以搭乘地铁5号线至猎德站，从A出口步行大概3分钟左右可以达到，店铺招牌大大地挂在高德美居外墙上，十分的清晰，所以不难找到的，交通的话地铁能够达到的也还算是便捷了...
2号唐厨店内装修可谓是相当的高大上，还有水晶大吊灯、红地毯，而且整个大厅都没有柱子相当的开阔，用以举办婚宴是很不错的场地哦~总的来说中国风感觉很重，把投影幕收起之后还有一张龙椅放在那呢~~
这次还是我第一次到店消费的，整体环境和服务都是很不错的，我们是团购了代金券消费的，主要是喝夜茶为主，不过这边9点半就关门的了，所以要主要时间不能太晚~可能由于周中的关系吧，基本是不需要等位，当入座率也有95%的了！这边点心的价格算是中等偏上吧，如果按代金券来消费的话就会相对划算很多的...
喝茶来说，这边点心的品种还是蛮多的，我还发现有猪杂粥以及凉菜可以点，这个是很多餐厅没有的点~食物的摆盘是相当的精致，不过分量就一般，很多都是以3块点心为主的！虾饺几乎是每次喝茶必点的，味道不错也很弹牙，不过相比于点都德就小个很多；排骨拼凤爪，凤爪的味道调配得不好，分量也不多；蘑菇包的馅是冬菇，挺特别的，味道也挺好~不得不提的是【不是小笼包】，它的卖相很是小笼包，她是椰汁糕来的，挺新奇好玩的
总的来说，用团购的代金券来消费的话还是很不错的，无论是环境、服务还是出品都是挺不错的，如果是原价的话就相对贵一些了~

decisions.label: Ambience#Sanitary
decisions.rejected_reason: “干净”紧跟在龙虾评价后，针对菜品，不是店里卫生状况，证据不足
decisions.text: 昨晚去富达路店发现已经放假了，看了门上的通知说富达路冬季放假，明年夏天龙虾季再营业，看着通知上的地址来了周姑娘家分店新城河路店，才发现新城河路环境比富达路店大好多，服务员也好热情，生意非常好，菜品比富达路店多好多，刚好赶上大闸蟹也刚上市，吃了招牌黄焖大闸蟹，以为这个季节的蟹黄少还小，居然大大出乎我们的意料！整整10个，服务员说都是2两5的！同事们都赞不绝口！点了3份龙虾，估计龙虾快接近尾声了，除了稍微小点，味道一如既往的好吃，干净！我们同事说她一个夏天就只吃周姑娘家的龙虾，因为他们家龙虾每天都不够卖，有时候夜里来就吃不到了！听服务员说马上羊蝎子火锅和羊汤也要出来了！一定会来的！！！昨天没有见到老板娘，难道老板娘又回上海给空姐上课去了，对了，周姑娘是上海航空公司给空姐培训的老师，一直以为周姑娘是空姐，看了姑娘微博认证才知道原来是空姐的老师，客舱教员难怪服务员都很热情客气！周姑娘好励志的！

decisions.label: Ambience#Noise
decisions.evidence: 不一样的环境
decisions.text: 昨晚在闽江路192号烤够味吃的烧烤，不一样的烧烤，不一样的感觉，不一样的环境，够味烤够味！地点：在闽江路上192号，我从博物馆方向过来坐的8路公交在松雷中学下的车（事后觉得高德地图会不会搞错，在终点闽江路下车会不会比这个好，就差一站）约好18:00活动，下车就17:55分一路小跑，看路牌，应该过道右手边是双号差不多五分钟就走到啦。还挺好找的。到地儿对于吃货的我免不了一顿狂拍，门脸牌匾还蒙着红布，烤够味映入眼帘，进门突然感觉好明亮，有点儿灯火通明的感觉，首先感觉不太像大多数烧烤店的感觉，怎么不一样领导一语中的，说有木有肯德基的感觉，的确是有点儿，呵呵，老板好年轻啊，我们一桌十个人，坐在靠窗靠门口的地方，挺长的桌子，大家一起很热闹，我稍迟到一点点，大家就差一位美女姗姗来迟，都坐在那里，我一直以为对面的座位是个长椅子，后来看自己座的就明白啦，大家其乐融融畅所欲言，首先那个老板介绍的这是一家中式烧烤店，牌匾写着关注中式烧烤20年，吃这么久都不知道烧烤有区分，现在试营业阶段五折，周一到周五，特色和海鲜包豆芽，领导说那个海鲜包豆芽汤都很够味，本着这个口号吃就吃好的烤就烤够味进入主题，首先上桌的是涮毛肚，这里头除毛肚还有木耳、干豆腐卷等，但是，服务员亲自下料做毛肚，全程你尽收眼底制作过程，我吃过的烧烤很多，谁敢酱紫当你面透明式的做法，烤够味独一家，很干净，首先盐包调料进锅，然后酱包，随后倒水，然后那个炉具太独特啦，开火蓝色火苗好漂亮，安全无毒无异味儿，在做的过程中，又陆续上来肉串肉筋和鸡头、炒饭、凉菜等等，饮品红茶、紫薯汁儿自家独创，太好喝啦，是特色的确相当够味儿超赞，烤品主推特色，有一道菜就是前面说的海鲜包豆芽也是本店特色之一，的确不错，黄蚬子等被豆芽包着，汤汁儿的确如领导所说味道不错哦，蚬子相当干净还大没有砂子，过瘾，然后据说是茄子炒饭我个人觉得味道超赞，很好吃，反正太多的惊喜你真的是应接不暇，当然涮肚很快就好啦，吃的很够味，汤料独特，辣的有味道，超赞，没来得及一一仔细品尝，还想下回仔细品尝，谢谢老板热心招待！加油哦！

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The phrase 不一样的环境 is a vague general remark, and the self-check added Ambience#Noise even though the rule was never read; the boundary rule would only apply to the general 环境 wording if the review then sets the label set, and the review gives no sound-level evidence.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt step: before labelling Noise from a generic 环境 remark, verify the review mentions noise, quietness or crowd sound; make the self-check unable to add labels without a quoted sound-related cue.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: The phrase 不一样的环境 is a vague general remark with no mention of noise, and the rule only applies to explicit noise words or the general-environment convention, which the agent did not read; the self-check added it without support.
pass2.fix: Add a self-check guard: only keep Ambience#Noise when the text contains a noise descriptor (安静/吵/嘈杂/人声等) or a stated general-environment evaluation with the rule read; state in the prompt that self-check must not add labels lacking quoted evidence.

pass1.label: Service#Timely
pass1.why: Five of six arms also labelled 涮肚很快就好啦 as speed, so the rule's 出餐快 and 很快就上齐了 examples look like they fit this sentence, yet it describes cooking the dish at the table while the timing is a judgment on the kitchen's speed; the rulebook does not say whether tableside cooking speed counts.
pass1.fix: Clarify in the Timely rule that a quick remark about a dish's prep time counts only when it concerns the restaurant's serving of ordered dishes, with examples like 涮肚很快就好啦 labelled as negative-control or positive case explicitly, and add a few such cases.

pass2.label: Service#Timely
pass2.why: The text says 当然涮肚很快就好啦, which is a speed comment about the dish being ready quickly and matches the rule's 出餐快 and 上菜快 cases, yet five arms rejected it; the gold omits it, so the gold and rule seem to conflict on a quick-serve remark.
pass2.fix: Add a rule clarification with examples such as 很快就好了 or 很快就做好 counting as 上菜速度, then add a few similar cases to the library so labellers apply it consistently.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 最后吃的非常饱
decisions.text:
不知道是不是因为上了人气美食所以人气爆棚，以前都没什么人排队的，去的礼拜天等了一个多小时。下次再去要提前预约了，日式烤肉吃的比较少，会和韩式烤肉和普通烧烤做比较。
男朋友想吃肉，就选了358的套餐，再加了一块钱的盐烤牛舌，最后吃的非常饱。
最惊艳我们的是雪花牛肉粒，如果不是套餐的话要128，10块小肉左右。第一次不太会烤，没有熟，后来店长还经常过来帮我们翻和看熟度。差不多烤十多分钟就可以了，久一点的话外面皮是焦硬的口感，一口咬下去会爆汁出来，而且里面的肉很嫩，不会因为烤的时间就老掉。如果时间短一点，外面和里面的肉都会很嫩，并且带有弹性，吃过了之后真是不想吃其他肉了。
第二个比较推荐的是猪颈肉和牛肋条，韩式和普通烧烤里很少有这种没有腌制过得烤肉，而且猪颈肉切得很大块，不会怕烤老了，时间久点反而更香，更有嚼劲。
第三推荐的是乌冬面，咸辣适中，虽然面有点软，但汤的整体口感很鲜，牛肉也炖的很到位，在吃饱的前提下我们解决了整整一大碗面。
最后说下没那么好吃的，一元送的牛舌不好吃，又老又有点牛腥气。后来店长和我们说是因为配合节目搞活动，成本太高肯定和原价买的有些区别，我觉得虽然便宜但是占了胃的容量，吃不了其他好吃的食材了有点可惜。最后经典肥牛也没吃完，不管是烤的时间久还是时间短都老的不行，咬不动。

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review says 吃的非常饱 after a set meal, which is a fullness report and arguably about the whole meal rather than the dish portion size; the Portion rule's 吃不饱 wording is about dish quantity, so the gold omission is defensible and the rule does not clearly cover satiety from a set menu.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that 吃饱/吃撑 describing a set meal without judging dish quantity does not count as Food#Portion.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review says "最后吃的非常饱" after a set meal, which describes being full rather than judging the dish quantity; the Portion rule's positive cues (分量, 量大, 量足) are absent, and the gold omits it, so the agent over-read satiety as portion judgement, though the other arms split on this too.
pass2.fix: Add a rule edge case: '吃饱了/吃的很饱' describing the diner's state without evaluating dish quantity does not apply; add a few such cases to the case library.

pass1.label: Service#Queue
pass1.why: The rule explicitly covers 等了 about waiting for a seat (排队/等位), and '去的礼拜天等了一个多小时' with the preceding sentence about queues and reservations is a seat wait, so the agent applied the rule correctly; the gold omitted it, which conflicts with the dataset's own convention that waiting for a table is Service#Queue (all six other arms also labelled it).
pass1.fix: none: the gold looks incomplete; flag the item for relabelling to include Service#Queue, and add a case to the library showing '等了一个多小时' about the line at the door as Service#Queue.

pass2.label: Service#Queue
pass2.why: The rule says 排队 applies when waiting for a table, and this review says the diner waited over an hour on Sunday, which seems to fit; but the gold omits it and all six other arms also labelled it, so the gold conflicts with the rule's own wording and the dataset convention is unclear.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or clarify in the Queue rule whether a stated multi-hour wait with a reservation recommendation counts as a queue judgement when the reviewer does not judge acceptability.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.evidence: 这么实惠的海鲜店就在世贸大厦侧面
decisions.text:
最近网络上疯狂流行一种吃海鲜的土豪方法，堆一桌子的海鲜狂吃狂吃狂吃，一桌子的海鲜深深的勾起了我的馋虫，亲小伙伴向我推荐了本店，价格便宜到没朋友，而且超级新鲜，据店家介绍店里的海鲜都是自家渔船出海打的，不过弊端就是运气不好你可能吃不到某样东西。这么实惠的海鲜店就在世贸大厦侧面，原当天阳二部，以后外地同学朋友来再也不用担心请吃海鲜没地方去了。
  环境干净简洁，没有那么浮夸不像有些店装修那么豪华，却忽略了菜品本身。墙上有各种海鲜的小玩偶，处处昭示这是一家吃海鲜的店。服务员服务大方得体，让人很舒适，而且有小鲜肉哦。

pass1.fix: Add a rule note: '划算/性价比好' alone labels Cost_effective only; add Price#Level only when the text says price is high or low (贵, 便宜, 实惠, 价格). Add a few cases where 划算 appears without 贵/便宜 to show the intended boundary.

pass2.label: Price#Level

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that 划算 plus a stated total spend in a value comment may count as a price-level judgment when the review states the amount.

pass1.why: The review says 拿号 and describes waiting at the door, but says nothing about how long the wait was or whether it was acceptable; the rule requires judging whether the wait is acceptable, so the gold is debatable, and the phrase 拿号 alone was a weak cue (training precision 0.735) that four arms followed.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.rejected_reason: Only says the storefront looks old; not a decoration judgment.
decisions.text:
有幸抽中这次霸王餐哦，哈尔滨水饺店，除了水饺还有东北菜哦，南昌东北菜店不多吧，这次体验还好吧，老板的服务态度蛮好的，他家还可以送外卖哦，吃饭的时候总有外卖单。这家店的位置是在巷子里，算蛮好找的哦。交通还是便利的，有公交直达的哦。这家店外表看上去开了蛮久的，而且里面空间也不算大吧，也就十个左右的小桌子哦，一般般咯。里面卫生状况也一般般咯。
点的菜算还行吧，饺子就是东北的，和我们南方的不一样哦，还行吧。还有一个煎饼样的，里面有肉馅，还行。酱大骨还不错，第一次吃这种，东北特色菜吧。还有驴肉，东北大拉皮，水晶肉皮冻，凉拌脆骨，锅色肉，东北京酱肉丝，糖醋排骨，东北疙瘩汤等等，都还行吧，没吃过东北菜的可以来尝尝口味，他们的菜咋感觉偏甜，不符合南昌吃辣的口味哦，希望在大众点评能推出更多优惠就好了。哈哈哈哈

decisions.label: Food#Portion

decisions.text: 有幸被大众抽中免费试吃，虽然地方有点远但有专车接送还真不错。店招很醒目，就在灵山景区停车场东门对面。到店后老板热情招呼上了二楼包厢，环境干净整洁。经过一轮自我介绍后大家才开始动筷！冷菜大致与菜单上相同一，有白斩鸡、牛肉、蜜汁番茄、红枣、皮蛋豆腐、蒜泥黄瓜、猪耳、蚕豆。热菜先上的是发菜银鱼羹，由于从小就不喜欢淀粉勾芡的汤羹，没尝。太湖虾虽然小，但肉质不错。香炸银鱼用竹签串起，调味后裹面包糠油炸，吃起来外酥里嫩还很方便。无锡酱排骨看着不错， 到我这一块都没了，没尝到据说还不错。红烧土鸡尝了一块，还可以吧。清真白鱼没尝，鱼看着倒是新鲜的。鳝鱼蒸咸肉觉得鳝鱼咸了，可能咸肉泡的时间短吧。老鸭煲看着不像老鸭，油也不黄，没吃。猪手炖黄豆看着炖挺烂的，但实在是不喜欢猪手也没碰。酱椒财鱼就是挑较大的银鱼来清真，看着味道应该比较鲜美，但是转到我那又没了，唉~~红烧激浪鱼味道不错，肉质细腻，味道也很鲜，不过鱼刺比较多，吃起来要格外小心。红烧面筋都说咸，没碰。蔬菜分别是旱芹炒干丝，韭菜炒蚬肉、雪菜野山笋。吃着还算清爽，不油腻。点心是麻花，不喜欢吃也没尝。总的来说这顿饭没有特别惊艳的菜。景区嘛，农家菜只能吃个便饭。

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review never judges portion size; it only lists dishes and says some were not tasted, so the rule's exclusion (listing dishes without evaluating quantity) applies and the gold seems to over-reach, though '没了' (run out) is a weak quantity hint.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a case showing that 'X没了/没吃到' about a dish counts as a portion remark only if the reviewer frames it as too little.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review says '一块都没了' and '转到我那又没了' about dishes running out for the reviewer, and '农家菜只能吃个便饭', which arguably judges quantity; but the rule says only explicit comments on amount count, and the agent and most arms judged it absent, so the gold looks debatable rather than clearly missed.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule example that '吃个便饭' and '没了/没吃到' about shared dish quantity count as Portion judgments if the dataset intends that.

decisions.label: Ambience#Noise
decisions.evidence: 环境淡雅幽静
decisions.text: 有活动便宜了那么几十块钱，就来再吃了一次，听说换了楼层，就来看看新面貌。新的餐厅确实很有feel，像个露天花园，地方挺大挺宽敞，环境淡雅幽静。这里最好的一点就是不用急着抢食物，每一种都供应充足，无论是刺身还是牛排都可以不间断供应。其实这里的菜品并不是很多，口味也还凑合，品质还是可以的。中菜都是一些普通的彩色，西点品种倒是挺丰富。基本的水果饮料冰淇淋也都一应俱全。不知道是不是有活动，送了两只蟹，不过很小可能是因为不当季吧。总体来说还是不错的。

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 中菜都是一些普通的彩色
decisions.text: 有活动便宜了那么几十块钱，就来再吃了一次，听说换了楼层，就来看看新面貌。新的餐厅确实很有feel，像个露天花园，地方挺大挺宽敞，环境淡雅幽静。这里最好的一点就是不用急着抢食物，每一种都供应充足，无论是刺身还是牛排都可以不间断供应。其实这里的菜品并不是很多，口味也还凑合，品质还是可以的。中菜都是一些普通的彩色，西点品种倒是挺丰富。基本的水果饮料冰淇淋也都一应俱全。不知道是不是有活动，送了两只蟹，不过很小可能是因为不当季吧。总体来说还是不错的。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The quote 中菜都是一些普通的彩色 describes the dishes as ordinary in colour, which is a negative-leaning appearance judgement and matches the rule's 颜色 trigger, yet the gold labels it not as appearance, so the agent over-applied the colour keyword; the sentence is about variety of dishes rather than visual appeal.
pass1.fix: Add a case library entry where 普通的彩色 or dull colour descriptions about a dish set are labelled as Appearance only when they judge how the food looks, and clarify in the rule that remarks on dish variety or types do not count.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: 普通的彩色 refers to dish colour, which fits the 颜色/色泽 cue, but the review calls it ordinary and the rule does not say whether a negative or neutral remark about colour counts; the agent read the rule and still applied it, while 6 of 6 other arms did not, so the rule is unclear on lukewarm colour remarks.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the Food#Appearance rule that colour/presentation remarks count only when they judge the dish's look (positive, negative or neutral), and add cases like 颜色普通 to show whether such mild remarks are labelled; otherwise document as ambiguous.

pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule example that a directly stated 优惠 remark about the price counts as Discount even without a coupon or group-buy term

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note clarifying whether generic 优惠 praise of the base meal price (no coupon/promotion mechanism) counts as Discount or only as Cost_effective/Level.

decisions.label: Ambience#Sanitary
decisions.rejected_reason: Hair in a dish is a food issue, not an explicit hygiene judgment of the restaurant.
decisions.text: 服务太差，一进门就说不准自带酒，几个貌似领班的老阿姨吊个脸一起跑过来，说这是我们酒店的规订，我这还是新规出台以来第一次碰到，还没吃就搞的心情很不爽。菜品少，上菜速度很慢，味道也不行，有个菜吃出根长长的头发，松茸汤里有臭虾味道，清蒸班节虾有不少是死的，点了壶55的铁观音茶渣很多，结账时还要多收50元酒水费，不敢说开瓶费，说是用了她们酒店的酒杯啊茶杯啊什么什么的茶位费，一脸你爱来不来的表情。以后不可能再来了。

pass1.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass1.why: The rule lists 脏 and 有苍蝇 as hygiene signals but is silent on foreign objects like hair in a dish, and the reviewer's hair complaint sits between food quality and restaurant hygiene, so the case is genuinely unclear.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit or case: a hair, insect or foreign object found in a dish counts as Ambience#Sanitary negative when the review frames it as unhygienic, and add several such cases to the library.

pass2.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass2.why: The review explicitly reports a hair in a dish and a shrimp that smells and dead shrimp, which are hygiene judgments the gold counts under sanitary, but the rule only lists cleanliness words and says food-only comments usually tag taste, so the model reasonably read these as food issues rather than restaurant hygiene.
pass2.fix: Add a rule edit to Ambience#Sanitary: foreign objects (头发、虫子) and dead or spoiled ingredients found in dishes count as 卫生 negatives, with a worked example from this review, so the boundary with Food#Taste is explicit.

decisions.label: Service#Timely
decisions.evidence: 因为是现做的可能会有点慢
decisions.text:
来吃两次了 很喜欢的一家小店 店主是韩国人 中文太6 感觉人非常好啊哈哈 店里有水果也会给客人吃 经常看到一家人还有老爷爷在看韩剧(。・`ω´・) 很温馨
【位置】比较不好找 新一城后面第二排箱子的最深处 走到最里面就会看见啦
【环境】店面不大 两层 但是位置还算多 比较拥挤吧 装修挺韩风的 很干净 每次来吃的人都不少
【食物】味道肯定很地道啦 种类一只手就可以数过来 但是各有特色
#黄金包饭# 应该算是招牌吧 包饭是之前卷好的 里面卷的胡萝卜大根萝卜和火腿 然后现煎鸡蛋 裹一圈在外面 撒上芝麻 很对起黄金包饭这个名字啊 个人很喜欢 因为是现做的可能会有点慢 不过一定要趁热吃 凉了鸡蛋皮会变硬 量其实挺多的 两个女生吃非常够
#宫廷年糕#偏辣 比起别的这个口味最强烈 里面有鱼饼和鹌鹑蛋 酱多但是不咸 年糕很入味有嚼劲 鱼饼特别好吃
#韩式乌冬面# 味道偏淡 面的感觉QQ的 汤很清爽 里面青菜豆腐果都挺好吃~
喜欢泡菜 自家腌的 完美发酵 自取型~ 金大根就是外面卖的那种…
乌冬汤！我真的很喜欢这个秘制的汤 味道很鲜！配着喝特别棒

pass1.fix: Add a rule note: a mention that a dish is slow only because it is made to order, with no complaint or praise of service speed, is not Service#Timely; add a few such cases to the library with the gold label recorded either way.

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that a reviewer's statement that a dish is slow because it is made to order counts as Service#Timely, and add similar cases to the library.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 个人比较推荐芝士的跟二路的小丸子
decisions.text:
来大连旅游，因为是自助游，查攻略当然少不了查看大连当地的小吃了，2路车站小丸子，这个已经是当地有名的小吃了，来了一定要去尝尝。其实是专门品尝小丸子是总要事情，逛街为辅。
  就在大连2路车站附近，应该是总店了吧。店面不是太大，但是人却是不少，除了当地人还有不少来旅游的人跟我一样专程来尝尝这诱人的小吃。
  交上钱领了小票跟做丸子的大妈就眼巴巴的等待我的小丸子出炉。虽然来买丸子的人很多，但是等待的时间却不长，小丸子出锅了。
  个人觉得小丸子一定要堂食最好吃，个头挺大，赶紧要一口，外皮酥脆软嫩，要的芝士的，还有芝士的拉丝，大粒的鱿鱼，还有卷心菜的菜香，配上各种自己喜欢的酱汁，味道真是好吃，比我们当地的小丸子好吃不知道多少倍，当地里面有的有很小鱿鱼，然后就全是面了，粘粘的。尝了二路家的小丸子才知道真是好吃。扇贝小丸子里面有一整颗的扇贝。个人比较推荐芝士的跟二路的小丸子。酱料推荐青芥，蛋黄酱还有番茄酱比较好吃。
  还有它家的鸡肉串也很好吃，微波炉打过，热热的，肉质软糯可口，鸡肉入味而且很嫩。
  来大连一定要吃的小吃哟，推荐。

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The review explicitly says 个人比较推荐芝士的跟二路的小丸子, which is a clear recommendation, yet the rule says praise plus 推荐 of a specific dish usually gets the label; the gold omits it, so the gold or the rule's boundary with Food#Taste is inconsistent with this wording.
pass1.fix: Add a rule example: when the reviewer writes 个人比较推荐 or 推荐 + a named dish, label Food#Recommend even if Food#Taste is also present, and add more cases of 个人推荐 wording to the case library to settle the convention.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The review explicitly says 个人比较推荐芝士的跟二路的小丸子 and recommends specific items, which matches the rule's 'explicit recommendation' criterion, so the agent's label is defensible and the gold omission looks inconsistent with the rule's own examples.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a case showing that an explicit first-person 'I recommend X' sentence alongside praise is labelled Food#Recommend.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.rejected_reason: 没有评价商圈位置，只提到在大学城
decisions.text: 来这边办事顺便在大学城吃饭，美食街现已成为大学城的标配了，金堂也不例外，各种小吃玲琅满目，面食不考虑，所以选了拌饭。价钱公道，各种石锅饭（真的是用石锅装的哦）只要十三，比起市内太划算有没有。我选的咖喱鸡肉拌饭，配菜有鸡肉，葱，蘑菇，胡萝卜，豆芽，青菜叶，蛋皮丝，还窝了个生鸡蛋。咖喱是另外用一个小碗分开装的，里面还有土豆吃的时候倒进去，我没有全部倒进去，量太多了。饭有锅巴但是不香，咖喱味道一般，但是这个价钱性价比已经很高了，要是我们学校周围有我肯定经常光顾。

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The review only says the restaurant is in a university-town food street and never judges a commercial district or city-centre position, so the agent's rejection matches the rule's 'does not apply' spirit; the gold label seems to rest on the 'market-wise' price comparison with 市内 rather than on any location statement, and all six arms agreed against it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a rule note that comparisons like '比起市内' alone do not trigger Location#Downtown.

decisions.label: Location#Easy_to_find
decisions.rejected_reason: The review gives landmarks and says the reviewer entered a neighbouring shop by mistake, but never states that the shop is easy or hard to find, nor a sign or position judgement. The evidence is too indirect, so I dropped it.
decisions.text:
某年某月某日，实在没啥可吃的东东了，就在点评上搜索，恰巧他家做活动，好像是9.9一斤吧，当年的时候，长春的麻辣烫大多都是几块钱一碗的，这种称斤的还是新鲜玩意，于是就团了一份。记得他家好像是在百汇街上，离学人书店不算远，和什么八千里麻辣烫是斜对面，为啥我对这事儿这么清楚呢，因为我第一次去的时候走人家八千里屋里去了，后来才发现不是。
店的整体算是比较干净的，一进门能拿到一个小篮子，有很多青菜啊，蘑菇啊，香肠鱼丸之流可选，建议后人去的时候拿东西不要拿太多，因为大多数的东西都是泡了水的，泡水的东西嘛，你懂得，很压秤，你挑个几样轻轻松松一两斤，超重几乎是必然的事情。煮的时候尽量让他多煮一会，麻辣烫如果煮不熟是挺容易得病的。最后，他家味道还不错，满满的一大碗蔬菜在冬天是一件挺满足的事情。

pass1.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass1.why: The agent read the rule and had landmark evidence ("百汇街上", "离学人书店不算远", "和八千里斜对面", and the reviewer walking into the wrong neighbouring shop), but its self-check dropped the label, although the rule's findability wording covers this kind of location description.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt edit to the self-check: do not drop a rule-covered label just because the evidence is indirect; add a rule example that landmark-based directions ("离X不远", "在X斜对面", "走错进了隔壁店") count as Easy_to_find.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The agent read this rule and found the landmark and mistaken-entry details, but its self-check dropped the label, and all six arms made the same miss, so the self-check is discarding a label the review's wording supports.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt note that landmark-based directions and anecdotes of entering the wrong shop count as Easy_to_find evidence, and tell the self-check not to drop a label solely because the judgement is indirect.

decisions.label: Location#Transportation
decisions.rejected_reason: No mention of public transport.
decisions.text:
某年某月某日，实在没啥可吃的东东了，就在点评上搜索，恰巧他家做活动，好像是9.9一斤吧，当年的时候，长春的麻辣烫大多都是几块钱一碗的，这种称斤的还是新鲜玩意，于是就团了一份。记得他家好像是在百汇街上，离学人书店不算远，和什么八千里麻辣烫是斜对面，为啥我对这事儿这么清楚呢，因为我第一次去的时候走人家八千里屋里去了，后来才发现不是。
店的整体算是比较干净的，一进门能拿到一个小篮子，有很多青菜啊，蘑菇啊，香肠鱼丸之流可选，建议后人去的时候拿东西不要拿太多，因为大多数的东西都是泡了水的，泡水的东西嘛，你懂得，很压秤，你挑个几样轻轻松松一两斤，超重几乎是必然的事情。煮的时候尽量让他多煮一会，麻辣烫如果煮不熟是挺容易得病的。最后，他家味道还不错，满满的一大碗蔬菜在冬天是一件挺满足的事情。

pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or check the gold label against the rule's transit-only scope and remove Location#Transportation if no transit mention is confirmed.

pass2.label: Location#Transportation
pass2.why: The review gives only landmarks ('离学人书店不算远', '斜对面'), which the rule says '只说附近有什么' does not trigger, so the gold label conflicts with the rulebook's own convention and no transport information appears in the text.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or ask the gold labellers to re-check whether landmark-only proximity should carry Location#Transportation.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 这个价钱有这个味道也真的是，如果不好吃那就太糟糕了。幸好是着实没让人失望
decisions.text: 每次无论几点从这里路过都是排长队，不由得让人好奇到底这个鲍师傅是干嘛的。观察了好久发现也只是买糕点，周围糕点店各式各样的牌子也都有，所以就更好奇，这个鲍师傅的糕点做的是有多么好，才会这么受欢迎啊！亏的离住的地方近，没忍住好奇心，大晚上的趁着人没那么多也跟着排起了队，不敢多买，每种两块，只为尝尝，结果拿回家自己还没吃，我妈先打电话过来说炒鸡好吃了，想了一下，这个价钱有这个味道也真的是，如果不好吃那就太糟糕了。幸好是着实没让人失望。宫廷糕点果然有一套。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review does compare price with taste (这个价钱有这个味道), which fits the rule's 'value for price' idea, but it never uses the listed cue words and the cost-performance judgement is implicit; the gold omits it, and all six other arms made the same call, so the gold reading looks more literal than the text supports.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that implicit price-to-taste comparisons ('这个价钱有这个味道') count as Cost_effective, with a few such cases in the library to settle the convention.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says the price matches the taste and that it would have been terrible had it been bad, which is a value-for-money judgement comparing price with quality, so the label is arguably correct; all six other arms made the same call and the rule's 'value for price' cues fit, so the gold label looks incomplete rather than the agent being wrong.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that 'price matches the taste' / '这个价钱有这个味道' counts as Cost_effective, with a few such cases in the case library.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: Only states the price of 22 刀 as a fact, with no judgement of high or low.
decisions.text: 两家都是正宗的高棉厨房，重要事情前面说。问过本地人问过服务生，都说两家都是一样的，我们两家都去过，路口那家比较小，有些菜没有，比如炸排骨，所以我们转移阵地去了巷子那家，巷子那家很大，前后都是店面，都是同一家没有什么冒牌一说。再说口味，暹粒吃的最落胃的就是这家，炸排骨一定要点，超好吃，没有异味，很酥，蘸调料一绝。芒果沙拉好吃，有淡淡的芒果香味，酸辣适口。lok lak是柬埔寨传统菜，比之前的好吃，冬阴功汤比较甜，小小一碗但是料还是很足的，三菜一汤两个饮料，米饭管饱，22刀，性价比超高，比红钢琴好吃多了，服务员的态度也好多了，5星推荐！还有一道香蕉花沙拉很想试试，谁点了拜托写下点评～

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review only states that the meal cost 22 刀 without any high or low judgement, which the rule explicitly excludes (a menu/bundle amount with no evaluation is not labelled), yet the gold includes Price#Level, likely inferred from the surrounding 性价比超高 praise and the implied cheapness; the other arms made the same miss, so the rule as written supports the agent.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a boundary case that a stated total paid alongside an explicit value judgement (e.g. 性价比超高 with a specific amount) counts as Price#Level when the cost is framed as cheap or worth it.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review states '22刀' only as a bare price with no high/low judgement, which the rule explicitly excludes, yet the gold label includes Price#Level and the item's '性价比超高' plus '超高性价比' framing reads as an implicit price-level judgement that most arms also missed, so the gold is debatable against the rule's own wording.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a boundary note that a bare price alongside an explicit cost-effectiveness praise may be labelled Price#Level, and add similar cases to the library.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.rejected_reason: 环境评价只具体指向空调油渍，属于卫生，没有评价装修
decisions.text:
每次路过他家都发现人特别多，后来才发现是上过人气美食的。这次皇太后生辰，过去拔草。下午17点多到那边，已经没有位置了，都被预定掉了，不过老板说18点半之前能吃完的话，有间包厢能用，果断拿下。点菜就和大家说的一样，吵是吵得来，还催着你快点快点，但是菜品都放在那边，能看到实物，还不错。点完菜，吧台点完饮料，上楼，自带了黄酒，加了服务费10块钱，能接受。四菜一汤一炒面，量比较大的，能吃撑。
酒香草头：量大，但是相对比较老，酒味不浓。
田螺：味道很好，量超多，我爱吃，基本上一盆都被我干掉了~
八爪鱼：一般，我觉得有沙。
红烧肚档：量大，味道还可以。
青蒜鸡鸭血：味道不错，但是是做成羹的，感觉勾芡有点厚。
炒面：这个很好吃，点了小份的，上来一大盘。
结账一共才145块，真心是便宜了，老板说的薄利多销是一点没错。
不过老实说，环境真心不怎么样，空调上面都是油渍，乌黑乌黑的，我差点以为是苍蝇在上面呢。。。
总之，味道不错，还可以考虑再去。

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The review gives a general negative verdict on the environment ("环境真心不怎么样"), and the rulebook says a general environment evaluation takes all four environment labels, but the agent never read the boundary rule and rejected the label because the complaint was specifically about oil stains.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt step: when a review gives a general verdict on 环境 (环境很好/不好/一般), read the Ambience boundary notes and tag all four environment labels, with polarity from that verdict, even if a specific sub-aspect is also named.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review says "环境真心不怎么样", a general judgment of the environment, and the rulebook says general environment comments tag all four environment labels. The agent never read the Decoration rule, so it applied only the specific air-conditioner comment, and six other arms got this label right.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: whenever a review uses 环境 or 环境相关 wording, the agent must read the boundary notes for all four Ambience labels before deciding, and tag all four when the evaluation is general.

pass1.why: The agent considered Space but dismissed it, and it never read the rule saying a general 环境 evaluation also tags Space, so it applied only the specific-aspect reading.
pass1.fix: Same prompt edit: force the agent to check the general-环境 boundary rule for all four environment labels before finalising, and add a self-check that a general 环境 verdict must not be pruned to a single sub-aspect.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.rejected_reason: “牛肉味很足”说的是味道浓淡，不是菜品分量；厚牛排描述的是厚度，也不是分量评价
decisions.text: 点了份套餐，前餐面包搭配了份蘑菇酱，可谓是画龙点睛之笔，酱里带着蘑菇的香味，哪怕是单吃也不会感到腻。汤我点了貌似是象拔蚌，以前没尝过，这次特地尝了下，味道还行，朋友点的牛肉汤好像，刚端上桌看上去不咋样，清汤清水的，但尝了口感觉棒极了，虽然看上去清淡，但牛肉味很足，清爽鲜香！沙拉选的是芦笋鲜虾沙拉，看大众点评人气还挺高的，所以才点的它，果然群众的口味是杠杠滴，非常棒！虾肉很嫩，芦笋也很嫩，沾了点酱，棒棒哒！牛排就点了这里的招牌，牛排没多少感觉，还可以吧，不过还蛮符合厚牛排的名字，真的比一般的牛排厚，不过受热还是蛮均匀的。甜点什么的没有什么特别想评价的。

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The agent never read the Food#Portion rule (rule_read is false), so it did not check the review for portion wording; the rule's 'Applies when' list and the review's 'Does not apply when' boundary would have been the test. The agent's own reasoning about '牛肉味很足' and '厚牛排' is the correct rejection of those as portion evidence, but the gold label likely rests on the thick-steak remark ('真的比一般的牛排厚') being read as portion size, a judgement the flow never reached.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to walk through every Food# rule (Taste, Appearance, Portion, etc.) for each dish before finalising, and add a case-library entry stating that comments on the physical thickness or size of a dish count as Food#Portion when the reviewer contrasts them with typical portions.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review says the 牛排 is thicker than usual (真的比一般的牛排厚) and that the 牛肉味很足, which the reviewer may intend as a portion/size judgment, but the rule's 'Does not apply' list and the reviewer's own framing as thickness and flavour make the gold label debatable; all six arms missed it and the rule was never read, so the miss is not a clear model error.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a case noting that remarks on a dish being thick or substantial count as Food#Portion only when the reviewer ties it to amount.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 最后还有香辣鱿鱼须（不推荐这个，我只吃出辣味）
decisions.text: #烤匠# 先说下环境，群光广场9楼找到店家，外面排队的人贼多贼多，还好我可以直接进来[调皮]，装修是酒吧格调，卡座和吧台，所以每桌人数不能太多。特色菜：黑椒蚝油味和黄金酸辣味的烤鱼两个满满的放满了一张桌子。黑椒蚝油味刚吃时时最入味的，随着后期加热升温，口味逐渐温和，补加素菜后仍是满口的幸福。黄金酸辣味初上是看着像咖喱，味比较清淡，闻着却有点。。（泡椒牛肉方便面？）还好随着温度升温整条鱼入味爽口。其他菜有烤生蚝、肉串、猪蹄、鸡翅、茄子，手撕烤鸡，其中包浆豆腐真心不错，柔软入口即化。最后还有香辣鱿鱼须（不推荐这个，我只吃出辣味）。小吃我们试了绵绵冰、培根薯条，饮料是特制玫瑰饮，目前新店开张打折，人均消费90左右，如果小伙伴5人左右一桌非常合适哦！！最后，我今天是非常幸运的，非常感谢蛋妮妮酱和CC的活动。

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The review explicitly says 不推荐 about the squid whisker dish, which by the rule's own wording should be labelled, so the agent's label looks right and the gold may be incomplete; the error is shared by all six arms, pointing to the gold label rather than the agent.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous or correct the gold to include Food#Recommend, since the rule explicitly lists 不推荐 as applying.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The review explicitly says "不推荐这个" about the squid whiskers, which fits the rule's 不推荐 case, so the agent's label is arguably right and the gold omits it; the error is shared by six arms and the rule was read, pointing to a gold-label inconsistency rather than a model slip.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; check whether explicit 不推荐 on a single dish should be gold-labelled, and align the gold with the rule's own 不推荐 (84%) example.

pass1.fix: Add a rule edit clarifying that naming a mall or plaza (如 某某广场) as the location counts as Location#Downtown even when a floor number is also given, and add cases of this pattern.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.rejected_reason: 未提及分量
decisions.text:
环境不错，很有文艺气息，据说是复旦校友众筹，又是申报馆，B格很高。一楼可以用餐，喝咖啡，略吵；二楼是个酒吧，沙发区很舒适，下午去的，点了喝的，很安静，适合谈事情办公，但不可以用餐，后来加了吃的，就只好移到楼下。
食物味道还行，招牌press咖啡也不错，只是建议能不能把上面那个带颜色的奶油给换掉，实在有点…还有个招牌甜品，名字忘记了，是朗姆酒里面浸泡，沾巧克力酱吃，很有特色，但是酒味很浓，不喜欢酒精的朋友慎点。
服务生也很热情，虽然开始点好单把我们忘记，两杯咖啡等了半个小时！不影响整体良好体验～

decisions.text:
环境不错，很有文艺气息，据说是复旦校友众筹，又是申报馆，B格很高。一楼可以用餐，喝咖啡，略吵；二楼是个酒吧，沙发区很舒适，下午去的，点了喝的，很安静，适合谈事情办公，但不可以用餐，后来加了吃的，就只好移到楼下。
食物味道还行，招牌press咖啡也不错，只是建议能不能把上面那个带颜色的奶油给换掉，实在有点…还有个招牌甜品，名字忘记了，是朗姆酒里面浸泡，沾巧克力酱吃，很有特色，但是酒味很浓，不喜欢酒精的朋友慎点。
服务生也很热情，虽然开始点好单把我们忘记，两杯咖啡等了半个小时！不影响整体良好体验～

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective

decisions.text:
[环境] 在望京商业街海底捞的侧边 一进店浓浓的辣椒香感觉还可以 店内人不少吵吵嚷嚷可座位之间只有一层竹席没有隔音 座是木质的板凳舒适度一般 吃到后面整个店通风不好特别呛人
[服务] 中规中矩没什么特别的
[菜品] 锅底鸳鸯锅 出乎意料清汤那边很赞 但是小料台是简易的 特别没有吃火锅的感觉
  高钙羊肉和牛肉 都是一般水平 高钙羊肉里面是有脆骨的比较费牙口
  酥肉 印象最深的就是酥肉 味道调的很合适 不会太麻 我们直接吃了没放进汤里涮
  鸭肠 挺大的一碗应该比较新鲜 少涮一会脆脆的
  牛黄喉 是新鲜的厚切片的黄喉 不是一般火锅点常见的薄片泡发的 味道很不错
  牛大肚 和毛肚不一样 感觉像是卤味里常见的牛肚原料 口感劲道
  牛蛙 必须批评一下 点的一份上来只有一只 四五十一只牛蛙 店家是想钱想疯了吗

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 吃完很饱
decisions.text:
环境：解放碑商圈里，表妹在附近念书，为不耽误上课就近找了家吃。商场里的店铺，装修的还是挺好，看起来干净，卫生状况应该甩路边摊一条街。
味道：就是川菜的味道，整体感觉比较辣。由于前一个晚上吃火锅拉到半夜三点多，吃完还要赶灰机所以都点的温和的。相思牛肉，肉质很好，青椒偏辣，下饭很好。有机花菜，里面那个腊肉太肥，尝试了一片，虽然炸干了还好味不算太腻，但一片足矣！钵钵青菜，很温和，养胃，补充蔬菜水分。蜜糖吐司，主食之后自然要来个甜品，味道中规中矩，冰淇淋真的好冰啊
服务：饭点儿去的，需要排队，但时间不久，态度还不错
整体感觉，性价比一般，就餐环境味道综合4星，三人吃了200+，吃完很饱

pass1.fix: Prompt edit: add a note that 饱/撑 describes the diner's state and only counts as Food#Portion when it is tied to dish quantity (e.g. 菜量大, 分量足).

pass2.label: Food#Portion

pass2.fix: Add a boundary note to Food#Portion: '吃饱/吃很饱' describing the diner's fullness does not count unless the review judges the dish amount; add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: 只陈述人均200+，没有就价格高低作评价
decisions.text:
环境：解放碑商圈里，表妹在附近念书，为不耽误上课就近找了家吃。商场里的店铺，装修的还是挺好，看起来干净，卫生状况应该甩路边摊一条街。
味道：就是川菜的味道，整体感觉比较辣。由于前一个晚上吃火锅拉到半夜三点多，吃完还要赶灰机所以都点的温和的。相思牛肉，肉质很好，青椒偏辣，下饭很好。有机花菜，里面那个腊肉太肥，尝试了一片，虽然炸干了还好味不算太腻，但一片足矣！钵钵青菜，很温和，养胃，补充蔬菜水分。蜜糖吐司，主食之后自然要来个甜品，味道中规中矩，冰淇淋真的好冰啊
服务：饭点儿去的，需要排队，但时间不久，态度还不错
整体感觉，性价比一般，就餐环境味道综合4星，三人吃了200+，吃完很饱

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The agent never read the Price#Level rule, so it skipped a label it needed, even though the review gives a per-person spend and a cost-effectiveness judgement that the boundary rule links to price level.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: when a review mentions price or 性价比, require reading both Price#Level and Price#Cost_effective boundary notes before finalising, and add a case where 人均 with a value judgement tags both.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review states only '三人吃了200+' with no high/low judgement, which the rule says is usually unlabelled, yet the gold label is present and the category is 50% of similar cases, so the gold seems to rest on implicit expensiveness that the rule does not clearly state.
pass2.fix: None: document as ambiguous, and note that per-capita spend stated alongside a 性价比一般 judgement is often tagged as Price#Level in the dataset.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.evidence: 现在应该是万达里最火的自助餐了吧
decisions.text: 现在应该是万达里最火的自助餐了吧！去了三次都排队，第三次去的早才没用排！可能会说刚开价格低所以人多，但是我还想说他家的服务绝对拉其它几家自助餐好几条街！因为有小孩，和铁板烤肉串的小伙说要几串不放辣椒的，人家做好了第一件事就想着这事呢，真的有心！会有人主动来加水，收拾桌子的服务员除了收走盘子，还会把桌面上的垃圾用手带走！我认为除了味道，服务也是商家的根本，他家做到了！说说我吃的几样东西吧，巴西烤肉味道都不错，会有服务员主动拿到桌上问要不要，都可以尝尝！有个烤猪肉串，像是羊肉串的样子，就不要吃了，味道不好还不好嚼！寿司的味道还不错，就是饭还可以再少放一点！水果和现榨果汁不错，都挺新鲜的！说说重头戏海鲜，除了虾和螃蟹，其它还都很新鲜，就是个头小点，味道还不错，虾和螃蟹是冻的，虾比较小，螃蟹的肉是面的，但味道可以，不过一次煮不了多少！就餐环境算是比较紧凑的吧，并不十分宽敞，还行吧！

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The reviewer only remarks that the buffet is the hottest one in 万达 (a mall complex), an offhand speculation about popularity rather than a judgment of the location; the self-check added the label after the first pass had not flagged it, so the check overrode a correct decision and the rule's 'in a mall' trigger was applied mechanically to a popularity remark.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt edit to the self-check: only add a Location label when the review judges the location itself (where it is, how central or convenient); add a case-library entry where a mall name appears only in a popularity or reputation remark and the gold is no Location label.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown
pass2.why: The agent read the rule but the self-check added the label on a passing remark about the restaurant being the hottest buffet in Wanda, which is a popularity judgement, not a statement that the restaurant sits in a commercial district; the self-check overturned a decision the other arms got right.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt step that a self-check may only add or remove labels when it cites a rule condition, and add a rule note that popularity or 'hottest' remarks about a mall do not by themselves trigger Location#Downtown unless the review states location or district.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: 造型 appears only in 'the spirit of constantly innovating shape and taste' about the bakery's general approach, not as a judgement of how the bread looks on the plate.
decisions.text:
皇后饼店推陈出新的味道，天天出炉的新鲜口感，对生活乐趣和品位的热切追求，这份对新鲜的执着与诚意，对品质一丝不苟的要求，以及不断钻研、不断创新造型和口感的创意精神，更重要的是，皇后饼店为生活制造新鲜的喜悦和健康的气息。
以健康为尚，天然成份、含丰富纤维的皇后面包，最受大众欢迎。皇后面包有港式、欧陆等多种不同风味，精选面包共冶一炉。每日不断新鲜烘焙，营养丰富，香气四溢，入口松软，适合任何年龄人士，是百吃不厌的健康食品。
皇后饼店的地理位置都设计很好，临近地铁站、公交车站，总在你身边有一间……中山八路的就在公交车站旁，温暖的招牌，暖色的设计，给寒冷的冬天添上温暖……
双十二临近，优惠多多，除了点评有闪付，支付宝也有，每天8折，双十二还有5折……不过记得要8点后……

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists 造型 as a cue for Food#Appearance and the case library links 造型 to this label 85% of the time, yet the gold labeller tied 造型 to the bread's shapes while the review's wording about shape innovation is general; other arms also missed it, so the rule's cue list and the reviewer's reading diverge.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note that 造型 describing the product's shape or design of baked goods counts as Food#Appearance, with 2-3 examples, and document this item as borderline if the innovation-in-shape sentence is not treated as a judgement of the food.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The gold label is debatable because 造型 here describes the bakery's general innovation spirit rather than the look of the bread, yet the rule lists 造型 as a direct cue and 84.6% of cases containing 造型 carry this label, so the agent's rejection went against the dataset's own convention and the rulebook; other arms also missed it, pointing to the gold and rule rather than the model.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a note that 造型 applied to a product line's shapes/styles counts as Food#Appearance even when phrased abstractly, and add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 价格到挺实惠的
decisions.text:
看到点评特地来的，看点评都写怎么好吃排队人怎么多还抱着很大期待，没想到就是吃日本简餐的，寿司什么的，店面也很小，工作日晚上五点半到的，不用排队，没有预约坐在吧台，说六点半要吃完的
价格到挺实惠的，各种寿司也没有非常惊艳，和牛也没有入口即化，鹅肝各家寿司店都不错的这家也没有特别好吃
箱蟹是现场拆的，还不错
芝士豆腐非常好吃，这个是唯一一个好吃的，芝士融在豆腐里好香好浓
秋葵酥本来以为像天妇罗那样的，其实就是把秋葵的水分都炸没了变成脆脆的，还是冷的
还有鳗鱼饭也很普通，鳗鱼刺也很多，不好吃
反正没有排队吃吃还可以，价格也不贵，特地来就算了，就是普通寿司店的味道

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The rule lists 实惠 as a Cost_effective cue, so the agent's label matches the rule's wording, yet the review's 实惠 is a plain value-for-money remark that the gold omits; the boundary note (only 性价比/值不值 trigger it alongside Price#Level) and the 66% cue share make the rule's trigger for 实惠 ambiguous, so the gold and the rule disagree.
pass1.fix: Edit the rule to say 实惠 alone counts only when the reviewer compares price against the quality of the food, and add cases where 价格实惠 is stated without any quality comparison labelled as Price#Level only.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says 价格到挺实惠的 and 价格也不贵 but then judges the restaurant as ordinary sushi taste with no good-value comparison; the rule lists 实惠 as a cue, so the agent followed it, yet the gold omits this label, and all six arms made the same error, pointing to the gold label or rule rather than the model.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that 实惠 alone without weighing price against quality (e.g., 普通味道但便宜) may be labelled only as Price#Level; add a few such cases to the case library.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 摆的都没法夹
decisions.text: 看着挺高档的，装修也不错，设施完善有监控器可以直接看见后厨的操作，菜品价位也高，想着味道和卖像肯定都不错，但是卖相可以看图片味道实在是很一般，土豆片里有几片肉都焦的特别硬，小炒排骨也特别一般，随便吃吃还凑合特意来不值，特别要提的是服务员的服务实在太差劲了，上菜就晃荡一放，摆的都没法夹，叫服务员调整（因为有两个菜都是点火的特别烫）叫了三次来了以后特别不乐意问怎么了，调整完还摔片汤话，真不知道这么大的餐厅怎么培训的，还不如个小餐厅吃盖饭的服务呢

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The phrase 摆的都没法夹 describes the dish arrangement being unusable for picking food, which is about serving/plating stability rather than visual appeal; the rule's 摆盘 cue is present but the sentence is about practical difficulty, and the review's appearance comment is 卖相可以看图片 which is a neutral reference, so the model over-read it.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note: 摆得不好夹、上菜晃荡等描述实用性或上菜方式的内容不算外观，除非评价摆盘好看或难看；add a few cases where 摆盘 complaints about usability are labelled Service or none.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The phrase 摆的都没法夹 describes the plating being unusable for picking food up, which is about serving/arrangement and the dish sitting loosely, not about visual appeal; the review's appearance remark is 卖相可以看图片, which is a neutral-to-unfavourable comparison, and every arm made the same reading, so the model stretched 摆 into 摆盘 when the mess is really a service-handling complaint.
pass2.fix: Add a rule edit to Food#Appearance: 摆放不便于夹取、上菜晃荡 describe service or handling and do not count as 外观 unless the review judges how the dish looks; add a case with 摆的没法夹 labelled as Service, not Appearance.

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review says 随便吃吃还凑合特意来不值, which does compare quality with price (a value judgement), so the gold omission looks like a rule gap: 不值 is listed as a cue yet the gold does not include it, and the boundary section says 值不值 maps to Cost_effective, creating a conflict the agent resolved by labelling it.
pass1.fix: Clarify the boundary: when a review judges that the food is not worth the price (不值/值不值) and there is no explicit 性价比 wording, state whether to label Cost_effective or only Price#Level, and add matching cases so the agent applies the same convention consistently.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says 随便吃吃还凑合特意来不值 and the rule lists 不值 as a cue, but the complaint is that the meal is only average for its high price, which does compare price against quality; the gold omits the label, so the gold may be treating this as Price#Level plus taste rather than an explicit value judgement, which is a debatable call the model read too literally.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 试吃的菜真多啊
decisions.text:
真的很感谢点评，能让我来试吃外婆家，万象城里很高大上，环境真的很好，花了不少钱，服务也很好，包房服务的很周到，有想再来的冲动。
话说试吃的菜真多啊，真的很幸运，我把我觉得好吃的菜说说吧，#秋葵#真的挺好吃，家里也做过，但是他这个没有家里做的那么的黏，那么的滑，所以口感不错，赞，#外婆红烧肉#这个招牌确实不错，很好吃，配着佛手一样的小夹饼确实很棒，很有家的感觉，#手抓羊#这个也不错，不是很腻，感觉会有点贵，推荐这个，#超级芒果牛奶冰#很赞，就是喜欢这样的甜点，好多芒果，碎碎的冰，超级喜欢，推荐
其他的也还不错，#黑枣#很开胃，#山药，色拉，藕，冷拼，鸭舌#这几个凉菜也挺好的，藕做的挺符合我的口味，但是不一定所有人都喜欢，很喜欢藕，山药，还有个豆皮做的菜，#鱼头，虾干，叫化鸡，小炒肉，目鱼蛋，牛蛙，#做的大部分有些咸，但是正常点菜一桌子不可能有这么多菜，荤菜也多，所以可能是整体上的问题，菜品本身都不错，喜欢虾干和小炒肉，#定胜糕#一般把，好像不同颜色是不同的味道把，#龙井抹茶酥#馅料和外皮口感太相同了，感觉没有馅料似地，所以没觉得太好，有点可惜。
饮品上喝的金桔的还不错，就是没有可以拐弯的吸管，酒酿圆子，感觉水再多一点就好了，挺想多来点汤的，小笼包没什么感觉，但是在北方做的也算很好了，至少里面会有汤汁流出来，赞，西湖牛肉羹，看上去是咸口的，没试，喜欢清淡点的相对于这个羹，好吃的甜豆，也还行，只是人少的话，点这个菜也吃不完啊。
总体满分，还想再去。

pass1.fix: Add 菜多、菜真多 to the Food#Portion applies-when list and re-check gold for similar quantity praise; otherwise document as ambiguous.

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a case where "菜真多" or "菜很多" is labelled Food#Portion to settle the convention.

decisions.text: 第一次去这店，人很多，11：30等位，大概等了50分钟，三人餐的份量吃得不多的人还行，选了两个牛一个海鲜，最后上的一个锅和一盆饭，饭除了偏辣和只有浅浅一层，味道有海苔在里面还行，重点说下年糕锅，味道和别家点差不多，主要说不满意的地方，第一：海鲜的份量，四个基围虾，六个花甲，几根鱿鱼丝，然后就木有了，完全和图片不一样，并且四个虾肉全部很柴，有的里面已经是那种浆糊的感觉，明显就是死虾，老板啊，份量少，价格贵我能接受，但是菜品质量能不能提高。第二：吃到一半，发现菜品里面有小拇指指甲一半大小的塑料袋碎片，我个人觉得，厨房工作虽辛苦，但是还是注意下卫生，考虑到当时服务员太忙，也就算了，还是希望老板把握卫生环节这一关。最后还是表扬下在门口等候准备的小食，给的一星是希望你们能加油，越做越好，望老板别介意！

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review says only that the price is high and the reviewer accepts it, plus a complaint about quality; the rule says a 'only expensive, no value comparison' remark does not apply, yet the sentence 'price expensive I can accept but quality should improve' is a value-for-money comparison, so the rule is genuinely ambiguous here and the gold (no Cost_effective) follows the stricter reading of Price#Level-only.
pass1.fix: Add a rule example: '价格贵我能接受' with a quality complaint is a price-level judgement only; add 3-5 cases of 'X贵但能接受' labelled Price#Level only to the case library.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The reviewer only says the price is high and they accept it, with no cue word like 性价比 or 划算, and the rule excludes bare 贵 statements; but the sentence does weigh price against portion and quality, and 5 of 6 other arms also labelled it, so the rule's "拿价钱和东西好坏比" test and its "does not apply" clause pull in opposite directions.
pass2.fix: Edit the rule to state whether an explicit price-versus-quality trade-off (e.g. "贵但份量少", "价格贵我能接受但质量要提高") counts as a value judgment, and add 3–5 such cases with gold labels to settle it.

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The praise is for a free appetiser handed out while waiting, which is a product/offering rather than a staff member's attitude; the rule requires evaluating service personnel, and the boundary note only adds Hospitality when staff are evaluated, but the agent read '表扬' as praising service.
pass1.fix: Add a boundary line: complimenting free snacks, dishes or waiting-area items without judging staff does not apply to Service#Hospitality; add cases of '送的小食不错' labelled as no Hospitality.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The rule was read, but the praise targets the complimentary snack served while waiting, a product, not the staff's attitude or hospitality toward the guest, so the model over-read "表扬" as a service-personnel judgment.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt note that praise for dishes, snacks or items is not Service#Hospitality unless the review credits staff, and add a contrast case such as "表扬门口的小食" labelled without hospitality.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 团购很实惠
decisions.text: 第一次来广粥城，感觉不错，人特别的多，只有知道收银员，还要排队等好久。环境还可以，上菜速度适中，菜量很少，味道还行，菜心不错值得推荐，但是筷子要自己拿。如果服务员更专业点那就更好了。团购很实惠，还会再来的。 菜品口味大致都可以，唯独我们点的饺子馅太多了，味道不是很好，点了2份，两个人只吃了一份另外的打包回来了！

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The rule lists 实惠 as an Applies-when term for this label (66%), so the agent's reading fits the rulebook, but the gold omits it, and the self-check added it on the strength of the same word that is also the main evidence for Price#Discount.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a boundary note stating whether 团购很实惠 alone counts as cost-effectiveness or only as a discount.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The Cost_effective rule lists 实惠 as a trigger, but its does-not-apply clause excludes judgements that never compare price with quality, and "团购很实惠" only praises the group-buy discount, so the trigger and the exclusion point in different directions.
pass2.fix: Edit the Cost_effective rule to say 实惠 counts only when paired with a price-to-quality comparison, and route bare group-buy 实惠 praise to Price#Discount.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.evidence: 团购很实惠
decisions.text: 第一次来广粥城，感觉不错，人特别的多，只有知道收银员，还要排队等好久。环境还可以，上菜速度适中，菜量很少，味道还行，菜心不错值得推荐，但是筷子要自己拿。如果服务员更专业点那就更好了。团购很实惠，还会再来的。 菜品口味大致都可以，唯独我们点的饺子馅太多了，味道不是很好，点了2份，两个人只吃了一份另外的打包回来了！

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review never compares price with price level; 实惠 here describes the group-buy discount, and the self-check added Price#Level after the first pass had left it out, which turned a correct answer into a wrong one.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: the self-check should only add a label when the review contains a price-level judgement, such as 贵, 便宜, 人均, or a stated price with an evaluation, and not when the only price word is 实惠 attached to a 团购 or discount.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The self-check added this label after the first pass without new evidence, and only one arm made the same addition, so the check overrode a correct first-pass decision.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt rule that self-check may only add a label when it quotes a specific new phrase, and that it may not add price-level labels for a discount-only remark like 团购很实惠.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 绿茶菜的分量真的是跟价钱成正比
decisions.text:
第三还是第四次去绿茶了，依然觉得很赞。因为中午就打算去了，所以下午去之前看了一下排号情况，惊讶地发现竟然3点半就有人在排号了。五点半出门前用大众取号发现前面已经有二十多位在等，不过到的时候只等了一会儿就进去了，所以大家去之前一定要记得先拿大众取号。
店内环境是一贯的比较暗，木质元素很多，整个气氛就很小资。不过因为店内人多，服务员都显得很匆忙的样子，而且店内过道很窄，所以略显拥挤。而且事实证明，虽然服务员看起来都很忙，但是需要的时候依然总是找不到人。
这次没有点以前经常点的烤肉椒香牛蛙或者面包诱惑，而是尝试了一些新的菜，不过不出所料的点多了，最后几乎每道菜都有剩。
【糖醋里脊】
这个是基本每次都会点的，因为总感觉是江浙菜的代表。糖醋味很浓郁，不过小块的肉吃起来感觉只有外面裹着的那层外衣，所以口感不是很好。但是大块一点的还是很好吃的。
【绿茶招牌泉水蛙】
以往都是点椒香牛蛙，但是总感觉椒香牛蛙裹的那层有腐乳的味道。这次尝试了招牌泉水蛙，只能说不愧是招牌。分量很大，不是很辣，但是很入味，青瓜和莴笋也很好吃。
【绿茶鸡肉合拼】
给这个菜名跪了...上菜之后才知道它的意思是“鸡”“肉”合拼，好险没有再点绿茶烤肉。这次的烤肉感觉有点咸，对比之下烤鸡味道更好。
【绿茶饼】
我的最爱，现在很多地方都有了，不过因为第一次吃是在绿茶，所以还是更喜欢绿茶的。
【招牌原味奶茶】
喝完了才想起来要拍，一直觉得杯子外面放一桶冰块的做法很有创意。
最后两个人吃了158，用大众买单减了5块钱，最后付了153。这次之后点菜有经验了，绿茶菜的分量真的是跟价钱成正比的，大概人均50左右应该是正好的。所以始终觉得最适合去绿茶吃饭的场合是多人聚会，能品尝到更多的菜式又不会浪费。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review does say portions are proportional to price, which reads as a value judgment, but the rule ties 性价比 to explicit value words and the review never calls it good or bad value, so 6 other arms rejected it and the gold may be incomplete rather than the agent wrong.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and add a rule note that 'X与价钱成正比' style value comparisons count as Cost_effective.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says portion size is proportional to price, which compares price with the quality of the goods as the rule's 性价比 definition requires, yet the gold omits it, so the gold looks incomplete rather than the model being wrong.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and add a rule example that '分量与价钱成正比' type comparisons count as Price#Cost_effective.

pass1.label: Service#Queue
pass1.why: The rule says 排队 covers 取号 and waiting for a seat, and the reviewer did take a queue number and waited a short time before being seated, yet all six arms that read the rule still disagreed with the agent, so the gold and rule seem to diverge here.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; clarify in the Queue rule whether a short wait that is judged acceptable still counts as a Queue label.

pass2.label: Service#Queue
pass2.why: The review explicitly describes waiting for a seat and taking a queue number, which fits the 排队 rule, so the gold omission is the likely error and the agent's label matches the rule and the item's words.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; check the gold for Service#Queue on reviews that mention a seat wait with 大众取号.

decisions.rejected_reason: Only states that 5 yuan was reduced via 大众买单; no evaluation of the discount strength.

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The review explicitly mentions 大众买单 reducing the bill by 5 yuan, which matches the rule's 优惠 and 活动 cues, but the agent never read the Discount rule and so the flow skipped it.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to scan every price-related sentence against the Price#Discount and Price#Level rules before finalising, including amount reductions from a platform deal.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The agent never read the Price#Discount rule, although the review explicitly mentions a 5-yuan reduction via 大众买单, which the rule lists as 优惠 and 满减 and so counts as a discount.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: when any money amount, 优惠, 买单 or 减 appears in the text, require the agent to open the Price#Discount and Price#Level rules before rejecting a label.

pass1.label: Price#Level

decisions.label: Service#Hospitality
decisions.rejected_reason: 没有评价服务人员态度
decisions.text: 第二次去，和闺蜜一起。之前上大二时和室友一起来过，菜便宜到死，量也很大，四个女生一百出头吃的撑死。不过味道和环境就一般了。室内通风较差乌烟瘴气的还很吵。这次和闺蜜晚上去座院子里还行，就是黑点儿。点了馕包肉、大盘鸡、羊肉串、新疆凉菜、奶茶。本来还点了包子但是被告知最少点是个，就取消了。还以为会不够吃，结果大盘鸡上来我俩就怂了。新疆凉菜就是大拌菜，里面有洋葱。味道一般，一如既往地量大。最后大盘鸡一半都打包了。

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The review never evaluates any staff member's attitude; the only service-related remark is about the minimum-order notice, a policy rather than a judgement of people, so the gold label looks unsupported by the text and the rule's examples (态度, 热情, 服务员) are absent.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or have the gold annotator confirm whether the minimum-order notice counts as hospitality.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The review mentions no staff and no attitude; the gold label appears to be inferred from the item, while the rule requires an evaluation of service personnel, which is absent, so the agent's rejection matches the rule and all arms missed it.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or check whether the gold was tagged on an unstated service impression; the rule as written does not support this label.

decisions.label: Service#Queue
decisions.rejected_reason: 没有提到排队等位
