pass1.label: Service#Queue
pass1.why: The review mentions no waiting or queuing at all; every arm missed it, and the gold label has no supporting quote, so the gold seems inconsistent with the text and with the rule's requirement of an explicit wait.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; ask the gold labeller to cite the supporting span or remove the label.

pass2.label: Service#Queue
pass2.why: The review says nothing about waiting for a table or queueing; the only related text is a minimum-order note, and every arm read the rule correctly as not applying, so the gold looks unsupported by the text.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous and review this gold label against the rule's own 'does not apply' conditions.

decisions.label: Ambience#Space
decisions.rejected_reason: 没有评价就餐空间或座位大小。
decisions.text: 终于把深藏已久的草草拔掉了，朋友强烈推荐给偶，偶却一直错过…之前去龙凤楼的时候有路过巨鹿路那家，小小的门面却很有情调的说，这个时候印象就很深刻，这次正好来到嘉里中心就来啦！传说的色拉偶并木有尝试，反而想尝试下金枪鱼三明治，一上来吓死宝宝了，这量也太大了，满满的金枪鱼，次着偶好撑，另外又加了杯咖啡和提拉米苏，不过#带我走#并木有惊艳到偶，感觉太湿的口感，少了蛋糕的层次感，有些小失望吧…但是总体还是不错的，给个四星吧

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The rule lists "店面小" as an Applies-when cue, and the review says "小小的门面", but the agent never read the Space rule and rejected the label without checking it against the cues.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step that checks each label's Applies-when list against every descriptive phrase about the venue, and add "门面小/店面小" as an explicit example under Ambience#Space.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The review mentions only the small storefront (小小的门面), which is about the facade rather than dining space; the rule says 店面小 applies, so a careful labeller could argue either way, and the gold seems to count 小小的门面 as space, which the rule's own example list partly supports but the agent read it as decoration.
pass2.fix: Add a boundary note clarifying whether 店面小 about the entrance/facade is Ambience#Space or Ambience#Decoration, and add a few similar cases with gold labels to the case library.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.rejected_reason: 只提到地点在嘉里中心，没有对商圈位置作评价。
decisions.text: 终于把深藏已久的草草拔掉了，朋友强烈推荐给偶，偶却一直错过…之前去龙凤楼的时候有路过巨鹿路那家，小小的门面却很有情调的说，这个时候印象就很深刻，这次正好来到嘉里中心就来啦！传说的色拉偶并木有尝试，反而想尝试下金枪鱼三明治，一上来吓死宝宝了，这量也太大了，满满的金枪鱼，次着偶好撑，另外又加了杯咖啡和提拉米苏，不过#带我走#并木有惊艳到偶，感觉太湿的口感，少了蛋糕的层次感，有些小失望吧…但是总体还是不错的，给个四星吧

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The rule says a restaurant inside or beside a 商场/购物中心/广场 gets this label, and the review places the restaurant in 嘉里中心, but the agent never read the Downtown rule and wrongly judged that no evaluation of the commercial area was given.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step that flags any named mall, plaza or shopping centre and requires checking the Location#Downtown rule, and state in the rule that naming a mall as the location counts even without a separate evaluation.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown
pass2.why: The review says 嘉里中心, a shopping centre name, which the rule lists as applying (在商场里标商圈), yet the agent judged it as a bare location mention; the rule's 'does not apply' note about only giving a place name conflicts with the listed mall example and the agent did not reconcile them.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the rule that naming a shopping mall or plaza as the restaurant's location counts as Location#Downtown even without further evaluation, and add this as an explicit example.

decisions.label: Location#Easy_to_find
decisions.rejected_reason: '没位置' refers to seats being unavailable, not to how easy the shop is to find.
decisions.text: 老渔父舟山海鲜位于繁华的南京东路步行街的旁边～地理位置相当的优越～交通就更是不用说的方便了～地铁出口就在不远处～可以想象那里的生意是多么的兴隆了～我们去的时候没位置～要等别人吃完才能有位置～服务员给安排在店门口坐着～先在门口点好菜～大概十几分钟的样子店家翻台有桌子了～因为先前点好菜了～一落座菜就陆陆续续的上桌了～可能是地方口味不同的原因～觉得那里的菜不太好吃啊～不过那里的服务没得挑～非常有礼貌～本来是在网上买好了代金券的～但要在九点才能用～只好现金结帐了。

pass1.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass1.why: The rule covers 位置 as shop location, and the agent read it, but the review's 位置 refers to seats; the gold seems to credit the review's praise of the location (地理位置相当的优越 plus the 'location is great' sentence) as findability, which the rule says is usually labelled (位置很好 96%), so the agent wrongly discounted it.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt note: when the review praises the shop's location (地理位置优越/位置很好) without mentioning seats, label Location#Easy_to_find, and add a contrast case showing 没位置 (seats) does not count.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The rule covers 位置 wording and the review says the restaurant is next to a busy pedestrian street and near a metro exit, which signals findability, but the model read '没位置' as seat availability and skipped the shop-findability reading; 5 of 6 other arms also missed it, though, which suggests the gold is debatable here.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that 'near a landmark / next to a busy street / near metro exit' describing the shop's position counts as easy to find.

decisions.label: Service#Timely
decisions.rejected_reason: Only describes dishes arriving one after another; no judgement of serving speed.
decisions.text: 老渔父舟山海鲜位于繁华的南京东路步行街的旁边～地理位置相当的优越～交通就更是不用说的方便了～地铁出口就在不远处～可以想象那里的生意是多么的兴隆了～我们去的时候没位置～要等别人吃完才能有位置～服务员给安排在店门口坐着～先在门口点好菜～大概十几分钟的样子店家翻台有桌子了～因为先前点好菜了～一落座菜就陆陆续续的上桌了～可能是地方口味不同的原因～觉得那里的菜不太好吃啊～不过那里的服务没得挑～非常有礼貌～本来是在网上买好了代金券的～但要在九点才能用～只好现金结帐了。

pass1.label: Service#Timely
pass1.why: The review says dishes came out one after another right after seating and that the shop turned tables quickly, which is a speed-related judgement the rule covers (很快就上齐了, 出餐快); the agent read the rule but judged it as only order description.
pass1.fix: Add a case to the Service#Timely rule: '一落座菜就陆陆续续的上桌了' or 'a short wait before dishes arrive' counts as speed when the reviewer frames it positively, with a note to check for implicit speed judgements.

pass2.label: Service#Timely
pass2.why: The review says dishes came up one after another soon after sitting down and that the shop turned tables quickly, which is a speed cue, yet the rule excludes plain description of dish order and only 1 arm marked it, so the gold leans on an implicit speed reading the rulebook does not spell out.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a rule example such as '一落座菜就陆陆续续上桌' to clarify whether implied quick service counts.

decisions.label: Food#Taste
decisions.evidence: 特别喜欢它家的菜品，新鲜度高，品种丰富
decisions.text: 自从第一次用星天广场的代金券尝试了每味每客的冒菜后，立即毫无抵抗力地成为它忠实的粉丝。基本上每周至少都要去吃上一次两次的。现在美团上既有每味每客自己的团购券，也可以用观音桥好吃街的团购券，面额更是有10元，50元可以自由叠加组合。非常好用和贴心。最初的时候团购下来优惠力度比5折还大，现在虽然团购价格一直在上涨，差不多在7折左右了，但是还是比较划算。特别喜欢它家的菜品，新鲜度高，品种丰富，可以随心所欲自由搭配。吃了以后身上不会有火锅的味道。我最爱光顾的是星天广场这个店，干净明亮。员工们永远精神饱满，总之，去了一次，就会不知不觉再去第二次第三次。连爸爸妈妈一起去吃了，也觉得不错。必须好评。推荐。

pass1.label: Food#Taste
pass1.why: The rule was read, but the review praises freshness and variety of the dishes, not their taste, and the model treated general praise of the food as a taste judgment.
pass1.fix: Add a boundary note to Food#Taste that freshness (新鲜度), variety (品种) and portion or ingredient quality do not count as taste, with a few such examples in the case library.

pass2.label: Food#Taste
pass2.why: The review praises the dishes' freshness, variety and free matching but never mentions taste, flavour or texture; the rule says Food#Taste applies only when a dish's taste or mouthfeel is judged, yet 6 of 6 arms made the same call and the label shares 94.5% of cases, so the gold omits a label that the dataset's own convention tends to attach to dish praise.
pass2.fix: Rule edit: state explicitly whether general dish praise (新鲜、品种丰富、特别喜欢菜品) without a taste word counts as Food#Taste, and add contrasting cases to the library so the convention is unambiguous.

decisions.rejected_reason: 只说干净明亮，未评价装修风格

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The decoration rule was never read, so the flow did not check whether 干净明亮 (bright, clean look) also falls under the decoration or atmosphere (氛围) criteria.
pass1.fix: Make the flow check every ambience label's rule whenever any ambience word appears, and add a rule note that brightness or lighting describing the look of the room counts as 氛围 for Decoration.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review says only 干净明亮 about the shop, which the rule assigns to Sanitary, and the agent never read the Decoration rule so it could not weigh the boundary; the gold still labels decoration, which suggests the 'environment' generalisation was applied, but the rule text does not state when a specific clean/bright remark also triggers decoration.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: make the agent read every Ambience rule before deciding and, for specific-only remarks, state the test explicitly; rule edit: clarify that 明亮 (lighting/look) can be read as decoration, with examples.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.rejected_reason: “星天广场”只是门店所在地的名称，未评价餐厅是否靠近商圈

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The rule was never read, and the rule explicitly says that being in a 广场 (plaza) signals the commercial district, which the model overlooked after considering the name as a mere address.
pass1.fix: Add a checklist step that scans for place-type words (广场, 商场, 百货, 步行街, 购物中心) and applies the Location#Downtown rule whenever one appears, even inside a store name.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown
pass2.why: The rule explicitly lists 广场 as a Downtown cue (84% precision) and the agent considered it but rejected it, and the phrase 星天广场 appears in the text; the agent never read the rule, so its flow skipped a rule it needed.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to read the rule for every cue phrase it sees (named plazas, malls) before rejecting a label, and add a self-check that lists each mall/plaza mention against Location#Downtown.

decisions.rejected_reason: “团购价格一直在上涨”只是价格变动的陈述，没有直接评价价格高低，性价比已覆盖

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The Price#Level rule lists 价格 as a trigger, yet also says that prices given without any high or low judgment are usually not labelled, so a neutral note that the group-buy price rose falls between the two rules.
pass1.fix: Clarify in the Price#Level boundary that statements about price increases or decreases (涨价, 降价) count as neutral price-level judgments, and add two or three such cases to the library.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review says 团购价格一直在上涨 and 7折 without a direct high/low judgement; the rule says standalone prices are usually not labelled, but the label shares 50.5% of cases and the gold may reflect the dataset's habit of tagging price-change talk as a price level, so careful labellers could disagree.
pass2.fix: Document as ambiguous; add a few cases where price rises or discount levels are described without a cost verdict, and state in the rule whether they count as Price#Level.

decisions.label: Ambience#Space
decisions.evidence: 人好多啊，都没有坐的地方
decisions.text: 至少对汉堡王没啥感觉，听男友说他家汉堡比KFC好吃而且实惠，我就心动了。开业当天就迫不及待的想去吃，可是人好多啊，都没有坐的地方……无奈我们只能打包带走了。那天关注微信就可以免费的一个甜筒，不过味道一般般，没有麦当劳好吃，吃了几口就全给男友吃了。买了个他家招牌的皇堡，单层的，还是依旧的牛肉馅，不喜欢吃，而且单点比较贵，套餐比较划算，他家的霸王鸡条挺好吃的，有点像鸡柳，他家薯条量也挺少的……下次去吃吃他家的鸡堡吧，感觉挺好吃的。他家除了汉堡貌似其他没啥了……

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The review describes a crowded opening day with no seats, and the rule lists 拥挤 and 位子多 as applying, yet all six arms and the gold disagree, so the gold may be treating this as a temporary situation rather than a lasting space trait.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and add a case clarifying whether crowding or lack of seats on a busy day counts as Ambience#Space.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The review says people are many and there are no seats, which is a waiting/crowding remark about the visit rather than a judgment of the restaurant's space; the gold omits it, and the rule's '拥挤' and '位子多' cues are present but the gold seems to treat this as situational.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note: crowding at opening-day or queue complaints that mention no seats count as Ambience#Space only when the reviewer judges the room itself; otherwise none. Add a few similar opening-day/no-seat cases with gold labels to the case library.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The phrase 量少 is explicitly listed in the rule as applying, and every arm flagged it, so the gold omits a label that the dataset's own convention supports.
pass1.fix: Check the gold for this item and add Food#Portion if the convention holds; add a note that 量少 about a single dish still counts.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The rule covers 量少 and the phrase 薯条量也挺少 is a direct portion judgment, so the gold omitting it looks inconsistent with the rulebook; the model applied the rule correctly as written.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or confirm with the gold owner that 量少 about a side dish counts under Food#Portion, since the rule lists 量少 explicitly.

decisions.text: 至少对汉堡王没啥感觉，听男友说他家汉堡比KFC好吃而且实惠，我就心动了。开业当天就迫不及待的想去吃，可是人好多啊，都没有坐的地方……无奈我们只能打包带走了。那天关注微信就可以免费的一个甜筒，不过味道一般般，没有麦当劳好吃，吃了几口就全给男友吃了。买了个他家招牌的皇堡，单层的，还是依旧的牛肉馅，不喜欢吃，而且单点比较贵，套餐比较划算，他家的霸王鸡条挺好吃的，有点像鸡柳，他家薯条量也挺少的……下次去吃吃他家的鸡堡吧，感觉挺好吃的。他家除了汉堡貌似其他没啥了……

pass1.why: 划算 is listed as applying, but the review compares package and single-item pricing rather than price against quality, and the rule's 'does not apply' clause on 套餐 sits close to this wording, so the two rules seem to point different ways.
pass1.fix: Rule edit: state whether a package-versus-single price value judgement counts as cost-effectiveness, and add a few cases of 套餐划算 with and without a quality comparison.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: 划算 is listed as a cost-effectiveness cue, so the model followed the rule, yet all arms and the gold disagree, suggesting the gold treats 套餐比较划算 as a deal/discount remark rather than value judgment.
pass2.fix: Clarify the rule: 划算 attached to a set meal or promotion is Price#Discount, and Cost_effective applies only when comparing price with product quality; add cases showing 套餐划算 labelled as Discount.

decisions.rejected_reason: Only mentions a free cone from WeChat follow, no assessment of the discount's strength.

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The agent considered the WeChat follow giveaway of a free cone but rejected it without reading the discount rule, which explicitly covers 赠送 and free promotional items, so the flow let a missed rule go unchecked.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: when a review mentions free items, giveaways or follow-for-gift promotions, the agent must read the Price#Discount rule before deciding to exclude it.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The reviewer's free-cone-from-WeChat-follow is a 赠送/免费试吃-type promotion that the rule lists under Discount, but the agent never read the Discount rule and rejected it as not an assessment of discount strength, which the rule does not require.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to check every rule for each candidate phrase, including promotional gifts like 关注微信送、赠送、免费试吃, before rejecting; state that Discount is labelled for the presence of a promotion, not its strength.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 住东门的童鞋们可以一试
decisions.text: 苍蝇馆子是成都特有的产物，不识苍蝇馆子者一定不是成都人我常去的排名进前10的一家苍蝇馆子，地处猛追湾横街，一条不出名的小街，近游泳池。因无店名无招牌无发票被称为三无餐馆。店里狭小，光线略显昏暗，却食客满座,不时有衣着时尚男女进进出出。店里菜品不甚多，也就蒸菜、烧菜、小炒素菜加三两汤菜共20余种，蒸牛肉蒸排骨确实很棒，香辣入味加耙和[色]小菜爽口，烧菜也不错，四个字：价廉味美，难怪食客如云，而况此餐馆很牛，凡国家法定节假日一律放假，星期天不营业，每天卖完关门，不提供发票住东门的童鞋们可以一试

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The phrase 住东门的童鞋们可以一试 is an explicit try-it recommendation to a specific group, which the rule's 值得一试 wording covers, so the agent's label fits the rulebook even though the gold omits it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case where 可以一试 closes a positive review to settle whether it counts as an explicit recommendation.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The review says 住东门的童鞋们可以一试, which is a soft recommendation addressed to a local audience, and the rule's explicit 值得一试 wording makes it borderline; six other arms did not label it, so the gold-vs-rule reading is debatable.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a case where 可以一试 with a target audience is labelled, so the convention is explicit.

pass1.why: The rule is read and the text is about having no sign, name or invoice, which describes the restaurant's notoriety and business status rather than how easy it is to locate; the agent misread a negative-sounding description as a findability judgment.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: add that descriptions of missing signs or names count for Easy_to_find only when the review says the place is hard or easy to find.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The rule was read, but the phrase 无店名无招牌 describes a missing sign and is a fact about the shop's identity rather than a judgement of how easy it is to find; the model over-generalised from the 三无 label.

pass1.why: The rule set says general 环境 evaluations tag all four environment labels, but the review only describes dim lighting and a crowded room, and the boundary text does not say whether lighting or crowding falls under Decoration, so the gold and the agent's reading diverge.
pass1.fix: Rule edit: state explicitly that lighting description alone maps to no decoration label and that Space or Decoration require an evaluative statement about the room's look or layout.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The gold labels 光线略显昏暗 as a decoration/ambience judgement, which is not clearly a decoration grade or style; the rule's general-environment convention only covers 笼统 comments, so the gold looks inconsistent with the stated boundary.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review says nothing about portion size, so the gold label appears inconsistent with the rule that requires an evaluation of quantity; no arm read a portion judgment in the text.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The agent never read the Food#Portion rule, so it had no chance to consider that the portion gold applies; the flow let it skip a relevant label rule.

decisions.label: Service#Timely
decisions.evidence: 添个菜加个火还是一会就有反映的
decisions.text:
临近冬至，这里非常火爆，160一斤都座无虚席。点了羊肉和羊杂汤锅，炒了羊蹄，羊肝，羊血。我是从来不吃血的，猪血都是勉强的吃一块，但这个羊血出乎我的意料，比我想象中要好吃许多。总之，人生第一次吃羊血的体验很好。
店内环境普通，坐着有些冷，为毛吃羊肉的地方都是这么开放式的，不过也比前几次好些了，没有大冬天的在外面搭个蓬子吃，这次总算还是在室内的。
服务还可以，虽然服务员很忙，但是添个菜加个火还是一会就有反映的。

pass1.label: Service#Timely
pass1.why: The rule explicitly covers 出餐快 and 很快就上齐了 as speed judgments, and the quote "添个菜加个火还是一会就有反映的" describes a quick response to add-on requests, which the rule treats as a speed judgment, so the agent applied the rule but the gold omitted it; the reviewer's sentence is a neutral-positive timing remark that a careful labeller could reasonably skip.
pass1.fix: Add a boundary example to Service#Timely stating that 添菜/加火 responsiveness counts as 上菜速度 only when the reviewer explicitly comments on speed, and add 2-3 such cases to the library to settle the convention.

pass2.label: Service#Timely
pass2.why: The review says a dish added or a fire added gets a response 'within a moment', which is a speed judgement on serving, so the rule arguably applies; the agent read the rule and the gold omits it, making this a gold/rule judgement call rather than a clear model error.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and add a worked example where '一会就有反应' or '一会就上' counts as a positive speed judgement on 上菜速度.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: 160一斤只是陈述价格，没有高低评价
decisions.text:
临近冬至，这里非常火爆，160一斤都座无虚席。点了羊肉和羊杂汤锅，炒了羊蹄，羊肝，羊血。我是从来不吃血的，猪血都是勉强的吃一块，但这个羊血出乎我的意料，比我想象中要好吃许多。总之，人生第一次吃羊血的体验很好。
店内环境普通，坐着有些冷，为毛吃羊肉的地方都是这么开放式的，不过也比前几次好些了，没有大冬天的在外面搭个蓬子吃，这次总算还是在室内的。
服务还可以，虽然服务员很忙，但是添个菜加个火还是一会就有反映的。

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The rule says a bare menu or price statement with no high/low judgment is not labelled, and "160一斤" is a bare price, so the rejection was defensible under the text, yet the gold labels it at neutral polarity, which the rule does not explain.
pass1.fix: Edit the Price#Level rule to state that a price mentioned in a crowded/popular context (e.g. 火爆 with a per-jin price) is labelled neutral, or add cases where a bare price stated alongside a value remark is tagged; add more such cases so the convention is explicit.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The rule's 'does not apply' clause says a menu price with no high/low evaluation is not labelled, while the gold labels the bare '160一斤' mention as Price#Level, so the rule and the gold conflict and the agent followed the rule as written.
pass2.fix: Clarify the rule: state whether a bare per-unit price in a review that is otherwise about value or cost is labelled Price#Level, and add cases of bare-price mentions with their gold labels.

decisions.label: Ambience#Sanitary
decisions.evidence: 但愿不是他们的卫生不过关
decisions.text: 为了去青岛啤酒博物馆才来到这里，下了车沿路问人这附近哪有吃，很幸运碰着一个本地的大姐，我说想吃本地的小吃，不要吃海鲜那些，她很热心地指路，根据她的指引，走到差不多路的尽头才找到了这家甜沫肉火烧，据说是当地比较出名的本地店，进去果然人挺不少，可能也刚好是吃午饭的点，看了下大家大多是点了肉火烧和一碗甜沫，除了肉火烧和甜沫，也有其他的包子、粥等选择，因为事前没做多少功课，我也就跟着大家一样点了。甜沫虽然叫甜沫，但却是咸辣味的，里面有胡椒、豆腐、青菜叶，大冷天喝一碗，全身顷刻热乎起来。肉火烧类似肉夹馍又像烧饼，估计都是一个系列的不同叫法而已。不过感觉比肉夹馍好吃很多。边吃自然边认真看起来墙上的介绍，原来相传明末清初年间，天灾战乱，大批难民涌入济南，饥不果腹，一田姓小粥铺，经常舍粥赈济，由于来者众多，难满众求，便在粥内中入大量菜叶并咸辣调料。灾民每当端碗盛粥前，见煮粥的大锅内泛着白沫，便亲切地称之为“田沫”，就是田老板见赈舍的粥。一落难书生，也来此求得此粥，误记为“甜沫”，后考取功名做了官，题写了“甜沫”匾额，从此“甜沫”就一直流传叫到了今天。吃完感觉很好，就想在门面拍照回来好写点评，掌柜大姐很热情，听说是要帮他们宣传，马上招呼我随便拍。真的当时的感觉真的是挺好的。但到了下午，我就越来越感觉不舒服，到了晚上，走着走着直接就呕吐了，把中午吃的东西全回吐出来了。我都来这边一个多星期，第二天就准备飞回广东了，所以应该是不存在水土不服的问题的。也许是胃受不了这么重的胡辣味吧。但愿不是他们的卫生不过关。

pass1.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass1.why: The reviewer only speculates and explicitly hopes hygiene is not the problem ("但愿不是他们的卫生不过关"), and the Sanitary rule is silent on hypothetical or hedged mentions, so the keyword match of 卫生 triggered a label that the gold does not carry, and all six arms made the same error.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note: speculative, hypothetical or hoped-against mentions of hygiene (e.g. "希望不是卫生问题") without a judgment on the restaurant's cleanliness do not apply; add 3-5 such cases to the library labelled no Sanitary.

pass2.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass2.why: The reviewer only speculates, hoping the stomach upset was not caused by unsanitary conditions, and never judges the shop's hygiene; all six arms made the same call, so the gold's omission looks like a deliberate reading of a hedged worry rather than a model error, and the rule's keyword list does not address hedged speculation.
pass2.fix: Add a boundary note to Ambience#Sanitary: a hedged worry or speculation about hygiene (e.g. 但愿不是…卫生不过关) without a stated judgment does not get the label; if the team prefers the literal keyword reading, document this case as ambiguous.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.evidence: 店位于顺德区应江路梁场工业区，不在市区内
decisions.text: 虽然店名叫“蚝”，其实除了吃蚝，这里还有很多生猛海鲜。店位于顺德区应江路梁场工业区，不在市区内，如想来吃饭就只有自己开车来，没有什么公共交通工具了。我们是前两个星期周六来吃晚饭，五点就到了，来得早，有很多位置。我们点了马贝、圣子、带子，蒜蓉蒸 ，火候刚刚好，肉鲜，非常正点，尤其是马贝，真是超级好吃。当晚皇帝蟹特价，原价298元一斤，当天只售99元一斤，我们点了一只3.4斤，清蒸上，巨好吃！这里的海鲜卖点是新鲜、实惠，虽然交通不太便利，但到了六点左右就座无缺席，外面还有很多人在等位，证明确实是酒香不怕巷子深了。饭后我们还点了椰子冻做甜品，据说是原装进口的，38元一个，香甜可口。

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The rule says the label applies only when the restaurant is in or beside a mall, plaza or commercial district; the review explicitly says the restaurant is in an industrial zone and not in the city centre, so the agent's reading of the negated phrase is a flow error rather than a rule gap.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt check: when the text explicitly denies downtown or city-centre location, do not label Location#Downtown; add a few negated-mention cases such as '不在市区内' to the case library.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown
pass2.why: The review explicitly says the restaurant is not in the city centre, which is a negation of the label; the agent applied the rule's keyword 'not in the centre' without noticing the 'Does not apply' logic for negated mentions, and 5 other arms made the same error, so the rule's wording invites matching on the 市区 term.
pass2.fix: Add to Location#Downtown: negative statements such as 不在市区/不在商圈 that place the restaurant away from downtown do not trigger the label unless the review judges the location as a downtown/commercial-area fact; or add a worked example of a negated mention being left unlabelled.

pass1.label: Service#Queue
pass1.why: The review says people are waiting outside for a table, which matches the rule's 等位 trigger, yet all six arms labelled it and the gold omits it, so the gold seems to treat a general crowd remark as not a judgement of queue acceptability.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or clarify in the rule that describing a waiting crowd with no evaluation of the wait counts as Service#Queue only when the reviewer judges the wait.

pass2.label: Service#Queue
pass2.why: The review says diners must wait outside for a seat ('外面还有很多人在等位'), which literally matches the rule's 等位 trigger, and all six arms labelled it, so the gold omission looks inconsistent with the rule's own examples.
pass2.fix: Review the gold: either add the item as Service#Queue to match the rule's '等位' trigger, or add a rule clarification that a crowd-waiting mention that is only a context for a positive remark is not a judgement of queue time and document it as ambiguous.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: “实惠”属于性价比，没有单独评价价格高低
decisions.text: 虽然店名叫“蚝”，其实除了吃蚝，这里还有很多生猛海鲜。店位于顺德区应江路梁场工业区，不在市区内，如想来吃饭就只有自己开车来，没有什么公共交通工具了。我们是前两个星期周六来吃晚饭，五点就到了，来得早，有很多位置。我们点了马贝、圣子、带子，蒜蓉蒸 ，火候刚刚好，肉鲜，非常正点，尤其是马贝，真是超级好吃。当晚皇帝蟹特价，原价298元一斤，当天只售99元一斤，我们点了一只3.4斤，清蒸上，巨好吃！这里的海鲜卖点是新鲜、实惠，虽然交通不太便利，但到了六点左右就座无缺席，外面还有很多人在等位，证明确实是酒香不怕巷子深了。饭后我们还点了椰子冻做甜品，据说是原装进口的，38元一个，香甜可口。

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The agent considered Price#Level but rejected it because 实惠 was read as value-for-money, while the rule lists 实惠 as a trigger for Price#Level and says it is often labelled alongside Cost_effective, so the rulebook contradicts the agent's reasoning on this exact word.
pass1.fix: Edit the Price#Level boundary note to state explicitly that 实惠 triggers Price#Level together with Price#Cost_effective when it is said of the price, and add this review as a worked example.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The agent considered 实惠 and rejected it as cost-effectiveness only, but the rule explicitly lists 实惠 as a Price#Level trigger and the agent never read that rule, so its flow skipped a required check.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt step: for every price-related word (实惠, 便宜, 贵, 价格, 人均), read the Price#Level rule before deciding, and label Price#Level alongside Price#Cost_effective when the review evaluates price.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: Only says prices did not rise; no judgment of whether the price level is high or low.
decisions.text: 记得去年十月份时在香格里拉去的这家餐馆，高反不是很严重但是当地的食物很不习惯，顺着APP找到这家餐厅简直是打开了新世界的大门 老板是山东来的兵哥哥，做的一手好菜，和老板娘一样健谈，会讲很多五湖四海的游客的故事给我们听，还有两个可爱的小盆友，本人平时很讨厌吃白菜可是在这里居然吃掉了半盘的醋熘白菜。。。最后最关键的一点是这家店从开业至今菜品居然没有涨过半毛钱，实在人，在日益商业化的独克宗古城附近非常难得。

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review judges price indirectly ("菜品居然没有涨过半毛钱，实在人" and calls it rare near the commercial old town), but the Price#Level rule lists only explicit wording like 价格, 贵, 便宜, 实惠 and says a bare price statement without a high/low judgment is not labelled, so the rulebook is silent on a no-price-rise judgment and all arms missed it.
pass1.fix: Add to Price#Level's Applies list: 不涨价, 没涨过价, 价格不变, 实在, 划算, and comments that a place is cheap or honest relative to its surroundings, with a positive or negative polarity. Add 2-3 cases like this one labelled Price#Level positive.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The agent never read the Price#Level rule, so it judged the review's "菜品没有涨过半毛钱，实在人" as a price-change remark and not as a positive price-level judgment. Six other arms labelled it, which points to the agent's flow rather than the rule or the gold.
pass2.fix: Edit the prompt so the agent must open the rule text for every aspect in the candidate list before deciding, and add a check for price-cue words (实在, 涨价, 不涨, 划算, 便宜) that triggers Price#Level review.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 本人在此主推汉堡系列、烤翅系列及烤全鸡等小吃系列
decisions.text: 该店位于共青城市北峰路东方超市一楼，地理位置优越，交通行驶便利，车辆停靠方便，且停车位非常充裕。  店内装修比较新潮时尚，非常具有特色，环境氛围格调高雅大气，大厅以二人到四人桌为主，能同时容纳几十位顾客同时品尝就餐，二楼正在装修中，期待早日完成。在本地算是比较高大上的快餐食品连锁店。店内桌椅摆放整齐有序，卫生整洁干净，空调随时开放，让人不禁身心气爽，神情惬意，倍感舒适！比较适合各种中小型朋友聚会及情侣间幽会！  店内老板及工作人员服务态度亲切热情，真的让我体会到了顾客至上的感觉，在此给该店服务态度大大的点个赞……。  该店各式美味汉堡、小吃及饮料等品类繁多，让顾客可以根据自己的个人口味喜好自由挑选搭配。  此店食品均是现场制作，原材新鲜，做工精致，质量上佳，香味浓郁，口感很好，让人回味无穷。本人在此主推汉堡系列、烤翅系列及烤全鸡等小吃系列，口感真的很好。参加本次霸王餐活动的会员们俱赞不绝口。以后只要光临此店都要逐个品尝品尝，大家伙也可以尝尝吧……。  建议该店多多推出一些优惠团购活动以吸引更多的新老顾客光临，本人自然是铁杆，定会时常约起好友前来小聚……

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The reviewer explicitly says "本人在此主推汉堡系列、烤翅系列及烤全鸡", which matches the rule's own criterion of an explicit recommendation, yet the gold omits the label, so the gold looks inconsistent with the rulebook.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule example that "主推" by the reviewer counts as an explicit recommendation and check the gold against it.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The reviewer explicitly says they 'mainly recommend' (主推) the burger, wing and whole-chicken series, which reads as a clear recommendation, but the rule lists only 推荐/特别推荐/很推荐 wording, so the gold label and the rule's examples diverge on '主推'.
pass2.fix: Add 主推, 力荐 and 首推 to the Food#Recommend applies-when examples, with a case like this one, so the rule covers self-stated promotion of specific dishes.

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The agent never read the Ambience#Noise rule, whose boundary note says a generic environment praise tags Decoration, Noise, Space and Sanitary together, and the agent rejected the label without applying that convention.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt step: when a review praises the 环境/氛围 in general terms, open the boundary notes of the four ambience labels and apply the dataset's convention before deciding.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: '环境氛围格调高雅大气' is a general environment judgement, which the Noise rule says to tag, but the Decoration boundary says a specific aspect mention tags only that aspect, so the agent read it as decoration-only while the gold applied the general-environment convention.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the boundary note that '环境氛围' or '氛围' alone counts as general environment and triggers Decoration, Noise, Space and Sanitary, and add this review as an example.

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The Appearance rule lists 精致 as an applicable cue (73%), but the agent did not read that rule and dismissed "做工精致" as craftsmanship rather than checking the cue list.
pass1.fix: Add the Appearance cue words (卖相, 摆盘, 精致, 颜值, 造型, 色泽) to the flow's keyword check so 精致 always triggers a read of the Appearance rule.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: '酥皮叉烧刚出锅的样子'只描述出锅状态，没有评价卖相、摆盘或色泽，不符合外观规则。
decisions.text: 趁着不上班，打算是来宜家逛逛，结果下地铁进了荟聚。哇！逛什么宜家！逛荟聚吧！我们逛了个昏天黑地。到了下午茶时间！选择了避风塘，进店人还不多。就坐下来了。打算来个下午茶➕晚餐。于是点了一大～桌好次次啊！酥皮叉烧包。黄金网肠粉虾。还有沸腾鱼。木桶鸡。和煲仔饭。等等等等。酥皮叉烧刚出锅的样子。酥到好处。叉烧馅料甜咸适中。沸腾鱼是龙利鱼做的，没有刺吃起来爽爆了！黄金网虾，虾肉饱满。鲜！好吃的不要不要的！还有特别推荐冻咸柠七！炒鸡棒啊！蛋挞超大只！不是很甜。味道不错！推荐

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The review says 酥皮叉烧刚出锅的样子 and 酥到好处, which describes freshly served pastry; the rule requires evaluation of looks, plating or color, and the 91%/89% keyword shares suggest this wording is rarely labelled as appearance, so the gold label is debatable.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that describing a dish as freshly served with its look-related state (如刚出锅的样子) counts as appearance only when the review evaluates how it looks.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The phrase 酥皮叉烧刚出锅的样子 plus 酥到好处 describes how the dish looks freshly served and is a plausible visual judgement; the rule's cues (卖相, 摆盘, 色泽) are absent, so the agent's exclusion was reasonable but the gold reading is defensible given that 6 of 10 arms also missed it and the gold is positive.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a case showing that describing a dish as freshly plated or looking appetising counts as Food#Appearance.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: 虾肉饱满 praises the shrimp meat's plumpness, which the rule explicitly excludes from portion, so the gold label seems inconsistent with the rule and the agent's reading is defensible.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a rule example that 饱满 describing ingredient plumpness does not count as Food#Portion, and check whether the gold label was applied through a loose reading of 饱满.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: 虾肉饱满 is a quality description of the shrimp meat, which the rule explicitly excludes unless the review judges quantity, so the gold label looks inconsistent with the rule's own convention and with the agent's correct reading.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.rejected_reason: No comment on portion size.
decisions.text: 超五分评价，第一次来艾美可，算是又发现一处可回顾的店了，首先服务意识非常好，这一点我觉得也是非常重要的，心情好了美食也就更加可口；其次菜品也都是可圈可点的，1.榴莲披萨，吃过各种店的榴莲披萨，他家做的比一些专门店还要好吃2.菲力牛排，单价68元肉嫩味美绝对超值3.法式鹅肝，超好吃啊，不点一份真的是一大损失哦4.芥末三文鱼，我是超喜欢wasabi的味道的啦，所以这个也当然是我最爱吃的5.甜点提拉米苏，手工提拉米苏没有非常甜腻，超赞！6.甜点西番莲乳酪，酸酸甜甜的非常好吃，也很美貌呢7.饮品呢我只喝了皇家奶茶，用料实在味道醇厚，值得推荐。总体来说非常喜欢的一家餐厅，另外他家是清真餐厅哦，期待一下次去探索新的菜品！

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review never mentions quantity, and every arm missed it, so the gold positive label looks unsupported by the text and the rulebook's 分量 triggers.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and check whether this gold label was assigned from outside the text before keeping it.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review never mentions quantity or portion size, so the gold label has no support in the text, and all six arms missed it, which points to the gold label rather than the agent.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or drop Food#Portion from the gold for this item after checking the annotator's basis.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: Price is only praised as worth it, not judged as high or low.

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review gives a specific price (68元) with a value judgement (超值) but no high or low wording, and the rule's trigger for 写出具体花了多少钱并带评价 does not say whether a neutral or positive value remark counts, so five arms skipped it, and the agent never read this rule.
pass1.fix: Add a Price#Level boundary note that a stated price with an evaluative remark such as 超值 or 划算 is labelled neutral, and add two or three cases of this pattern to the case library.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The Price#Level rule covers writing a specific price together with an evaluation, and '单价68元肉嫩味美绝对超值' fits that, but the agent never read the rule and only tagged the value-for-money wording, so the flow skipped a rule it needed.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to scan every review for explicit prices (单价, 人均, 元) and check each against the Price#Level rule before finalising, and add a rule example pairing a quoted price with a praise word such as 超值 to show it counts.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.rejected_reason: 只提到有一张50元优惠券并说快过期，是事实陈述，没有评价优惠力度，按规则不标
decisions.text: 跟室友去的，因为有张50元的优惠券快要过期，所以赶在有效期最后一天去的，环境不错，听说之前是家咖啡厅，现在改撸串了，不过小资的氛围还是继承了下来，服务员还算热情，但是不得不说看起来有点老，点了一些常规的肉串，要了一盘凉菜，一扎玉米汁，感觉靠凤爪和牛蹄筋还不错，其他的没有什么太多两点，室友喜欢烤大虾，应该也是值得推荐的，席间还有个小哥在弹吉他唱歌，调节气氛，总之中规中矩，如果能在食物的口味上下些功夫就更好了，加油，期待味道更上一层楼

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The review mentions a 50-yuan coupon and its near expiry, which the rule's '券' and '优惠' trigger words cover, yet the agent judged it a bare fact; the gold label follows the rule's trigger-word convention, so the gold is arguably right and the agent's reading is a defensible but stricter interpretation that every arm shared.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit and a few cases stating that a mentioned coupon or discount used by the diner counts as Price#Discount even without an evaluative word, and add this review as a worked example.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The reviewer mentions a 50-yuan coupon and its near expiry, and the rule lists 券 and 优惠 as triggers, so the gold reading that the coupon counts as a discount judgment is defensible; the agent's strict 'no evaluation of the deal' reading is not clearly written into the rule, and all six other arms also missed it, which points to the rule and gold rather than the model.
pass2.fix: Edit the Price#Discount rule to state explicitly whether merely mentioning using a coupon or voucher (no evaluation of its value) is labelled, and add a few coupon-mention-only cases with their gold labels to the case library.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 要是去多些人点合算
decisions.text: 过生日去的，送的券。点了很多好吃的。期待已久的麻辣朋友圈，里面有鱿鱼虾螃蟹花蛤，中间是豆腐皮和藕片，很大一锅，要是去多些人点合算。主打生蚝和扇贝，分为烤和蒜蓉两种，烤得快，蒜蓉的好脱壳，两种都是棒棒哒。蟹钳和非主流土豆丝每次必点，酸酸辣辣棒棒哒。环境挺小资，楼上有包间，最好提前定，人多没地方啦，周末上菜也比较慢，大家早点去，周一休息。你没吃过的豆腐，要是人多最好点上，他家的菜品都偏辣，这个里面是泡泡的还有蘑菇，可以中和辣味。粥也好喝，海鲜的。羊肉串5块1串，很大味道很好。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The rule covers 性价比 only when the review compares price with quality, but the phrase 要是去多些人点合算 is a conditional tip about ordering for a group, not a value judgement of the restaurant; the model read 合算 as a value verdict despite the rule being read.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note that conditional ordering advice or 'worth it if you go in a group' without comparing price to quality does not apply, plus a case example.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The phrase "要是去多些人点合算" is a conditional remark about group ordering economics, not a judgement of the restaurant's value for money against quality, so the rule's '拿价钱和东西好坏比' test is not met; all arms made the same error, suggesting the model over-read the word 合算.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note: '合算' tied to conditional advice about ordering more people or portions is not a value judgement unless the review compares price with quality; add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.rejected_reason: “环境挺小资”只具体评价了风格，没有提到嘈杂情况

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The review gives a general 环境挺小资 evaluation, and the boundary rule says general environment comments tag all four environment labels, yet the agent did not read the Noise rule and the boundary text is easy to miss, so the model treated the comment as style-only.
pass1.fix: Move the general-environment boundary rule into the main Ambience instructions and state explicitly that 环境挺小资 (general environment praise) triggers Decoration, Noise, Space and Sanitary together.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: The item says only 环境挺小资 and the general-environment boundary rule says a generic 环境 evaluation tags all four environment labels, so the gold is consistent with the dataset's convention, yet the agent and all arms rejected it by reading the specific-aspect exception; the rule was not read, so the agent did not apply the general-environment convention.
pass2.fix: Keep gold; add an explicit prompt step: when a review gives a generic ambience judgement about 环境 without a specific aspect, apply the four-label convention and reconcile with the 小资 style remark, and document the case as an edge case for the boundary.

decisions.label: Ambience#Sanitary
decisions.rejected_reason: “环境挺小资”没有提到干净与否，未提及卫生状况

pass1.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass1.why: The same general-environment rule that requires Sanitary on a bare 环境 evaluation was not applied; the agent judged that the comment did not mention cleanliness and stopped there.
pass1.fix: Surface the rule that general environment comments tag all four environment labels as an explicit checklist step in the prompt so the agent applies it to 环境-level remarks.

pass2.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass2.why: The same generic-environment convention in the rulebook applies, since 环境挺小资 is a general environment comment and the four-label bundle is standard in the dataset, but the agent never read the boundary rule and treated the style remark as specific.
pass2.fix: Keep gold; make the prompt force reading the Boundary section of every Ambience label whenever a 环境 remark appears, and state that a style-only remark such as 小资 is still a generic environment judgement.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.rejected_reason: “送的券”只是事实陈述，没有评价优惠力度

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The rule lists 券 and 赠送 as triggers and the review says 送的券, yet the agent rejected it as a bare fact, which contradicts the rule's keyword list; the agent did not read the Discount rule and so did not check its triggers.
pass1.fix: Add an explicit flow step to check every Price#Discount keyword (券, 送, 赠送, 团购, 优惠) before finalising, and add a case where 送的券 alone is labelled Discount.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The rule lists 券 and 赠送 as Price#Discount triggers, and the review says 送的券 explicitly, yet the agent judged it as a bare fact; the agent's flow apparently did not check the trigger word list against the text, so it rejected the rule's explicit keyword.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt instruction to scan each item for listed trigger words (券, 赠送, 团购, 优惠) before deciding, and clarify that receiving a voucher counts as a discount mention even without evaluating its size.

decisions.label: Location#Transportation
decisions.evidence: 也不是很远，还有免费快艇做来！
decisions.text:
这个天真的是出游的好时节，朋友把一天的行程都安排好来，我就跟在屁股后面吃吃呵呵就好来，曾呀么曾开心，朋友之前来过介绍说这里吃蟹不错的，也不是很远，还有免费快艇做来！我们也是自己开车过来的，很方便！
上菜咯！
蟹端上来看着我眼睛都放光咯，只只都是很壮的！其实我属于吃不大来的，朋友吃的那个叫个利索，吃的又干净，我两只手都端上来也不及她一只手哦！佩服佩服！蟹腮很白的，肉是甜甜的！真心嗲！如果有机会还要去吃！

pass1.label: Location#Transportation
pass1.why: The rule covers public transport and travel time to a station, but the review's "不是很远" is about distance and the "免费快艇" is a private boat, so the rulebook is silent on both and six of six arms made the same call.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit stating whether distance remarks (不远/很远) and private shuttle boats or ferries count as transportation, with two or three example cases.

pass2.label: Location#Transportation
pass2.why: The review says the place is 'not very far' and has a free speedboat, which is a reasonable reading of accessibility, and the rule's 'Applies when' list is about transport convenience, so the gold omitting it is debatable rather than clearly the agent's error; yet the rule's own examples (交通方便 type phrases, 打车, 离某站) are not present, so the label is weakly supported.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note clarifying whether distance phrases ('不远') or ferry/boat access count as Transportation, and add 3-5 labelled cases of such wording to fix the convention.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review says the reviewer personally can't eat much and that the crabs are big (只只都是很壮的), which is not a clear comment on portion size, so the gold label looks inferred and all six arms, having read the rule, rejected it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that describing individual items as big (个头大) counts as portion only when the reviewer explicitly comments on amount.

pass2.why: The review only mentions that the author could not eat much and that the friend ate a lot, which is about the reviewer's appetite and not a judgement of the dish quantity; the gold portion label is unsupported by the text, and the rule was never read, so the agent correctly rejected it and the miss is only apparent.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or check the gold label; the agent's rejection matches the rule's 'does not apply' spirit for non-quantity statements.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 好划算
decisions.text:
这家拾光甜品开在春熙路南口的米瑞购物广场的四楼，三楼是门面没有座位，要到四楼才是正式营业的地方哈。第一次吃他家还是科华路店了，感觉没多久的时光就开了那么多家分店了，甜品的味道的确还是不错，搞活动也是很优惠的。
环境：这家有些复古怀旧的风格，蛮温馨舒适的感觉，安静雅致，处处装点着小的摆饰，还是很用心的。感觉店面不算大，当然比原来科华路好很多，有不少童学都在这自拍了。
味道：因为自己是榴莲控了，当然最爱榴莲忘返了，而且这款也是团购可选单品中价值最高的一款，直接一个人来了二份，呵呵。还是那熟悉的味道，香草冰很浓郁香甜，糯米球也香香糯糯的，当然还有我最爱的榴莲球，个头不小，有榴莲的香味，但不知道是不是季节不对，感觉榴莲味没有原来那么重了，而且摆盘的造型没那么好看，感觉有些潦草了，不知道是不是团购影响了品质，不希望这样哟。不过还是蛮好吃的哈，谁让我就喜欢吃甜品了。还贴心的配有绿箭口香糖哈，细节处还是做得不错。
团购经典热销单品：榴莲忘返1份34元，招牌杨枝甘露1份28元，爆爆珠杨枝甘露1份29元，芒果白雪黑糯米1份30元，百利甜娘惹豆花1份29元，小丸子杨枝甘露1份29元，最高价值34元，只要9.9元，而且最近每天十点还有立减单，可以立减5元，好划算，就是不那么好抢呀，哭。
服务：他家服务一直不错的啦，很温和周到，团购验证也快，也没有嫌弃哈，服务都挺好的。
他家真的还是一家很有口碑挺火的店，这里位置也不错，市中心，很方便，逛街累了来坐坐，休息下，吃吃甜品，多享受呀，店里生意也挺不错的了。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The rule lists 划算 as a trigger, so the agent applied it correctly, but here 好划算 praises the groupbuy deal's value rather than the restaurant's value for the quality it serves, and all six arms made the same call.
pass1.fix: Add a boundary note: 划算 about a groupbuy price or coupon belongs to Price#Discount unless the review compares that price with the quality of the food.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The rulebook explicitly lists 划算 as a cost-effectiveness cue (71%), so the agent's label follows the rule, and the gold omits it even though the review says 好划算 after comparing the 34元 value with the 9.9元 price.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or correct the gold to include Price#Cost_effective for 划算 comparisons

decisions.label: Location#Easy_to_find
decisions.rejected_reason: “三楼是门面没有座位，要到四楼”只是说明位置，没有评价餐厅是否容易找到
decisions.text:
这家拾光甜品开在春熙路南口的米瑞购物广场的四楼，三楼是门面没有座位，要到四楼才是正式营业的地方哈。第一次吃他家还是科华路店了，感觉没多久的时光就开了那么多家分店了，甜品的味道的确还是不错，搞活动也是很优惠的。
环境：这家有些复古怀旧的风格，蛮温馨舒适的感觉，安静雅致，处处装点着小的摆饰，还是很用心的。感觉店面不算大，当然比原来科华路好很多，有不少童学都在这自拍了。
味道：因为自己是榴莲控了，当然最爱榴莲忘返了，而且这款也是团购可选单品中价值最高的一款，直接一个人来了二份，呵呵。还是那熟悉的味道，香草冰很浓郁香甜，糯米球也香香糯糯的，当然还有我最爱的榴莲球，个头不小，有榴莲的香味，但不知道是不是季节不对，感觉榴莲味没有原来那么重了，而且摆盘的造型没那么好看，感觉有些潦草了，不知道是不是团购影响了品质，不希望这样哟。不过还是蛮好吃的哈，谁让我就喜欢吃甜品了。还贴心的配有绿箭口香糖哈，细节处还是做得不错。
团购经典热销单品：榴莲忘返1份34元，招牌杨枝甘露1份28元，爆爆珠杨枝甘露1份29元，芒果白雪黑糯米1份30元，百利甜娘惹豆花1份29元，小丸子杨枝甘露1份29元，最高价值34元，只要9.9元，而且最近每天十点还有立减单，可以立减5元，好划算，就是不那么好抢呀，哭。
服务：他家服务一直不错的啦，很温和周到，团购验证也快，也没有嫌弃哈，服务都挺好的。
他家真的还是一家很有口碑挺火的店，这里位置也不错，市中心，很方便，逛街累了来坐坐，休息下，吃吃甜品，多享受呀，店里生意也挺不错的了。

pass1.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass1.why: The agent did not read the Easy_to_find rule, which covers 位置显眼 and 招牌明显, and dismissed the floor-location description as mere location information when the text tells readers how to find the shop.
pass1.fix: Make the flow read every rule for location-related candidates before deciding, and add examples such as 'X楼是门面，要到Y楼才营业' or '在某某楼/某某口很好找' as Easy_to_find.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The agent did not read the Easy_to_find rule, which says 位置很好 usually also counts as easy to find, so it dismissed the location remark as mere directions and mapped 位置也不错 only to Transportation.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: require reading every candidate label's rule before rejecting it, and add a worked case showing that a general 位置不错 praise can tag both Easy_to_find and Transportation when it is about the venue itself.

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The rule excludes bare menu prices but the review pairs the groupbuy prices with an evaluation ('最高价值34元只要9.9元'), so the rule is unclear on whether this counts as a price-level judgment, and the gold's neutral polarity for a heavily used label looks inconsistent.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 因为都没吃饱
decisions.text:
这家自助餐厅在很久以前来过几次，印象中还不错的……每次都吃的很饱的出来……这次再来真是失望！没有以前那么多的菜品，而且还少了很多味道！其实以前他们家甜品很出名的，但是这次去吃感觉就很一般，就双皮奶还不错，吃了两个。熟菜多的，但是口味实在是很差，应该说是肉的品质不好……鸡肉吃了几块也是吃不进了，海鲜还可以吧，除了最主要没有三文鱼，气的我同去的同伴呦！问了也说是没有货而已。还好我不吃生食的，倒也无所谓啦╮(╯_╰)╭
牛排什么的还是可以的，还有烤扇贝也不错，烤生蚝就一般般啦，因为没人吃。那个大虾都快被我们包下了！食量果然惊人……我就吃几只不是很喜欢吃冷的，放在火锅里烫烫一转眼也会被吃掉。饮料什么的，就喝了咖啡和红茶，其他不想喝。反正吃到后来也没吃什么吧，因为都没吃饱。

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists 吃不饱 as applying to Food#Portion, so the phrase 因为都没吃饱 is a valid match; the reviewer's sentence is about the reviewer's own fullness after eating, which the rule's examples treat as portion evaluation, so the agent's label follows the rule, and the gold omits it, suggesting the gold reads 没吃饱 as a self-description rather than a judgment of the portion.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit clarifying that 吃不饱 counts for Food#Portion only when it judges the dish quantity (e.g. 量少, 分量不够), not when the reviewer merely describes their own fullness; add a few cases of 'because I was not full' labelled as no Portion.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The phrase '因为都没吃饱' is explicitly listed under Food#Portion's Applies-when ('吃不饱'), so the rule covers it and the agent applied it correctly, yet the gold omits it even though 5 of 11 arms made the same call and the case library labels such wording as Portion in about 45% of cases; the gold looks incomplete rather than the agent being wrong.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; alternatively, if the gold is confirmed, add a note that '没吃饱' stated as the reason for leaving hungry in a buffet context is judged as Food#Portion only when the reviewer evaluates the amount, and add a few contrastive cases to the library.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.evidence: 等位时发现对面就是大名顶顶的太古汇
decisions.text: 这是当地人推荐的店，去了还等位，一等就是半个小时，想必物有所值吧，等位时发现对面就是大名顶顶的太古汇，点了脆皮叉烧，烧鹅，酸牛肉，还有最喜欢的菠萝包，叉烧有点肥，趁热吃还好，凉了就有点腻，烧鹅也还不错，炒牛河还是有点吃不贯，菠萝包有惊喜，等位时发现基本桌桌都点菠萝包，于是入乡随俗也点，有点照片为证，正点，回来家里又要很久吃不到这些正宗的味道了，跟北方比还是有时差的，吃完晚饭9点多了，又散步才回酒店。

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The review only mentions that the Taikoo Hui mall is across the street while waiting; it does not describe the restaurant's own location as being in or near a commercial district, and the rule's trigger is about the restaurant being in or beside a mall, which the review does not state about the restaurant itself.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: label Location#Downtown only when the review says the restaurant itself is in or next to a mall, square, or commercial district; landmarks mentioned as incidental scenery during the visit do not count, and add a case library example of a 'across from mall' remark labelled as not applicable.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown
pass2.why: The review only mentions that the Taikoo Hui mall is across the street while waiting; it does not describe the restaurant's own location as downtown or in a commercial district, though the rule's 'next to a mall' wording could be read to cover it.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note that a landmark mentioned only as incidental context (seen while waiting, passing by) does not count as the restaurant's location; add a few cases of 'mall visible across the road' labelled as not applicable.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 想必物有所值吧
decisions.text: 这是当地人推荐的店，去了还等位，一等就是半个小时，想必物有所值吧，等位时发现对面就是大名顶顶的太古汇，点了脆皮叉烧，烧鹅，酸牛肉，还有最喜欢的菠萝包，叉烧有点肥，趁热吃还好，凉了就有点腻，烧鹅也还不错，炒牛河还是有点吃不贯，菠萝包有惊喜，等位时发现基本桌桌都点菠萝包，于是入乡随俗也点，有点照片为证，正点，回来家里又要很久吃不到这些正宗的味道了，跟北方比还是有时差的，吃完晚饭9点多了，又散步才回酒店。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The phrase 想必物有所值吧 is a speculative remark made before eating, tied to the queue wait, and the reviewer does not actually judge value after tasting; careful labellers could go either way, and the gold omits it even though the rule's trigger phrase is present.
pass1.fix: Rule edit: state whether hedged or pre-meal value expectations (想必, 应该) count as a judgement; until settled, document this case as ambiguous and add similar hedged examples to the case library with an explicit label.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The phrase 想必物有所值吧 is a speculative expectation written before eating, not a judgement of the restaurant's value, yet the rule lists 物超所值 as a trigger and the gold omits it, so the gold may be inconsistent with the rule's own examples.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the rule that the value judgement must be an actual assessment of the meal, not a hypothetical or expectation; add this case as a negative example, or if the gold is intended to be generous, add it as a positive example to resolve the inconsistency.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 推荐猪腰肠，猪腰很爽
decisions.text:
这间店开了6年，最近成为了我的饭堂。刚开的时候，出品只有粥和肠粉，而且那肠粉很厚，很难吃，所以让我吃一吃就难忘了好久：不能帮衬的店。
  最近，因为我们单位的同事吃这店（就在我们单位附近）的人越来越多，我又跟着她们去了一次。这次让我对它的印象大为改观。粥，很绵，很香。拉肠，很薄，很滑，而且肉挺多的，推荐猪腰肠，猪腰很爽，而且不会有那股内脏特有的腥味。饭是瓦锅焗的，很有饭味，但菜比较淡，对于“食肉兽”来说是不够的，而且它家没有煎荷包蛋类的单独点的食物，所以到后来估计会吃白饭。
  它家现在最差的食品是油条，粉太多了，放一会就很软，难以下咽。
  环境一般吧，位置比较少。如果单位或家在附近，中午还是叫外卖比较好。

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The reviewer explicitly says "推荐猪腰肠", which matches the rule's "推荐他家的某某" pattern and the boundary note that an explicit 推荐 adds Food#Recommend, so the gold omitting it looks incomplete and all six arms made the same call.
pass1.fix: none: relabel the gold to add Food#Recommend for 猪腰肠 (an explicit first-person recommendation), and check other gold items for explicit 推荐 left unlabelled.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The review explicitly says "推荐猪腰肠" with praise for the dish, which matches the rule's explicit-recommendation trigger, yet the gold omits it; the rulebook's own rule that explicit 推荐 plus praise counts is not clearly applied in the gold, so the gold looks inconsistent with the rule's wording.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a case library example of "推荐X，X很爽" to clarify whether an explicit 推荐 of a specific dish with praise is labelled Food#Recommend.

decisions.label: Service#Queue
decisions.evidence: 看到这家店在排队，于是不能忍，立刻上网找团购
decisions.text: 逛大悦城的时候口渴了，看到这家店在排队，于是不能忍，立刻上网找团购，还真被我发现了！四选一，我们正好四个人，一人一杯！我选的红豆奶茶，很好喝！甜度正好，红豆给的也很足，价钱简直就是超值！另外朋友的布丁奶茶也很不错！喜欢！店员的服务态度也超好，验券速度很快，购买体验感觉超棒！朋友还另外买了他家的金桔柠檬双钻，据说非常好喝呢！这家店的位置非常好找，就在大悦城负一层，老张牛肉面往里走！呷哺呷哺的对面！推荐大家去哦

pass1.label: Service#Queue
pass1.why: The reviewer saw a queue and went to buy a group deal instead; the queue is only the trigger for the purchase, not a judgement of how acceptable the waiting time was, so the rule's 'time acceptable' test is not met, and the agent seems to have matched the word 排队 without applying that test.
pass1.fix: Add to Service#Queue's Does not apply list: 'only mentions seeing a queue or people lining up as a reason for going elsewhere or buying a deal, with no judgement of the wait'; add a few such cases to the library.

pass2.label: Service#Queue
pass2.why: The review mentions seeing a queue only as the trigger for buying a group deal; it does not judge whether waiting was acceptable, so the Queue rule's 'is the wait acceptable' test is not met, and the model misread a mention of queuing as an evaluation of it.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note: a queue mentioned only as background or motivation, with no judgement of the wait, does not apply Service#Queue; add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: 只说价钱超值，属于性价比而非价格高低
decisions.text: 逛大悦城的时候口渴了，看到这家店在排队，于是不能忍，立刻上网找团购，还真被我发现了！四选一，我们正好四个人，一人一杯！我选的红豆奶茶，很好喝！甜度正好，红豆给的也很足，价钱简直就是超值！另外朋友的布丁奶茶也很不错！喜欢！店员的服务态度也超好，验券速度很快，购买体验感觉超棒！朋友还另外买了他家的金桔柠檬双钻，据说非常好喝呢！这家店的位置非常好找，就在大悦城负一层，老张牛肉面往里走！呷哺呷哺的对面！推荐大家去哦

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The rule's Applies list is keyed on explicit level words (贵, 便宜, 实惠), and 超值 is a value judgement the rule assigns to Cost_effective; the boundary line says to tag both only when price level is discussed, which the review does not state directly, so the rule gives no clear answer, yet the gold tags Price#Level and most arms also missed it.
pass1.fix: Edit Price#Level's Applies list to include 超值 and 划算 as price-level signals when the reviewer judges the price as low relative to the product, and state in the Cost_effective boundary that such words tag both labels.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The rule was never read, and the Price#Level boundary text only says price level is labelled when price is discussed, so the model followed the Cost_effective reading ('超值' is value-for-money) and rejected Level; the gold label expects Level alongside Cost_effective when price height is also judged, and the rule's example set includes 实惠 and 便宜, which the review's 超值 and 价钱 phrasing is close to, so the boundary is unclear.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to read every label's rule before finalising, and add the explicit clause that 超值/划算 with a price comment about cheapness (价钱...超值 implies low price) triggers both Cost_effective and Level, with a supporting case.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.evidence: 环境嘛，因为人多肯定很嘈杂，除了这个总体来说还不错
decisions.text:
逛完西湖出来时候选择的就餐地点，已经一点多了，人还是很多，排队了三十来桌，好在就餐速度比较快，没有等太长的时候就可以就餐了！
团购了一个套餐，分量都蛮足的，比较划算！
龙井虾仁：说实话，虾仁不新鲜，上面裹了过多的生粉，失望！
东坡金牌扣肉：肥而不腻，裹着面皮吃味道还不错！
蒸鲈鱼：最满意的一道菜，因为鱼肉很新鲜，做法也独特，下面放着肉末，和大颗的蚕豆带壳的那种，喜欢吃！
荷塘小炒：有菱角，藕带，莲子，虾仁，木耳，青红椒，很清爽的一道菜，唯一不好的藕带是真空包装的那种泡椒的，如果是新鲜的会更好！
藕行藕素：对于喜欢吃甜的人来说，可以一试，蛮不错的！
地方蛮大的，可以容纳很多人就餐，环境嘛，因为人多肯定很嘈杂，除了这个总体来说还不错！上菜速度也蛮快的，！

pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or correct the gold to match the rule that general environment praise tags Decoration, Noise, Space and Sanitary together.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The sentence is a generic 环境 evaluation (环境嘛…总体来说还不错), and the rule says such generic comments tag all four environment labels, so the agent's Decoration tag is consistent with the dataset convention, yet the gold omits it; the agent did not read the rule, but the gold appears inconsistent with the rulebook.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a gold-check note that generic 环境 praise tags Decoration, Noise, Space and Sanitary together, and confirm whether the gold dropped Decoration here.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.rejected_reason: Only states the restaurant's location as a fact, with no evaluation of the commercial area.
decisions.text: 青岛市政府西侧新开了家万象城，里面有大名鼎鼎的船歌渔水饺。水饺种类多样，有墨鱼水饺、黄花鱼水饺、鲍鱼水饺、鲅鱼水饺等73种水饺。各种水饺风味各异，很多都有独特的风味。我觉得水饺作为北方人的重要食物之一，对饺子的创新，推陈出新，是一件很有意义的事情。尤其对推广北方饮食文化有重要意义。对于青岛这样的北方海滨城市，海鲜遇上饺子是必然，也是很有前景的发展方向。这家水饺或许不能满足很多人的口味，也或许没有满足很多人对耳目一新的需求，但确实是一家难得的综合性饺子主题的专门店。但总体而言，饺子做得还不错，有革新，有坚持。当然，皮馅比可以搭配得更合理些，海鲜馅可以做得更鲜味些，但瑕不掩瑜。加之环境卫生、上菜迅速，即使人流客流比较多，但也有不错的用餐体验。虽然某些菜式稍贵，但值得一试。尤其是对饺子情有独钟的食客。

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The agent never read this label's rule, which says a restaurant inside a mall such as 万象城 counts as commercial-area, so the agent judged the phrase as a bare location fact and skipped the rule that applies.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step that checks each candidate label's Applies-when list against named malls and plazas before rejecting it, and add cases where a restaurant 'in 万象城' gets Location#Downtown.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown
pass2.why: The agent considered this label but never read its rule, which says that a mall or plaza mention (here 万象城) counts as commercial-area positioning, so the flow let it skip a rule that applied.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt step that requires reading the rule for every label whose cue words appear in the text, such as 商场, 广场 or 万象城, before rejecting it; add a few mall-name cases to the Downtown rule.

decisions.label: Location#Easy_to_find
decisions.rejected_reason: No comment on how easy it is to find.
decisions.text: 青岛市政府西侧新开了家万象城，里面有大名鼎鼎的船歌渔水饺。水饺种类多样，有墨鱼水饺、黄花鱼水饺、鲍鱼水饺、鲅鱼水饺等73种水饺。各种水饺风味各异，很多都有独特的风味。我觉得水饺作为北方人的重要食物之一，对饺子的创新，推陈出新，是一件很有意义的事情。尤其对推广北方饮食文化有重要意义。对于青岛这样的北方海滨城市，海鲜遇上饺子是必然，也是很有前景的发展方向。这家水饺或许不能满足很多人的口味，也或许没有满足很多人对耳目一新的需求，但确实是一家难得的综合性饺子主题的专门店。但总体而言，饺子做得还不错，有革新，有坚持。当然，皮馅比可以搭配得更合理些，海鲜馅可以做得更鲜味些，但瑕不掩瑜。加之环境卫生、上菜迅速，即使人流客流比较多，但也有不错的用餐体验。虽然某些菜式稍贵，但值得一试。尤其是对饺子情有独钟的食客。

pass1.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass1.why: The review only gives a landmark-based position ('市政府西侧', 'in 万象城') with no judgement of findability, so the gold neutral tag is debatable and the rule's '位置显眼' trigger does not clearly fit.
pass1.fix: Document as ambiguous, or add a rule stating whether landmark-based directions alone count as findability (neutral) and add a few labelled cases.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The review never comments on how easy the restaurant is to find, and all six other arms also missed it, so the gold label looks unsupported by the text rather than a case the agent misread.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and check whether the gold label should be removed because no finding-related wording appears.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 海参拇指包看着新鲜好玩，有点像生煎，底部非常清脆
decisions.text:
青椒鱼看似清淡却是非常爱的味道，吃到嘴里才领教到这辣味，后劲十足。如果你可以吃鱼杂，这里的鱼杂做得也很棒，推荐一尝！海参拇指包看着新鲜好玩，有点像生煎，底部非常清脆。一口吃一个非常过瘾，拇指包里面不全是海参，还有部分虾仁，口感丰富。
喜欢小炒的江西味道，口味也有差异，辣椒入味，炒制黄牛肉或小炒鱼都是不错的下饭菜。还有余干豆腐，老豆腐炖煮的入味实在。江西米粉不同于湖南、桂林或云南，有着独特的风味，凉拌或者炒制都是不错的选择，凉拌粉并非凉，微微热气但清凉爽口很有风味。
推荐：江西米粉、余干豆腐、豫章酥鸡、瓦罐汤、海参拇指包、青椒鱼。
环境：新装修后的餐厅非常通透整洁，用餐舒服。
服务：店主是江西人，服务员上菜快，很有服务意识。
交通：地铁10号线健德门站（D口出），步行1.2公里即到。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The quote "看着新鲜好玩，有点像生煎，底部非常清脆" does mention look and shape, which is the rule's territory, but the rule's exclusion on freshness wording and the reviewer's focus on texture make the appearance judgement weak; the model read the surface word 看着 and the rule was available, so this is a reasoning slip rather than a missing rule.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt check: when a look-related phrase is paired with taste or texture comments, label appearance only if the reviewer judges the visual form (shape, colour, presentation), and add a few cases of 看着+形状 versus 看着+口感 to the case library.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The review says the 海参拇指包 looks fresh and fun and resembles 生煎 with a crispy bottom; the 'looks' wording is about shape and novelty, which arguably fits 造型, so the label is not clearly wrong, but the rule's 'does not apply' for freshness and the 'looks' phrasing made the model's read debatable, and the other six arms did not make this error, so it leans toward a model misreading rather than a rule or gold defect.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case where 看着好玩 or 造型 describes a dish shape to clarify whether visual description of a dish counts as Appearance.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 在5A景区里却价格很实惠，份量也足
decisions.text: 面馆的地址就在龙门石窟景区里的白园电瓶车站旁边，方便易到。店铺的装修比起一般的面馆算很有格调了，有空调，茶水需要自助，先付后食，但重点是在5A景区里却价格很实惠，份量也足，就是味道个人感觉偏咸一点，好像西北风味的味道都偏重一点。这里主食供应汤面和烩面，也有很多凉菜可供选择，汤面便宜的10元就有交易，贵的也就20元左右，端上来都是大大的一碗。我们两人各点了一个汤面，一个10元一个15元，埋单共25元，吃得饱饱的，呵呵，就可惜当时有点匆忙忘了给食物拍照了。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review says 价格很实惠 in a 5A scenic spot with generous portions, which the rule maps to 实惠 and to Price#Cost_effective, yet the rule also says a bare cheapness statement without comparing price to quality does not apply, and the agent's reading that portion size is a value comparison is debatable; the gold labelled only Price#Level and Food#Portion, and every arm made the same call, so the rule-to-gold mapping is the problem.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule edit clarifying that 实惠 alone with no explicit quality-for-price comparison (e.g. 份量足 phrasing) goes to Price#Level, and add cases of 实惠 paired with portion/quality description labelled as Price#Level only.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says 价格很实惠 with 份量也足 in a 5A scenic area, which reads as value-for-money comparing price against portion, so the agent's label is defensible; yet the gold omits it even though the rule's own cue list includes 实惠 and the boundary note says 实惠 with price talk gets both labels, so the gold seems inconsistent with the dataset's convention.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a gold-check note that 实惠 plus a portion or quality comparison counts as Cost_effective alongside Price#Level.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 之前买充值卡很划算
decisions.text: 食堂菜不好，五个人，改善一下伙食用闪惠付款，140左右。每个人点了一份拌饭，最喜欢的还是28块的传统全州拌饭。烤鱿鱼有点偏惺，今天的烤五花肉特别油，感觉像是炸的而不是烤的。拌饭推荐微辣的那个酱，口味不错。另外，点了一份海鲜豆腐汤，之前点过泡菜火锅，感觉也是不错的，人多适合点火锅。之前买充值卡很划算，今天用的闪惠付款，还有一个减十元的优惠，省了四十几块，好几次中午去人都是比较多，拌饭和五花肉需要多等待一会，总体来说，比较快，不会浪费很多时间。今天经理不在，感觉服务员的素质还是有待提高的！

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The review says the earlier recharge-card purchase was 划算, which the rule lists as a cue, but all six other arms also labelled it and the gold omits it, so the gold may be treating a past card purchase as outside the restaurant's value judgement.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule edit stating whether judgements of past prepaid-card purchases count as cost-effectiveness.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The review says 之前买充值卡很划算, which literally uses the word 划算 that the rulebook lists as a cost-effectiveness marker, yet it concerns buying a prepaid card rather than the restaurant's value for money, and 6 of 6 arms made the same call, suggesting the gold omits it while the rule reads as matching.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note: 划算 about the card purchase or a discount mechanism is not a judgement of the restaurant's value; add 2-3 cases of 划算 tied to payment or card deals labelled as not Cost_effective.

decisions.label: Ambience#Sanitary
decisions.evidence: 总体评价环境优雅
decisions.text: 餐厅位于八佰伴商圈，靠近世纪大道地铁站，交通十分便利，这家店走的是精品川菜路线，装修很古朴素雅，晚上顾客盈门，吃川菜和吃火锅的各占一半，服务挺亲切的，推荐钵钵鸡，香辣清江鱼，十八香小龙虾和粉蒸五花肉，糯米鸭，感觉很出众，干炸藕夹和生煎包很一般，有点失望，吃川菜，配上酸梅汤很解辣，价格还算平价，人均一百，用上大众点评的满200送60点券，或者团购就更优惠了，值得推荐，总体评价环境优雅，口味地道，精品川菜，好吃不贵

pass1.fix: Check the gold against the general-environment convention in the Ambience rules; if the convention holds, correct the gold to include Sanitary, or add a case showing that general 环境 praise does not trigger the four-label rule.

pass2.label: Ambience#Sanitary

pass2.fix: Add a case to the rulebook explicitly stating whether a bare 环境 praise tags Sanitary and Space, and align the gold with the stated convention for these generic-environment cases.

pass1.why: The complaint is about the number of waiters ('服务员少点') and a manager-like server, which is staffing rather than attitude, while the rule lists 服务员 as a trigger word, so the rule does not settle whether staffing counts as hospitality.
pass1.fix: Add a boundary line: staffing levels with no comment on attitude or hospitality go to a non-attitude label or none; add cases showing 服务员少 handled this way

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The reviewer explicitly criticises the waiter count and says later dishes were brought by a manager-looking person, which is a judgment about service staff, so the rule's '评价了服务人员就两个都标' applies; the gold omission contradicts the stated boundary rule.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or re-check gold against the Service#Hospitality boundary note about evaluating service staff.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.rejected_reason: The 环境 opener only describes the setting (residential courtyard, two floors, street stalls); no overall evaluation of 环境 is given, so the generic-环境 rule does not trigger.

pass1.fix: Prompt edit: when a review opens a section with 环境 or 装修 and describes the setting, apply the general-环境 rule and tag the four environment labels, using neutral polarity when no judgment is given; the rule should be read before rejecting it

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review opens with a general 环境 description, and the rule says general 环境 evaluations tag all four environment labels, but the opener is descriptive rather than evaluative, so the agent and the gold disagree on whether a general-环境 judgment exists; the rule does not define what counts as an evaluation.
pass2.fix: Add a rule clarifying whether neutral descriptive 环境 passages (setting, layout) count as general 环境 evaluations, with a worked example from this case.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 绿秋葵看上去很有食欲
decisions.text:
之前来青岛就想来这个店吃饭，地方算挺好找的，店面在一个巷子口离公交站很近，对面是青岛美术馆。周围都 小资情调的氛围，很不错。
中午来吃只有老板一个人，态度冷冷的觉得很酷，话不多说明做菜很用心，哈哈。
凉拌秋葵，很爽口，配上芥末和酱油刚刚好，绿秋葵看上去很有食欲。
牛肉土豆饼，外壳很酥脆，里面的馅料很香，有牛肉的香味。
鲜虾乌冬面，大虾吃的很过瘾，青岛就是好海鲜个头都很大，乌冬的汤也很鲜美。
参观了下店面，很小，吧台坐不了几个人，里面的小包间适合几个朋友私密聚会，在青岛找到这样的小店也算是难得了，有机会一定还要再来。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The phrase 绿秋葵看上去很有食欲 is a visual appeal comment that matches the rule's 卖相/颜色好看 cases, yet all six arms also tagged it, so the rule wording and the gold label likely diverge on whether appetite-appeal of a visible colour counts.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note clarifying whether 看上去很有食欲 or colour-based appeal counts as 外观, and add a few labelled cases of '看上去/颜色' comments to settle the convention.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The review says 绿秋葵看上去很有食欲, which is a visual appeal comment on the dish and matches the 卖相 wording, yet the rule's 'does not apply' list and the 41% share for freshness-type wording make the gold reading contestable; all six arms made the same call, pointing to the gold or rule rather than the model.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add an explicit rule that 看上去有食欲/看着诱人 counts as Food#Appearance so the convention is stated.

pass1.fix: Add a rule clarification: state whether praise of ingredient size or 吃得过瘾 with a dish counts as 分量, and add labelled cases of 个头大/吃得过瘾 wording.

点了每桌必点的奶酪罐子，男票很喜欢吃，我也还可以～分三层，每层味道都不一样。

男票要的墨汁饭，我要的意大利面

意面味道也还不错，他家那个彩虹沙拉真的推荐一下，东西很全～略微小贵
两个人 一杯咖啡，两份主食，一个奶酪罐子，一个沙拉花了200+还是挑的评价高的，只能说偶尔小资一下去吃，性价比有点低了

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The review opens by praising 环境 in general terms ('高端大气上档次…请让我这样不恰当的形容它的环境'), which the Noise rule's boundary section says must carry all four environment labels; the agent never read that rule and rejected Noise because no noise was mentioned.
pass1.fix: Add a flow step: when a review praises or criticises 环境 without naming a specific aspect, read the Ambience boundary note and tag Decoration, Noise, Space and Sanitary together.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: The review opens by praising "它的环境" in general terms, which the Ambience#Noise boundary rule says to label with all four environment tags. The agent never read that boundary rule (rule_read is false), so it judged only the decoration words.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: when any Ambience label is considered, require reading every Ambience rule, including the boundary notes, before rejecting a tag. Add a step: if the text praises or criticises 环境 generally, apply the four-tag convention (Decoration, Noise, Sanitary, Space) unless a specific aspect is named.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.rejected_reason: 只陈述周四闪付半价这一事实，没有评价优惠力度
decisions.text: 不知为什么要把寿司翻译成酥食，老板以前卖核桃酥的吗？冲着周四闪付半价来的，当然要想着凑到一百啦。酥食海鲜刺身饭，一次能尝到多个品种，自然是首选，分量适中吧，虽然生冷好在不油腻，三文鱼腩虽然没有入口即化的鲜嫩，油脂还算丰富，海草一直都不喜欢，怎么调味都会有腥味。寿司选了炙烤的，有肉松的会更香。牛油果沙拉里面牛油果很少，也无清香。酱油偏咸，芥末够劲，茶水基本没味道。装修其实不搭，楼梯口那些蒸笼不知所谓，挂的画又是朋克风，老板看来是个随意的人。

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The review states a discount fact (周四闪付半价) and frames the visit around it, which fits the rule's 'applies when' examples, but the agent dismissed it because no evaluation of the discount's strength was given; the rule does not say a bare mention of a discount is insufficient, so the gold label is defensible under the dataset's convention while the agent's reading is also reasonable.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit to Price#Discount stating that naming a concrete discount offer (e.g. 半价, 闪付优惠) counts even without evaluative wording, plus two or three cases of bare discount mentions labelled as Price#Discount.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The review states a Thursday flash-pay half-price offer and says the reviewer came for it and planned to reach 100 yuan, so the discount is mentioned as a fact that shaped the visit; the rule lists 优惠 and 活动 as applicable, yet the agent never read the rule and six other arms also missed it, suggesting the gold is debatable rather than a clear model error.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a case showing that a stated discount the reviewer acted on counts as Price#Discount even without an evaluative remark.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.evidence: 环境，一般的快餐厅
decisions.text:
为了打发午饭。其实是被榴莲披萨吸引进去的，最后却点了新奥尔良，i dont know why.好在味道还不赖。披萨饼皮松软，料多而且丰富，然而不能拉丝。培根只能说太油了，空口吃好奇怪，还是配三明治比较搭一点吧。凤尾虾？酥脆的口感挺讨人喜欢的。至于意面，感觉像微波加热就端出来了。意面酱真心不入味，完全是面和酱分离的状态，虽然表面上看起来满满都是酱……
服务的话，因为周末，人超级多，等了快四十分钟，就上来一瓶可乐，也是醉。
环境，一般的快餐厅，比较小，略拥挤。
位置，近江地铁站附近。
还有外卖服务，哪天不想出门吃饭，点一个十寸管饱两餐……

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.rejected_reason: 除“料很足”外无分量评价
decisions.text: 位置很好找，新六中南侧便是，门外停车也蛮方便的。一楼装潢跟其他生态酒店的规格无大差，小桥，流水于坐落其中的景亭相得益彰，想必品尝美食的同时也可以一饱眼福。聚餐订的二楼包间，装修的一般，倒是墙上的字画添了几分雅致。服务生态度不错，上菜速度也可以，炸鸡翅最先上桌，但没有想象的酥脆，金瓜米饭也好一般，那个什么剁椒鱼有点腥，不喜欢。烤鸭凑合，有点凉了。铁板海鲜挺好的，花蛤什么的很新鲜，肉质鲜美可口。最推荐的是他家的毛血旺，料很足啊，口感也不错，就连里面的宽粉都好好吃，牛肚是我吃过的毛血旺里面最软的，很入味，只是要等至少二十分钟才上桌。小烧饼刚烤出来真心好次，咸味再重点就更好了。期间有个帅哥上来给我们合影留念，印制的马克杯也是业界良心啊，送的果盘也很用心，总体还不错。

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The agent read the Food#Portion rule and considered "料很足啊", but dismissed it because it describes ingredients rather than quantity, even though 量足 is a listed trigger and most other arms caught it.
pass1.fix: Add 料足、料多、料很足 to the Food#Portion applies-when list with a note that generous ingredient quantity counts as portion.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review says "料很足" about the mao xue wang, which is a direct portion-sufficiency judgment, and the rule covers 量足/分量 wording, yet the agent read the rule and rejected it, so the miss is a misreading of the text rather than a rulebook gap.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note that 料很足/料足 (ingredients plentiful) about a dish counts as Food#Portion, with a few such cases in the library.

decisions.label: Ambience#Space
decisions.evidence: 室内大大小小的摆台有近二十张桌子
decisions.text:
九九羊泉水涮锅特色烧烤位于大济宁主城区的太白楼东路与建设路交汇处的东南角，也就是济宁饭店对面的雅戈尔男装（应该是原来的华力大厦）向南8米路东，店对面是一块老大老大的停车场呦，交通便利，视野开阔。老板绝绝对对的会选址……
九九羊泉水涮锅特色烧烤，开了有个两三年时间了，店家一直做的不错，去年经常来，老板特实在，今年一限制室外烧烤，去的有点少了，但是经常还去尝尝鲜。
九九羊泉水涮锅特色烧烤的门面不大，但是里面别有洞天，室内大大小小的摆台有近二十张桌子，一般人是想不到的~
店家把烧烤炉挪到了室内前厅，开始担心是不是会有味道呢？还不错，老板用的新型环保无烟烧烤炉，烟都处理掉了~
店家羊肉非常赞呦，是鱼台清真寺的直供食材，有专门的清真标志和保证书。
他家的烤鸡爪，烤鸡翅味道也很赞的。

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The rule reads 'bigger/smaller space or many seats' as applying, and the phrase '近二十张桌子' is a factual count rather than a judgment of space size, so the model over-read a neutral fact as a space evaluation even though it had the rule.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note that counting tables or seats without a size judgment (e.g. '有近二十张桌子' alone) does not apply; add a few such neutral-count cases to the library.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The phrase 摆台有近二十张桌子 is a count of tables, which the rule would count as seat/table size; but the review makes no judgment of space, and six arms made the same error, so the rule's '位子多' trigger likely read too loosely.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note: a bare count of tables or seats without a judgment of spaciousness or crowding does not apply; add 3-5 cases of neutral table counts labelled as not applicable.

九九羊泉水涮锅特色烧烤的门面不大，但是里面别有洞天，室内大大小小的摆台有近二十张桌子，一般人是想不到的~
店家把烧烤炉挪到了室内前厅，开始担心是不是会有味道呢？还不错，老板用的新型环保无烟烧烤炉，烟都处理掉了~
店家羊肉非常赞呦，是鱼台清真寺的直供食材，有专门的清真标志和保证书。
他家的烤鸡爪，烤鸡翅味道也很赞的。

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.rejected_reason: No comment on how the chestnuts look; only quality (no rotten ones) is mentioned.
decisions.text:
北京怀柔野板栗位于翠花街街口，临近警钟街公交车站~这家在绵阳开了好多年。卖各种干货，品质好，价格相对较高。板栗是这家的畅销品，每年天气转凉后，就开始售卖，每次去客人都络绎不绝，在这家买板栗可以放心，绝对买不到烂的。大颗粒和小颗粒价格不一样，个人觉得大颗粒比较香、小颗粒口感更甜。
因为产品卖出口碑，老板还是多夯的，完全不接受讲价，要买就买~不买不怕卖不出去。而且客人买直接装袋，不给挑~老板拍胸口保证质量，没有烂的。NB哟

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The review judges only chestnut quality (no rotten ones) and size-based taste, with nothing about how the chestnuts look; the rule's appearance cues (卖相, 摆盘, 颜值, 色泽) are absent, so the gold label looks inconsistent with the rule and with every arm's reading.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or check whether the gold annotator treated '大颗粒/小颗粒' (size grading) as appearance and, if so, add a rule note that size grading alone counts as Food#Appearance.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The review never comments on how the chestnuts look; it only says none are rotten, which is a quality/freshness judgment the rules explicitly exclude from appearance, so the gold label looks unsupported by the text.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or have the gold annotator justify it from the text; the agent's omission matches the rule's 'freshness is not appearance' exclusion.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.evidence: 感觉小贵
decisions.text: 十多年前来望京就看到过，也吃过，感觉小贵，味道不错。后来很久很久没来了。前些日子逛完超市，懒得回家做饭，就想来这里看看，人还真吧少，就为了来吃饺子，所以其他菜都没点，虾仁的，老妈超级喜欢，里面有完整的大虾啊，味道很鲜美，根本不要蘸调料，就吃饺子原味，很好吃的。我比较喜欢素食，素三鲜是首选，味道也是很好。其实他家的饺子真的都很好吃，皮算不上薄，但是很滑，有嚼头，馅料都很新鲜，基本都不要蘸料，就是个原味，很好吃的。吃完会员还有折扣，还可以刷积分，攒积分，很超值的！他家饺子可以带生的回家自己煮，非常方便呢。

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review says "感觉小贵" about a visit more than ten years ago, a past impression, while the current visit's judgement is "超值"; the rule's "同时谈到价钱高低时两个都标" boundary supports Level, yet the dominant reading across all arms is that the stale remark is not a current price-level judgement, so gold omitting it reflects a defensible reading.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note: price-level judgements about a past visit that the review contradicts with a current evaluation are not labelled; add two or three similar 'years ago it was expensive, now it is fine' cases to the library.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review explicitly says 感觉小贵 (feels a bit expensive) with a clear price judgment, so the rule's 贵 trigger applies and the agent's label looks correct; the gold omits it, and every arm also labelled it, which suggests the gold is incomplete rather than the model being wrong.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that an explicit 贵/便宜 judgment about the past visit counts for Price#Level even when the review is otherwise positive on value.

decisions.text: 去过多次了，这一次发现换了餐具，忍不住点评一下。中国元素的碗碟，杯具，加上尖头筷，是我喜欢的图案，表扬，点赞，可是使用中发现有多个餐具已破损，甚至有份餐具还留有粉丝的痕迹，让人不禁怀疑清洗流程与食品卫生！！！金奖蝴蝶骨让人期待，但出品我不甚满意，酱汁带甜，排骨腌制处理碱味却又太重，两者合之味道奇怪，失败之作，但搭配风格很好，排骨搭黄桃，去腻与陶陶居经典的芒果鸡有异曲同工之妙。服务及环境都好，交通便利！nnbvvggf

pass1.why: The agent considered the label and rejected it as taste pairing without ever reading the Food#Appearance rule, and the rule lists 造型 and 摆盘 as triggers, so the flow skipped a rule it needed.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: before rejecting any Food#* aspect, the agent must open that label's rule and check its trigger words; add a rule note that 风格/搭配 phrases describing a dish's presentation or plating count toward Food#Appearance.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a rule note that 搭配风格 alone refers to flavour/combination unless paired with visual cues like 摆盘 or 造型.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.rejected_reason: Decoration is not discussed.
decisions.text:
也不知道啥时候开的，就是阅味麻辣烫的位置，本来想去阅味家吃馄饨的，走到那了看是新开的也就进去了！去到收银台，问询吃什么，态度好好，点了招牌老鸭粉，熏肉大饼7元加肉的，屋里没开空调，导致吃完全身都湿了！
【老鸭粉】10元一碗，量还一般，自己加料，麻油，胡椒粉，陈醋，辣椒油都有，汤有点稀不浓，好在不难吃，鸭肝鸭肉鸭肠都有，粉多，导致我又加汤了，服务员很热情的给加了，此时吃的不是老鸭粉了，就冲这态度吧！我说的服务员就是收银妹子！
【熏肉大饼】7元可加肉，还有加肠加鸡蛋啥的，种类不少，毕竟主打，咋地也得点个试试，很干净很贴心的饼，切成两段，吃起来方便，味道尚可，有土豆丝什么的，挺好的！
此店干净卫生，态度也好，还会再去，但遗憾的是没开空调夏天吃太着罪了，冬天还行，老板你店都开的起，不能差点开空调的电费吧！

pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that a specific complaint about temperature or air conditioning does not trigger the four-tag general-environment set.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The gold label applies a general-environment convention, but the review never says 环境 or comments on decor; the only ambience remarks are about the room being hot without air conditioning and the shop being clean, and the rule's general-environment clause is not triggered here, so the agent's refusal was reasonable and the gold looks inconsistent with the rulebook's specific-aspect rule.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case showing that a complaint about no air conditioning alone does not trigger Decoration, and clarify that the general-environment four-label rule needs a stated general 环境 judgment.
