decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 我特别推荐麻辣牛肉和极品羔羊肉
decisions.text:
同城活动吃的最嗨的一次，所以这次也快快的交作业，非常感谢商家的慷慨，这次试吃竟然没有限制，想吃什么点什么，商家大手笔。一共两桌20人，赛况空前，呵呵。每桌都消费了1500以上。杨木木领队可是跟我上次见得风格不同，上次好文气，这次绝对是豪爽。
位置：先夸奖一下我可歌可泣的吃货精神，这么远的地方，跋山涉水的去了，前几天就在网上搜路线，下了公交车站向北再走20米就能看见，乐派生活广场，大北郊竟然有这么热闹的地方。
环境：先说说这家火锅店是苏福记旗下的，这家店装修的很古朴，有点老上海的味道，喜欢这个调调。值得赞扬这家店有一部分服务员是聋哑人，所以墙上有很多手语的海报，希望有更多的商家为残障人士提供更多的就业机会。
菜品：，重庆的那种老火锅，我们要的牛油鸳鸯火锅，吃完身上有味，但是很值啊，牛油的就是香，红锅看着好诱人啊。这次点的肉菜特别多，麻辣牛肉，嫩牛肉、肥牛上脑、肥牛眼肉、极品羔羊肉、雪花肥牛基本上都是两份，我特别推荐麻辣牛肉和极品羔羊肉，麻辣牛肉经过腌制后很入味，当然不吃辣的朋友还是别点了，极品羔羊肉很香嫩。肥牛上脑也不错，我喜欢比较偏瘦的肉。
大家吃的不亦乐乎，因为商家的慷慨，平时吃火锅不会点的菜，这次也有机会尝了尝。鸭胗、鸭肠、肥肠、鸭血，像这种动物内脏我一般是不吃的，这次点了我也有机会尝了尝，竟然味道还不错，不过还是放在辣锅里好吃，清汤可能有点腥，去骨鸭掌没吃，不过看大家吃的好香。
海鲜类，我们点了耗儿鱼、巴沙鱼，耗儿鱼小小的好可爱，虽然有小刺，但是味道不错，巴沙鱼是冻鱼，不过很好吃，刺比较少，都比较鲜嫩。
虾滑和鱼滑都点了，我个人比较偏爱虾滑，能吃到大大的虾肉，超爱。
素菜我们也点了不少，竹荪是我这次的大发现，好可爱的素菜，入口即化，可能大家都很喜爱，这盘菜我们桌竟然点了5份，创记录了，莴笋尖我们是生吃的，还不错，甜甜的。黑腐竹和黄金针菇应该是这家店的特色吧，应该是四川的特产。
服务：这家店因为是有聋哑人服务，可能带来不便，但是服务的小伙很可爱热情，也很勤快，是不是的过来放好盘子，换吃碟，只要肩上有拍拍我的标志，大家尽可能耐心一点，我也因此学了不少手语，服务没得说。
这次试吃完美收场，大家心满意足，真是觉得跋山涉水这么远来，真的很值，有机会会带家人来品尝。

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The review explicitly says 我特别推荐 for two dishes, which matches the rule's 'explicit recommendation' criterion, so the agent's label is defensible and the gold omission looks inconsistent with the rule's own examples (特别推荐 is 82% labelled).
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note clarifying that a first-person explicit 特别推荐 of named dishes always takes Food#Recommend even alongside positive taste praise.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The review explicitly says "我特别推荐麻辣牛肉和极品羔羊肉", which matches the rule's explicit recommendation wording, so the gold omitting it looks inconsistent with the rulebook; the agent applied the rule correctly, but since all six arms made the same call, the gold is the likely error.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or amend the gold for this item to add Food#Recommend since the rule lists 特别推荐 as a clear positive case.

海鲜类，我们点了耗儿鱼、巴沙鱼，耗儿鱼小小的好可爱，虽然有小刺，但是味道不错，巴沙鱼是冻鱼，不过很好吃，刺比较少，都比较鲜嫩。
虾滑和鱼滑都点了，我个人比较偏爱虾滑，能吃到大大的虾肉，超爱。
素菜我们也点了不少，竹荪是我这次的大发现，好可爱的素菜，入口即化，可能大家都很喜爱，这盘菜我们桌竟然点了5份，创记录了，莴笋尖我们是生吃的，还不错，甜甜的。黑腐竹和黄金针菇应该是这家店的特色吧，应该是四川的特产。
服务：这家店因为是有聋哑人服务，可能带来不便，但是服务的小伙很可爱热情，也很勤快，是不是的过来放好盘子，换吃碟，只要肩上有拍拍我的标志，大家尽可能耐心一点，我也因此学了不少手语，服务没得说。
这次试吃完美收场，大家心满意足，真是觉得跋山涉水这么远来，真的很值，有机会会带家人来品尝。

pass1.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass1.why: The sentence describes how to reach the place (bus stop, walk 20 metres) which is Transportation; the agent read the rule's boundary but still treated the directional landmark description as findability, so it misapplied the rule.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: when a review only gives directions from a stop or landmark, label Location#Transportation only, and add Easy_to_find only if the reviewer comments that the shop is easy or hard to spot.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The rule was read, but the text only describes the route from the bus stop and a landmark name; it never says the restaurant is easy or hard to spot, so the agent over-read the directions as a findability judgement, which the boundary note says belongs to Location#Transportation.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt note that giving directions or a landmark alone is Transportation, and only label Easy_to_find when the reviewer comments on how easy or hard the shop is to spot.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 但是很值啊
decisions.text:

位置：先夸奖一下我可歌可泣的吃货精神，这么远的地方，跋山涉水的去了，前几天就在网上搜路线，下了公交车站向北再走20米就能看见，乐派生活广场，大北郊竟然有这么热闹的地方。

大家吃的不亦乐乎，因为商家的慷慨，平时吃火锅不会点的菜，这次也有机会尝了尝。鸭胗、鸭肠、肥肠、鸭血，像这种动物内脏我一般是不吃的，这次点了我也有机会尝了尝，竟然味道还不错，不过还是放在辣锅里好吃，清汤可能有点腥，去骨鸭掌没吃，不过看大家吃的好香。
海鲜类，我们点了耗儿鱼、巴沙鱼，耗儿鱼小小的好可爱，虽然有小刺，但是味道不错，巴沙鱼是冻鱼，不过很好吃，刺比较少，都比较鲜嫩。
虾滑和鱼滑都点了，我个人比较偏爱虾滑，能吃到大大的虾肉，超爱。
素菜我们也点了不少，竹荪是我这次的大发现，好可爱的素菜，入口即化，可能大家都很喜爱，这盘菜我们桌竟然点了5份，创记录了，莴笋尖我们是生吃的，还不错，甜甜的。黑腐竹和黄金针菇应该是这家店的特色吧，应该是四川的特产。
服务：这家店因为是有聋哑人服务，可能带来不便，但是服务的小伙很可爱热情，也很勤快，是不是的过来放好盘子，换吃碟，只要肩上有拍拍我的标志，大家尽可能耐心一点，我也因此学了不少手语，服务没得说。
这次试吃完美收场，大家心满意足，真是觉得跋山涉水这么远来，真的很值，有机会会带家人来品尝。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The phrase 但是很值啊 is a value judgment that the rule lists as 值这个价-type wording, yet the gold omits it, suggesting the gold treats it as a general remark rather than a value-for-money judgement on the shop.
pass1.fix: Rule edit: state whether bare 很值/值 judgments count as Cost_effective, with two or three labelled examples, so labellers apply it consistently.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: "但是很值啊" directly uses 值 in a value-for-money sense, which the rule lists as 值这个价, yet all six arms labelled it the same way and the gold omits it, so the gold may be following a stricter convention that the rulebook does not state.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the rule whether bare 值/很值 without a price comparison counts; if it does, correct the gold, otherwise add a not-applicable example for 值 used with a surrounding positive mood.

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The gold labels appearance from the 红锅看着好诱人 remark and the agent considered it but rejected it as too weak, while the rule's '颜色好看' and '看着' wording points toward inclusion; the agent never read the Appearance rule, so its self-check dropped a valid label.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: require the agent to read the rule for every candidate aspect before rejecting it, and add a case-library example where 看着诱人 about the dish's colour is labelled Food#Appearance.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The agent never read the Food#Appearance rule, so it skipped the rule that would have let it weigh the "红锅看着好诱人" remark against the 颜色好看 criterion, and it dropped the aspect on a judgement it never checked.
pass2.fix: Make the flow read every rule whose keywords appear in the text (including 看着 and 诱人 for appearance) before deciding to drop an aspect.

decisions.label: Location#Transportation
decisions.rejected_reason: 只说店在地铁站旁边、离考场二站路，是陈述事实，没有评价交通是否方便，按通则不标
decisions.text: 周六女儿去上海考试，考完后女儿向我们推荐了这家规模较大的牛肉拉面，貌似青海人民政府驻上海办事外开的。离考场二站路，在镇平路地铁站旁边，店确实蛮大，有三层，面的品种也蛮多，有毛细，细，中细，韭叶，宽面各种，我们四人点了不同的四种面，其实吃吃也都一个味道，因为汤都是同一种，价格最低15元，性价比一般，菜到是有几种没吃过，都是野菜，但价格偏高，因为抱着很大期望来的，但也就一般而言，关键厨房和面的地方看上去不是太清洁，希望能改进。

pass1.label: Location#Transportation
pass1.why: The agent read the rule, whose Applies-when list names 地铁 and 离某站几分钟 (mentions that hit 92-94% of the time), but its self-check dropped the label because the sentence was a plain fact rather than an evaluation, so a right answer was overturned.
pass1.fix: Add to the prompt's self-check that a rule's Applies-when triggers count without evaluative words, and add a rule note that station-proximity statements such as 在X地铁站旁边 or 离某站几分钟 are labelled Location#Transportation even when neutral in tone.

pass2.label: Location#Transportation
pass2.why: The rule says to tag subway/bus mentions and 'X station a few minutes away' cases, and the review explicitly says the restaurant is beside Zhenping Road metro station and two stops from the exam venue, yet the agent read the rule and dropped the label in its self-check, treating a factual location as no evaluation; the rule's own examples (离某站几分钟) match this wording, so the self-check overrode a correct label.
pass2.fix: Add an explicit note to the self-check: '离某站/地铁站旁边/几站路' statements count as Location#Transportation even without an evaluative word, and only drop it when the text mentions no transport at all.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.evidence: 店内氛围不错
decisions.text: 在豚一和博多一辛舍两者中犹豫不决，最后觉得豚一更实惠点，就团购了代金券带着小伙伴来了中华广场店。店确实是非常的难找，只能打电话求救店员，店员说按着一楼地面上必胜客的指示贴方向走就能找到，终于得救！虽然铺子小了点，但是店内氛围不错，店员们也很热心。两个女生都点了半份的面，觉得这种设置不错，小份刚刚好。面汤闻起来确实有点儿肉骚味儿，大部分的调味都点的普通，发现太淡了！味口重伤不起！糖心蛋好评！温泉蛋差评，居然还没有食其家的好，都破了。饺子味道中规中矩，做得卖相倒是不错。总的来说，这类的日本拉面性价比是极低的，不过可能各人有各人的喜爱吧，我还是更喜欢苏式面。

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: "店内氛围不错" is a general atmosphere praise that the rule lists under Decoration, yet the gold keeps Noise and Space from the same general-environment rule and drops Decoration, so the gold is internally inconsistent with the rulebook.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, and state in the rule whether a bare 氛围不错 gets the full four-tag general-environment set or only Decoration.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review says '店内氛围不错' (atmosphere is good) without specifying decoration; the rulebook's convention says a general good-environment remark should carry all four environment labels, but the agent applied Decoration alone while omitting Noise and Sanitary, so the gold likely treats 氛围 as a general environment comment that the agent's per-label reading does not match, and 氛围 is listed in Decoration's applies-when list, making the label defensible but ambiguous.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; clarify in the Decoration rule whether 氛围 alone counts as decoration or as a general environment remark needing all four labels.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: "小份刚刚好" is a direct evaluation of portion size, which the rule covers, but the gold omits it and every arm made the same call, so the gold looks incomplete against the rule's own wording.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case where 小份/大份 plus a judgement of fit is labelled Food#Portion so the convention is explicit.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review mentions half portions and says 小份刚刚好 which evaluates portion size, yet the rule says listing ordered quantities without evaluation does not count and the agent and all arms read it as a portion evaluation, so the gold omitting it conflicts with the explicit '小份刚刚好' judgement.
pass2.fix: Add a rule example: explicit evaluation of serving size such as '小份刚刚好' or '份量合适' applies Food#Portion, and clarify that 半份 ordering plus approval counts.

decisions.evidence: 糖心蛋好评！温泉蛋差评，居然还没有食其家的好，都破了。

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The rule was read and says praise without an explicit recommendation does not qualify, yet the agent treated "好评" and "差评" as recommend or not-recommend statements, which is a misreading of the rule's boundary (only 1 of 7 arms erred).
pass1.fix: Add a prompt note that 好评/差评 on a single dish is taste-level evaluation unless the reviewer states recommend or not recommend, and add a few such cases to the library.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The text '糖心蛋好评！温泉蛋差评' praises and criticises specific dishes but contains no explicit recommend or do-not-recommend statement, which the rule requires, so the agent over-read praise as recommendation although the rule was read.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: before applying Food#Recommend, check for explicit words 推荐/不推荐/值得一试; praise alone goes to Food#Taste or Food#Appearance.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.evidence: 最后觉得豚一更实惠点

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The label was added only by the self-check, which reversed an unsure first pass, and the gold omits it; the flow let a late self-check change the answer.
pass1.fix: Restrict the self-check so it cannot add a label that the first pass rated unsure, or require a quoted rule trigger before any self-check addition.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The self-check added Price#Level based on '实惠点', but the rule lists 实惠 as an applies-when term while the gold omits it, and the self-check changed the decision without a clear reason, so the flow introduced an error the first pass had avoided.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: the self-check should only add or remove labels with a cited rule test; state that comparative phrases like 更实惠 in a choice between dishes count as Price#Level only when judging the restaurant's price, and otherwise keep the first-pass decision.

decisions.label: Ambience#Noise
decisions.rejected_reason: No noise comment.
decisions.text: 在豚一和博多一辛舍两者中犹豫不决，最后觉得豚一更实惠点，就团购了代金券带着小伙伴来了中华广场店。店确实是非常的难找，只能打电话求救店员，店员说按着一楼地面上必胜客的指示贴方向走就能找到，终于得救！虽然铺子小了点，但是店内氛围不错，店员们也很热心。两个女生都点了半份的面，觉得这种设置不错，小份刚刚好。面汤闻起来确实有点儿肉骚味儿，大部分的调味都点的普通，发现太淡了！味口重伤不起！糖心蛋好评！温泉蛋差评，居然还没有食其家的好，都破了。饺子味道中规中矩，做得卖相倒是不错。总的来说，这类的日本拉面性价比是极低的，不过可能各人有各人的喜爱吧，我还是更喜欢苏式面。

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The agent never read the Noise rule, so it did not apply the general-environment rule that would have carried Noise from the bare 环境/氛围 praise, and all arms missed it.
pass1.fix: Prompt edit: when a review praises the general environment or atmosphere without specifics, always load the four environment-label rules (Decoration, Noise, Space, Sanitary) before deciding.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: The review gives no noise comment, yet gold includes Noise with positive polarity, which fits the dataset convention for general environment praise (氛围不错) that applies all four environment labels, but the rulebook's cue list gives no reason for the agent to infer it and no rule was read.
pass2.fix: Rule edit: state explicitly that general positive environment remarks like 氛围不错 or 环境不错 carry Noise, Space and Sanitary as well as Decoration, so annotators and models apply the convention consistently.

decisions.label: Ambience#Noise
decisions.rejected_reason: 未提及嘈杂，“环境”一词未出现在点评中
decisions.text:
外女儿和小伙伴要回天津了，想请她俩在陆总附近吃饭，我要求适合年轻人的，有点个性的，想来想去决定吃一方广场的肉蟹煲，比较有特色，还能满足外女喜欢海味儿的需求。
一方广场交通便利，大家也都认识，就算不知道这个名字，一说文化路家乐福的东面毗邻，就找到了。
进门，乘直梯到五楼，出梯相当于梯的后面直走，过两个门脸，左手边就是了，今天来的早，不用等位，再晚一点儿，就得等位，他家等位就餐似乎是特色之一，哈哈。
坐下来，点餐：肉蟹煲(大份微辣)，她的小伙伴儿刚做了双眼皮，需要禁口，只能吃素的，那就来蓝莓铁棍山药，田园沙拉，香脆藕片，多嘴泡馍，加微信关注赠青梅酵素饮品(每个人都加，一桌给一份)。
下面说说用餐感受，
上餐很快，煲个大量足，橙红色的螃蟹壳盖在上面，点缀着绿色的葱花，颜色新鲜，好看。壳下有不少的蟹子，这个季节的螃蟹都是存的吧，蟹肉量还行，新鲜，没有涩味，烹饪的火候好，入味充足，稍有一点儿咸。
鸡爪子：上色好，味道足，量大，烂乎，火候好，就是多一会儿有点烂过头，少一会儿就不烂乎，正好。
年糕：软软糯的，超喜欢。土豆面面的，块大，烂乎，入味，上色，能感觉到炖煮的时间够长。
之前在网络上买的代金券92代100，到店桌上显示刷招行80代100，当即退前面的，做买2张，为凑钱数，又点了多嘴烤馍，这个好吃，热乎的，面味足，没加东西，本来吃饱了，太好吃了，空嘴又吃了2块。
在用餐的过程中有跳舞表演，外女幽默的说“这太不易了，当服务员还得会跳舞”，而且会有手工气球赠送。
店里是工厂似装修，当下比较时尚的，充满现代气息，工业化革命，颠覆了传统的用餐环境，有新意，受欢迎。

pass1.label: Ambience#Noise
pass1.why: The review never mentions noise, and its only environment comment is about decor, which the rulebook says should tag only Decoration. The gold applies the four generic-environment tags, which conflicts with the rule's own example that "装修很有格调" tags only decoration.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous. Clarify in the rule whether a decor-only praise (no word 环境) triggers the four generic tags.

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise
pass2.why: The review only describes the décor as factory-style and fashionable and never mentions noise. The rulebook says only a general "环境" comment triggers all four environment labels, and a specific décor comment triggers only Decoration, so the gold's extra environment labels conflict with the dataset's own convention.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or re-check the gold so that a specific décor description does not add Noise, Sanitary and Space.

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The review describes a 代金券 (voucher) being applied, which the rule lists as a Discount trigger (券). The agent never read the Discount rule and filtered on whether the reviewer evaluated the deal, so the flow skipped a rule that applies.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt step that scans for 券, 优惠, 团购, 打折, 活动 and 赠送 mentions and checks each against its rule before deciding, even when the text is only factual.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The Price#Discount rule lists 券 (coupons) as an applies-when keyword, and the review describes using 92-for-100 and 80-for-100 vouchers, but the rule was never read, so the agent judged only whether the discount was praised. The flow did not make it check each label's trigger list.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt step that requires reading the applies-when list of every candidate label, and state that a coupon or discount mentioned as a fact still triggers Price#Discount even when it is not evaluated.

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review gives only coupon and item prices with no high or low judgement, which the rulebook says is usually not tagged. Yet the gold tags Price#Level with neutral polarity, and the agents' reading matches the rule.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous. Check the gold for this item and add a rule example stating whether neutral voucher-price arithmetic counts as price level.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review gives only coupon face values and no high or low price judgement, and the rule says a price with no evaluation is mostly not labelled. The gold's Price#Level therefore conflicts with the rulebook, and all six arms missed it, which points to the gold.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.rejected_reason: '装修多年无变' is a bare factual statement with no judgment, so it is not labelled.
decisions.text: 大家来大良食双皮奶，都习惯性的去清晖园附近的民信同仁信，这家隐藏在大良街的金榜牛奶，装修多年无变，味道也应该活变。餐牌品种不多，昨天去吃时更说因为人手不够，全店只卖冷热双皮奶，姜汁双皮奶同鲜水牛奶，鲜水牛奶奶味很浓，但有点太甜了，姜汁双皮奶就是热双皮奶加了点姜汁在上边，姜不算很辣，个人感觉跟普通的差不多。冷热双皮奶相对喜欢热的，比较香滑，但冻的吃起来无咁适，也无咁腻。导航得好找，来顺德的朋友不妨来试试！

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The rule was read and the keyword 装修 is present, but the self-check dropped the label as a bare fact, even though the review explicitly evaluates decoration neutrally and the other six arms kept it.
pass1.fix: Edit the self-check so it does not remove an aspect label when the item names that aspect with a keyword from the rule and gives a polarity, including neutral statements such as 装修多年无变; only drop labels for passing mentions with no evaluation.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The rule was read and six of seven arms labelled '装修多年无变' as a neutral judgment, so the agent's self-check wrongly dropped a correct label that the task's neutral polarity covers.
pass2.fix: Edit the self-check so it cannot remove a label that other evidence supports. Add a prompt note that a factual statement about an aspect's state (e.g. '装修多年无变') counts as a neutral judgment, and add similar neutral-state cases to the case library.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 看着一碗大份的面也才10元
decisions.text: 大胡子羊肉面片，来天水的麦积山石窟玩，在大众点评玩上搜了一下，就这家店最火了，于是午餐就在此店解决了。店铺位于火车站附近，出火车站后往前走，然后右拐，进入一条小吃街，两侧都是各式小吃店。大胡子羊肉面片差不多位于街的尽头，在右手边。据说团购不能用，看着一碗大份的面也才10元，于是就直接开点了，以为牛肉面片和兰州好的拉面一样，羊肉是要另点的，所以点了一份牛腱肉，10元/份。付钱后有个号，后厨会叫号，厨房里一个人负责叫号、一个人负责煮面片，两个人负责扯面片，秩序井然。不得不说，店铺的生意相当好，顾客络绎不绝。再说这羊肉面片，味道很赞，配料有小块的羊肉、西红柿和香菜。另外，这是再大西北吃了这么多天，为数不多的没有放辣椒的面。

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review says 看着一碗大份的面也才10元, which is a visual impression tied to price, not an evaluation of the dish's quantity; the rule excludes mentions that do not evaluate how much food there was, and the agent applied it despite reading the rule.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note: '看着大份/量大' used only to motivate a price judgment, without tasting or eating the quantity, does not count as Food#Portion; add contrastive cases like this one labelled Price only.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review says a large bowl costs only 10 yuan, which is a price judgment about value rather than an evaluation of how much food was served, and the rule's 'does not apply' clause on non-portion uses of 大 is not triggered by the model's reading.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note that '大份…才X元' comparing price to quantity is labelled Price#Level, not Food#Portion, unless the reviewer comments on the amount itself; add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Price#Discount
decisions.evidence: 据说团购不能用
decisions.text: 大胡子羊肉面片，来天水的麦积山石窟玩，在大众点评玩上搜了一下，就这家店最火了，于是午餐就在此店解决了。店铺位于火车站附近，出火车站后往前走，然后右拐，进入一条小吃街，两侧都是各式小吃店。大胡子羊肉面片差不多位于街的尽头，在右手边。据说团购不能用，看着一碗大份的面也才10元，于是就直接开点了，以为牛肉面片和兰州好的拉面一样，羊肉是要另点的，所以点了一份牛腱肉，10元/份。付钱后有个号，后厨会叫号，厨房里一个人负责叫号、一个人负责煮面片，两个人负责扯面片，秩序井然。不得不说，店铺的生意相当好，顾客络绎不绝。再说这羊肉面片，味道很赞，配料有小块的羊肉、西红柿和香菜。另外，这是再大西北吃了这么多天，为数不多的没有放辣椒的面。

pass1.label: Price#Discount
pass1.why: The phrase 据说团购不能用 says the group-buy voucher could not be used, which is a negative remark about discount availability that the reviewer reports second-hand; the self-check added the label although the gold treats it as no discount judgment, and no other arm made this error, so the flaw is in the agent's self-check rather than the rule.
pass1.fix: Add a self-check guard: keep a Price#Discount label only when the review evaluates a discount's strength or availability in the reviewer's own voice; add a case of '团购不能用' labelled as no discount aspect.

pass2.label: Price#Discount
pass2.why: The self-check added this label even though the reviewer only reports that group-buy cannot be used, which is a negative fact about a discount, not an assessment of discount strength; the self-check overrode a reasonable first reading.
pass2.fix: Add a prompt step: a self-check may remove labels but must not add them, and state that mentioning a coupon being unusable does not by itself qualify as Price#Discount unless the review judges the offer's strength.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: 只提到便宜的价格，未对价格高低作单独评价

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review calls the price cheap through 10元 for a large bowl, but the Price#Level rule's examples do not clearly cover a bare 'only a low price' judgment with no adjective, so the agent rejected it as a plain menu price, while gold labels it as a price-level judgment.
pass1.fix: Add an explicit rule example: '才10元''这么便宜' or a sum paired with 'only/才' counts as a price-level evaluation, and add cases of that wording.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review says the price is cheap-sounding (10 yuan for a large bowl, plus the explicit value judgement implied by the framing), but the agent rejected it because it saw no explicit 便宜 word, and the rule's Applies list does not clearly cover implicit low-price judgements, while the library shows price-level labels are commonly applied to such framing.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the Price#Level rule that a concrete amount paired with a value framing such as '才10元' or '看着…也才' counts as a price-level judgement, and add cases of this wording.

decisions.rejected_reason: 没有评价服务人员态度

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The review describes orderly queue-calling and crowded business without judging staff attitude, yet gold tags Service#Hospitality; the 秩序井然 remark arguably evaluates staff work, but the rule only covers attitude and hospitality, so careful labellers could differ.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note clarifying that praise of staff's orderly work (秩序井然) counts as Service#Hospitality if the gold convention is confirmed.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The review praises queueing and order flow ('秩序井然', staff roles) but gives no comment on staff attitude, so the gold label looks inconsistent with the rule that requires a judgement of people's attitude; the agent's rejection is defensible.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or clarify whether efficiency of staff organisation without attitude words should be labelled Service#Hospitality or Service#Timely.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.evidence: 包厢也不错，圆桌+八仙椅的模式，也算颇具重庆风情
decisions.text:
好安逸的重庆火锅很正宗哎，吃了一趟感觉真满意来着~排队等候的地方还能电子游戏桌能玩游戏，真是超级嗨啊，赞一个！
这儿的包厢也不错，圆桌+八仙椅的模式，也算颇具重庆风情；特质的小瓶装香油很完美，其他酱料不错，但经典的配料一个不少，香油碟+牛肉酱碟+海鲜酱油碟，吃货三组合，习惯性的绝不缺少，哈哈。
话说自从卡梅伦来成都吃过香菜丸子之后，似乎一夜间每家火锅店都多了香菜丸子。当然好吃确实好吃，纯肉糜，无淀粉（当然也可能有微量淀粉，没吃出来）。其他方面，金针菇、午餐肉都是必点的；称赞一下这儿的豆花，跟重庆磁器口的美味江水豆花很像，也是非常不容易了。
鹅肠处理的很干净；炸酥肉是现炸后端上来，既可以涮锅，也可以直接吃（我很喜欢刚炸好的酥肉直接蘸花生酱吃）。最后，小食方面，糍粑做得不错，调料方面需要再多放一点花生碎末，糖太多啦！

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The review says 包厢也不错 and describes the round table and eight-immortal chairs with Chongqing flavour, which does judge the decor, so the agent's label is defensible; the gold omits it while the rule's 装修/风格 scope fits this wording, and the 6-6 spread suggests the gold is inconsistent with the rule.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a case showing that concrete furniture and style descriptions of a private room count as Decoration.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review explicitly praises the 包厢 layout and says it has Chongqing atmosphere (颇具重庆风情), which fits the rule's 装修/风格/氛围 wording, so the label is defensible, yet the gold omits it and the rulebook gives no clear line for a sub-area praised with a style remark; 6 of 6 arms made the same call, pointing at the gold or rule rather than the model.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case where a private room or table layout praised with a style remark is labelled Decoration to settle the convention.

decisions.label: Ambience#Sanitary
decisions.rejected_reason: 干净 describes the ingredient (鹅肠处理的很干净), not the restaurant's hygiene, which the rules treat as taste.

pass1.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass1.why: The agent read the rule and considered 干净 but rejected it as describing the ingredient; the review's 鹅肠处理的很干净 is about ingredient handling, which the rule says should be taken as taste, so the gold Sanitary label is itself questionable, yet the agent's rejection followed the rule and its reasoning was mostly sound.
pass1.fix: Add a boundary case: 食材处理干净 (ingredient cleanliness) stays with taste, while a gold Sanitary label needs a statement about the restaurant's own hygiene; then re-check whether this gold label is consistent with that rule.

pass2.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass2.why: The only cleanliness word is 鹅肠处理的很干净, which describes an ingredient, and the rule says ingredient cleanliness usually goes to taste; yet the gold labels Sanitary, so the rulebook's ingredient exclusion conflicts with the gold on this wording, and the model rightly followed the written rule.
pass2.fix: Add a rule clarifying whether praise for ingredient cleanliness (食材干净、处理干净) counts toward Sanitary, and add labelled cases showing the chosen convention.

decisions.label: Food#Appearance
decisions.evidence: 不仅看着精致，而且很美味
decisions.text: 宇宙韩餐，位于凯德精品的LG层，位置很好找，交通便利。最喜欢的一道菜就是生拌牛肉了，不仅看着精致，而且很美味。服务员在上菜的时候现拌的，在上面挤上新鲜的柠檬汁，绝对让人胃口大开！配和梨丝拌在一起，酸酸甜甜的口感很好吃。牛肉很新鲜，没有腥味或掺有血丝，口感有点冰冰凉凉的，酸甜爽口。韩餐不得不提的就是辣白菜和五花肉了 ，几乎每个韩餐馆都会推出很特色的五花肉的菜肴。宇宙韩餐当然也不例外了。但是它家的辣白菜不是很辣的口感 ，不会感觉辣酱很多，像吃辣酱的感觉，而是刚刚好的酱料，配上口感爽脆的白菜，吃过后口感稍稍有点回甜，也不会觉得很辣。餐厅有现扎的饮料，是鲜果组合的，营养丰富美味，服务员的态度也很好。

pass1.label: Food#Appearance
pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists 精致 as an appearance cue (73%), so the agent's label follows the rulebook; the gold omits it, which is inconsistent with the dataset's own convention.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or correct the gold to add Food#Appearance for the 精致 phrasing since the rule lists 精致 as a cue.

pass2.label: Food#Appearance
pass2.why: The review explicitly says the dish looks refined (看着精致), and the rule lists 精致 as an applicable cue at 73%, so the agent's label fits the rule; the gold omits it, and all six arms made the same call, pointing to the gold label being incomplete rather than a model error.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a gold-review pass checking whether explicit 精致/看着 appearance cues were skipped in this dataset.

pass1.label: Service#Hospitality
pass1.why: The rule lists 服务员 and 态度 as direct cues (90%, 99%), and the review explicitly judges the waiter's attitude as good, so the agent's label matches the rule while the gold omits it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; the gold appears to miss an explicit staff-attitude judgement that the rule covers.

pass2.label: Service#Hospitality
pass2.why: The sentence 服务员的态度也很好 directly evaluates staff attitude, which the rule covers via 态度 (99%) and 服务员 (90%), so the agent's label is rule-supported; the gold omits it even though all arms agreed, suggesting the gold is inconsistent with the dataset's convention.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; verify the gold annotator applied the 态度 cue rule to this item.

decisions.label: Location#Downtown
decisions.rejected_reason: Only says it is on a floor of Kerry mall; no downtown-area judgement.

pass1.label: Location#Downtown
pass1.why: The review says the restaurant is on a floor of Kerry mall (凯德精品), which the rule associates with 商场 and 商圈, but the rule also says 只说在几楼 does not apply, so the agent's rejection and the rule's signals conflict on this case.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit clarifying that naming a shopping mall as the restaurant's location counts for Location#Downtown even when a floor number is also given.

pass2.label: Location#Downtown
pass2.why: The review says only that the restaurant is on the LG floor of Kerry mall; the rule says 在某某广场/商场里或旁边 counts as downtown, but also says '在几楼' alone does not apply, so the rule is contradictory on this exact wording and the agent never read the rule.
pass2.fix: Add an explicit boundary example: 'located in a named mall (e.g. 凯德精品) with floor only' -> apply Location#Downtown, or state that floor plus mall name counts as a mall location; then add cases of this wording.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 吃的肚子饱了嘴不饱
decisions.text: 家门口的饭馆 一直是路过 之前家里人也买过不过是打包回家吃的 这次和朋友一去的 晚上去的 大概六点吧 这个时间就已经火爆的不行了 在外面等了半天 上他家来 必点的肯定是酱羊骨 还点了个扒茄子 还有个玉米粒 凉拌蛰头 炒合菜 除了这个玉米以外 其他菜都是棒棒的 很好吃 吃的肚子饱了嘴不饱 玉米是炸过的 个人口味的原因吧 不太喜欢这个玉米 这个扒茄子我很喜欢 酱羊骨我只吃到了一块 全部都是朋友对象全部去掉了 啃的太快了 而且啃的太干净了 真是神技能！值得推荐大家去！

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The phrase 吃的肚子饱了嘴不饱 is a playful pun in which 嘴不饱 expresses unsatisfied enjoyment, not a judgement of how much food was served, so the portion label is debatable and the gold omitted it, as five of the six arms did not label it.
pass1.fix: Document as ambiguous, and add a case showing that figurative 嘴不饱 or 吃不饱-style wordplay about enjoyment does not trigger Food#Portion unless the reviewer is judging the quantity served.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The phrase 吃的肚子饱了嘴不饱 is about being full but not satisfied in taste/texture, not about the quantity of dishes, so the rule's portion triggers (分量, 量大, 吃不饱) are not met; the model misread the idiom as a portion judgment although the rule was read.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note that 肚子饱/嘴不饱 expresses satisfaction of appetite, not portion size, and add a few labelled cases where 嘴不饱 is used with taste-related complaints and no portion label.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 值得推荐大家去
decisions.text: 家门口的饭馆 一直是路过 之前家里人也买过不过是打包回家吃的 这次和朋友一去的 晚上去的 大概六点吧 这个时间就已经火爆的不行了 在外面等了半天 上他家来 必点的肯定是酱羊骨 还点了个扒茄子 还有个玉米粒 凉拌蛰头 炒合菜 除了这个玉米以外 其他菜都是棒棒的 很好吃 吃的肚子饱了嘴不饱 玉米是炸过的 个人口味的原因吧 不太喜欢这个玉米 这个扒茄子我很喜欢 酱羊骨我只吃到了一块 全部都是朋友对象全部去掉了 啃的太快了 而且啃的太干净了 真是神技能！值得推荐大家去！

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The rule defines Food#Recommend as whether a dish is worth recommending, but 值得推荐大家去 recommends the restaurant as a whole, and the rulebook is silent on restaurant-level recommendation, so the agent applied the label by its explicit wording.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit stating that recommendation of the restaurant as a whole (推荐大家来/值得推荐去这家店) is not Food#Recommend, which applies only to named dishes, and add cases of restaurant-level recommendation labelled without this tag.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The review ends with 值得推荐大家去, which is a general endorsement of the restaurant rather than an explicit recommendation of a dish; the rule says 值得 and 推荐 alone do not qualify and the model applied the Food#Recommend label to a restaurant-level recommendation, so the instructions do not clearly separate dish recommendation from place recommendation.
pass2.fix: Clarify in the Food#Recommend rule that recommendations of the restaurant overall (e.g. 值得推荐大家去、推荐大家来) do not count unless a specific dish is recommended, and add this sentence as a negative example.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 两人吃108绰绰有余还多了好多粥
decisions.text: 很早前一直在十全的荔茵吃，后来就好久不去了，听说观前开了一家新店就忍不住约姐妹去尝了鲜 。团购的108的套餐，点的干贝排骨粥，粥是现熬的很不错蚝油生菜大同小异，三杯鸡不错甜甜里面的青椒也好吃，至于叉烧包一般啦，送的西米露不错这边感觉人气一般，白天人不多的晚上人气就不知道了。榴莲酥比唐宫的也稍许差点，服务员不多挺懒散的聊天的聊天或许我们去的时候不是饭点他们才这样的。两人吃108绰绰有余还多了好多粥我就打包带回来给女儿吃了，可惜小家伙不喜欢不给面子。下次有机会再去尝尝其他的吧，好怀念以前十全街的黄鳝粥。

pass1.why: The phrase 两人吃108绰绰有余还多了好多粥 does judge the quantity of food (more than enough, lots of porridge left over), which the rule's 吃不完/够几个人吃 cues cover, yet six arms also labelled it, so the gold's omission looks like a gold-side inconsistency rather than a model error.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case library example where 够几个人吃 or 绰绰有余 plus leftover food is labelled Food#Portion to settle the convention.

pass2.label: Food#Portion

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a case-library note that 'X人吃绰绰有余 / 还多了' counts as Food#Portion and confirm the gold for this item.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: Only gives the total for four; no comment that the price is high or low, so only the value judgement (Cost_effective) applies.
decisions.text: 本来想吃川菜，走到门口看到新开张就来试试。大概是两层吧，一层面积不大，都是两人位，可以拼桌，装修风格很喜欢，可惜没有无线，老板说刚开业无线过几天就会办理好。然后说下菜品和饮品。饮料点了一扎酸梅汤和大瓶雪碧。酸梅汤像调出来的，但也很解渴，一大瓶很喜欢瓶子朋友说像啤酒一样。点了两个干锅，干锅牛蛙和干锅鸡中翅，要的重辣，味道中规中矩吧，在这边给老板一点建议，我拆开餐具后勺子上有几条不明物体，喊了服务员换过了，这点一定要注意，不然给人感觉卫生上不仔细。新开业打8.8折，四人吃了190、还是蛮划算的。

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review only gives a total for four people with a value judgement ('还是蛮划算的'), and the rule says a bare amount with no high/low comment is not labelled, so the gold Price#Level looks inconsistent with the rule and the dataset's convention.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule clarifying that a stated per-person or total spend framed as a value judgement ('划算') counts as a price-level comment, with matching cases.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review gives only a total for four people and calls it worthwhile, which is a value judgement; the rule says a bare amount with no high/low evaluation is usually not labelled, so the gold looks inconsistent with the rule's own convention.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a rule note that a stated per-person or total spend plus a favourable value judgement counts as Price#Level only when the text itself says cheap or expensive.

decisions.label: Location#Easy_to_find
decisions.evidence: 破店烤鱼的招牌闪亮醒目
decisions.text: 破店烤鱼二店位于城东路万达嘉华酒店对面，破店烤鱼的招牌闪亮醒目，店铺共两层新装修，整洁、卫生，环境不错……来到破店，烤鱼是必点的店内特色菜，配菜品种丰富，鱼咸辣适中，烤香四溢，这道主菜的确很抢手，三两下就被朋友们吃光了……爆炒鸭胗酸辣口味很不错的一道开胃菜，是我的最爱。椒盐水电鱼包浆均匀口感松脆只是量太少了平均一个人吃不到两块，炒油面比较清淡，个人喜欢吃点辣的，所以感觉味道一般……总体比较满意……

The review's sign comment ('招牌闪亮醒目') describes the restaurant's sign, which the rule covers, yet the review is about the dish and décor and the self-check appears to have overridden a first-pass judgement; 6 of 9 arms did not make this error, so the flow is the likelier issue.
pass2.fix: Prompt edit: make the self-check only remove labels that lack evidence, not add new ones, and require a quote for each addition; add a worked example where a sign or location remark appears in a review about other aspects.

decisions.label: Price#Cost_effective
decisions.evidence: 比团68抵100的券还划算。
decisions.text: 终于说动老公来滇草香拔草了。去的巴沟店，车位相当难找，这里是消费200元免费停车2小时。店里环境很好，富有傣家风情，各种花草和摆件都有匠心，让人乐意停留。服务一流的，会主动介绍特色菜，但不会强求。中间服务员会非常恰逢其时地来帮助涮、分餐、加汤，基本光动嘴吃就行了。点的亚热带丛林野山珍菌汤，虫草花不少。汤一开，服务员就各盛一碗，让先喝汤，挺科学的。锅分内外两圈，里面涮菌类，外圈涮肉，这样可以一直喝里圈的汤，而不用增加嘌呤，又很科学。汤的菌味足。牦牛嫩肉，56米吧，只有2两。端来肉上撒着小黄花瓣，养眼，情调满满的。肉确实很嫩，哪怕涮久了依然嫩，但没吃出多香。虾51米，5头，个头比较大，算中等新鲜度吧，再新鲜点就好了，那就能吃出虾的自来甜了。豆腐拼盘里，建水豆腐好吃，其它一般，不如单点建水豆腐实惠。蘑菇拼盘也50几米，是北方最常见的菌菇（香菇、金针菇、平菇、双孢菇）。野生菇拼盘好贵，貌似129元，也没多少东东。点的鲜花麻酱调料，结果发现多余点它，经过涮，食材味道已经很丰富了。点的一堆菜里，菠萝饭最好吃。米粒金黄，菠萝味十足，感觉用菠萝汁当水煮出来的江米饭。饭里面还有很小粒的枸杞子，照顾到营养。有葡萄干提甜度和风味。还见到几粒绿色豌豆，可能是冷冻过的，基本没啥味道，不知道起什么作用，装点用的吗？对了，还免费送了4样小凉菜（都是辣的）、1小篮炸虾片、2小竹筒米酒、1碟应季水果（桔子和冬枣）。其中米酒又甜又糯，超赞。另外提供免费的柠檬水。这家东东标价都高，量份很小。结账314米，好在团了3张券（2张50抵100,1张49抵100），实际花销163米。现场去直接打68折，比团68抵100的券还划算。

pass1.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass1.why: The phrase '比团68抵100的券还划算' compares the in-store 68% discount with a group-buy voucher, so it is about which payment route is better value rather than the restaurant's value for money; the rule lists 划算 as a trigger, so the gold omitting it is defensible but the review does use a value-comparison word about the restaurant's pricing.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that '划算' comparing payment channels (discount vs voucher) is a Price#Discount matter and not a cost-effectiveness judgement, and add a few such cases to the case library.

pass2.label: Price#Cost_effective
pass2.why: The phrase 比团68抵100的券还划算 compares the restaurant's on-site 68% discount to a voucher deal rather than judging the restaurant's value against the food quality, and the rule's trigger word 划算 is present, so the agent followed the rule's keyword list literally while the reviewer's point is about discount mechanics; all six arms made the same call, which suggests the rule and gold are at odds here rather than the model misreading.
pass2.fix: Add a rule clarification: 划算 used only to compare payment methods or vouchers (e.g. 打折 vs 团购券) is labelled Price#Discount, not Cost_effective, unless the reviewer also judges food quality against price; add 3-5 such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.evidence: 绿色色调为主，从字体到软装潢都是文艺风
decisions.text:
人在熟悉的环境里会有安全感，而我不知道为什么总对西式素食餐厅感觉亲切熟悉，在多伦多的时候找的头牌素食餐厅，一个人吃饭也感觉像回家一样，这间LP上有推荐的素食餐厅，也是一进来就觉得“哦果然如此”，从菜单到布置到出品都毫不出意外。看来全世界素食主义者已经提前天下大同了吧。
绿色色调为主，从字体到软装潢都是文艺风，周围多是些用有机果汁代替饮酒调情的游客或情侣。但服务生其实盯场盯得很紧，一晚上被关照十次以上。以及领班是高级马屁精，会问我妈是不是瑜伽或太极老师，比我还狗腿哦。
我点了一份Vegetarian Paella，没有什么铁盘气，但作为一盘蔬菜烩饭来看的话，还是很落胃的，节瓜和香菇都还饱满有嚼头，略淡些，磨点黑胡椒进来就好了。

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The sentence explicitly describes the room's colour scheme, fonts and soft furnishings as an "文艺风" style, which the rule lists as applying (风格, 布置), and all six arms read it the same way, so the gold omission looks inconsistent with the dataset's conventions rather than a clear agent error.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or confirm with the gold labeller that style and decor descriptions such as "文艺风" with colour and furnishings count as Ambience#Decoration; if confirmed, add a case of this wording to the library.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The sentence explicitly praises the restaurant's 软装潢 and 文艺风 style, which matches the rule's 'style and decor' scope, so the label is defensible; the all-arms error suggests the gold omitted a clear decor judgement rather than the agent misreading the rule.

decisions.label: Food#Portion

decisions.text: 今日牛事牛肉火锅，位于漕宝路虹漕南路口，公交巴士交通便利就是离地铁站远了点。老婆大人同事聚会吃过这家一次后一直念念不忘，从国庆节念叨到现在。今天答应陪她下午去解馋，午饭后她就坐立不安3点就要出门，说那里生意太好，去晚了要等位。我迫于无奈4点出门，四点20分进店，这时就已经有五，六桌用餐了。饮料可以外面买好带进去喝，这家店没有异议。今天点了招牌锅底，手打牛丸，脚趾肉，牛舌，吊牛肉，胸口朥，煎豆腐衣，加微信升级会员后再送一份牛腩。牛肉锅底里面内容也蛮多的，有牛腩，感觉脚趾肉最好吃，超嫩。手打牛丸超Q，弹性十足。牛舌一般般，吊牛肉没脚趾肉嫩，也还可以，胸口朥多烧一会，入锅10分钟后再吃，脆脆的，也还可以，煎豆腐衣也很酥软，送的牛腩也很好吃，可是吃不了只能打包带回去。最后大众点评网买单，348便宜了30，这次吃的很满意，就是点了多了点，两人去的话不要点太多哦。

pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a case library entry showing that 内容多/东西很多 about the pot contents counts as Food#Portion, or that it does not.

pass2.label: Food#Portion

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a boundary note that '内容多/料多' without portion words is not Food#Portion unless the reviewer comments on quantity sufficiency.

decisions.text: 位于解放大道循礼门公交车站旁，隔壁就是武汉剧院。一个挺小的门面，不怎么起眼，不过在循礼门这里做了感觉有有一二十年了吧。奇君甜品的名字源于这家店的两个老板，一对兄妹，传承父亲的手艺，只做传统的汉味甜品。记得前几天看湖北经视好吃佬节目，还看到了关于这家的宣传节目，感觉现在能在外面喝到传统的汉味甜品真的挺不容易的，而且他家的甜品对于用料都很讲究，比如绿豆汤只选用最优质的天山绿豆，用沸水煮，捞出煮沸的绿豆壳儿，非常讲究，用心去做甜品，非常赞。喜欢喝他家的绿豆汤，真的味道很纯正，香甜味美、清凉解暑，好喝。

pass1.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass1.why: The agent never read this rule, so its flow skipped the check; when it did consider the item it rejected the label because it saw only a landmark, missing that 不怎么起眼 is a negative visibility judgment that the rule covers (位置显眼, 招牌明显).
pass1.fix: Change the flow so that any mention of a landmark, the storefront's visibility or how to locate the shop triggers a read of Location#Easy_to_find, and add a case where a landmark plus 不起眼 is labelled negative.

pass2.label: Location#Easy_to_find
pass2.why: The rule was never read, and the model rejected the item because only a landmark was given, yet the review's '不怎么起眼' comment is a negative judgment on how visible the shop is, which fits the rule's 位置显眼 and 招牌明显 cues.
pass2.fix: Make the flow check the Location#Easy_to_find rule whenever a review gives a position or landmark and comments on visibility, and add a rule note that a landmark plus a remark on visibility ('不起眼', '不显眼') counts as a judgment on ease of finding, with negative polarity.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.evidence: 1斤的东西实际称有5量已经算不错了
decisions.text: 位置和停车都不好找。。。在小巷内部，不过好在老板娘会站在路口指挥，饭店周围都在建房中，周边的环境也相当一般，去的时候还是休渔期，旁边的海鲜市场几乎每家都是那样的坑（价格比广州市场的还要贵，1斤的东西实际称有5量已经算不错了），一只小小的肉蟹随便都要40块，可能也只有游客才会在这个市场里面吃吧。。。团购的套餐味道也只是一般，店内可以接收客人的食材加工但收费（白灼10块每份，炒菜15块每份）。一开始以为性价比高。。。到头来却发现只是个坑。。。严重不推荐。

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The phrase 1斤实际称有5量 is a weight complaint about market seafood, not a judgement of the restaurant's dish portion, and the rule excludes mere counts or non-dish quantities; the model misread it as portion evaluation.
pass1.fix: Add a rule note that weights or quantities bought from a market or shop-side scale are not Food#Portion unless the dish's serving size is judged.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The review complains that the seafood is underweight at the market (1斤 weighs only 5两), which is a weighing issue at the adjacent market, not the restaurant's dish portion, and the agent had read the rule but misapplied it.
pass2.fix: none: the rule already excludes non-dish quantity; add a short example to Food#Portion of 称重/缺斤短两 at a market or shop being outside the label, and reinforce the check that the quantity must be the restaurant's dish.

我们坐下后等了半小时才上了一杯饮料 询问之后才知道有两个菜没了 服务员不仅不告知也没问我们要不要换菜 要不是自己问了估计要被这样一直晾在旁边 爬黄山累了一天吃个饭遇到这种事情实在醉人
再说说菜吧
#酸汤捞虾 汤底味道调的不错 点的小份也是很多很多虾
#鹅肝焗油麦菜 鹅肝的味道香香的
#捏菜拌螺肉 应该是田螺肉 蛮清爽的
#流沙芝麻球 配料里面有榴莲但味道不重 吃不惯榴莲的人也可以尝试
#果汁浓郁新鲜 没有多余的添加剂

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The agent read the rule but the phrase 也可以尝试 is a soft suggestion about who would like the dish, not a clear 推荐 or 不推荐 stance, and the rule says praise without explicit recommendation does not count; the agent over-read a suggestion as a recommendation.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt edit: tag Food#Recommend only when the reviewer explicitly uses recommend/not-recommend wording or equivalent (推荐, 不推荐, 值得一试); phrases like 可以尝试 for a target audience should be checked against this before tagging.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The sentence '吃不惯榴莲的人也可以尝试' is a soft suggestion about a dessert, not an explicit recommendation, and the rule says '值得'/'必点' style wording is usually unlabelled; the rule was read but the model over-read the suggestion, while no other arm made this error.
pass2.fix: Add a rule note that conditional tips like '某类人也可以尝试' without an explicit 推荐/不推荐 verdict do not trigger Food#Recommend, with a few such example cases.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.evidence: 个人感觉还是不错的！推荐
decisions.text:
作为一名吃货当然知道中国八大菜系了，但作为中国八大菜系之首的鲁菜，我可是从来没尝试过，而且在上海鲁菜馆也是少之又少，几乎很难看到，一直想去尝试，这不借着老板的光，他提到了上海唯一一家山东菜馆，于是就阔气的带着我们这些基层干部一路杀了过去，心想：哟，老板，你也是个吃货嘛，这个地方也能被你找到！呵呵
老山东，位于浦东陆家嘴金融中心一带，浦东南路近浦东大道，地理位置属于闹中取静，一眼望去能看到大大的招牌{老山东}，但如果你是第一次去的话大门不大好找，他是开在一幢大厦里面，不像是饭店的感觉，而且在6楼
乘坐直达电梯来到了6楼，走廊很宽敞明亮，很大，出电梯的两边都通的，都属于老山东，大堂很大，包间很多，环境很好，老板订的一间包间叫孔府，好阔气的名字，有点吃孔府家宴的感觉
包间很大，8-10甚至再加两个位子也不会觉得挤，光线很明亮，家具很古色古香，走进去让人觉得很舒服
老板蔡已点好，我们就等着开吃了
老板要了2瓶白酒，说是这酒喝了不会上头，我一看哇，70度，这~~不喝嘛又不行，最终还是忍忍喝了，而且是小白酒被一口闷得，这叫我不会喝酒的怎么办啊，不过这种顾虑很快就消失了，刚下去的时候确实有点裂，辣辣的，但是真有一线吼得感觉，喝了绝不会上头，头不会感觉晕晕的
霸气的老板居然点了8个冷菜拼盘，一盘是3个，那么加起来就24个，好阔气啊，我也是史上吃饭吃到最多的冷菜了
热菜中当之无愧少不了赫赫有名的九转大肠，大肠个个很肥硕，晶莹剔透，口感鲜嫩爽滑，很有嚼劲
烤大虾：虾很大，茄汁烧法，很入味，很嫩，虾壳容易拨，很新鲜
葱烧海参：海参的摆拍很精致，青菜打底，选用的材料很新鲜，没有腥味，口感爽滑
德州扒鸡：一上来是整只的，超大一只，服务员还很有耐心的帮我们撕好，鸡很嫩，一点都不老，很香
主食水饺也是相当不错的，都是平时吃不到的馅料，胡萝卜水饺很清爽可口，什么鱼水饺，后来才了解到时叫鲜鲅鱼水饺，虽然是没听说过，但是味道很鲜美，不醒！口感不错
总体：老山东是一家相当不错的店，喜欢山东鲁菜的话可以去尝试一下
个人感觉还是不错的！推荐

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The closing "推荐" recommends the restaurant as a whole, not a dish, and the Food#Recommend rule covers only dish-level recommendation and is silent on whole-restaurant endorsements, so all six arms applied it.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit: a recommendation of the restaurant overall (e.g. "这家店推荐", "喜欢鲁菜可以去试试") does not trigger Food#Recommend; add a few such cases to the library as negatives.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The closing "个人感觉还是不错的！推荐" recommends the whole restaurant ("总体：老山东是一家相当不错的店"), not a dish, and the rule defines Food#Recommend as whether dishes are worth recommending, so the rulebook does not settle restaurant-level recommendation; six arms made the same error, pointing to the rule's silence rather than the model.
pass2.fix: Rule edit: state that Food#Recommend applies only to specific dishes, and that a recommendation of the whole restaurant ("这家店推荐", "总体推荐") is not labelled here and goes to an overall-opinion label if one exists; add a contrast case of a general shop recommendation with no dish named.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The review explicitly evaluates quantity ("好阔气啊，我也是史上吃饭吃到最多的冷菜了"), which the Food#Portion rule covers, but the model read it as a plain dish list and applied the exclusion for listing dishes.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt example or library cases where praise of how much food was ordered or eaten ("吃到最多", "阔气", "量大") counts as Food#Portion, and clarify that the exclusion applies only when no quantity judgement is made.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The rule was read and the review contains an evaluative quantity judgement ("一盘是3个，那么加起来就24个，好阔气啊", "吃饭吃到最多的冷菜了"), which matches the rule's 量大 and 分量 cues, but the model treated it as a mere list of dishes, a misreading that only 3 of 9 arms shared.
pass2.fix: Prompt/few-shot edit: add cases where praise for quantity is expressed through words like 阔气, 最多, 好多, 满满 or counting totals, showing these count as Food#Portion when the reviewer judges the amount.

decisions.label: Ambience#Space
decisions.evidence: 而且这个店也不算小
decisions.text: 先说句，汉堡王最喜欢的是霸王鸡条皇堡！不得不说，霸王鸡条简直完爆其他油炸食物几条街，汉堡王的番茄酱也很棒！但是中午吃一个皇堡显然是吃不饱的，虽然皇堡也不小了！皇堡加鸡条也让人有点不满足的感觉、所以再来一份烤翅那就圆满了，汉堡王的烤翅也是可以负责任的说完爆其他店的烤翅烤腿的，这样午餐基本可以完美的解决了，哈哈哈！而且这个店也不算小，晚点散步的时候来个甜筒也很不错！吃K和M太多了容易腻、但是汉堡王的鸡条和烤翅我觉得可以吃很久很久。哈哈哈

pass1.label: Ambience#Space
pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists 不小 and 店面小/地方不大 style wording as applying, so the rule was available, but the reviewer's phrase 而且这个店也不算小 is a passing remark inside a food discussion and is a weak, incidental space judgment that the model over-read as a clear aspect judgment.
pass1.fix: Add a case-library example of an incidental size remark ('这个店也不算小') labelled as not applicable when it is a throwaway aside rather than a stated evaluation, and clarify in the rule that the aspect must be judged, not just mentioned in passing.

pass2.label: Ambience#Space
pass2.why: The review says the shop is not small (这个店也不算小), which is a genuine judgment of dining space, but the gold omits it even though the rule lists 店面小/地方不大 as applicable; all six arms made the same call, so the gold label looks incomplete rather than the model being wrong alone.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a gold-check note that brief space comments like 不算小 count as Ambience#Space when they are a judgment rather than an incidental remark.

decisions.label: Location#Transportation
decisions.evidence: 师傅直接开到了餐厅门外，非常方便
decisions.text: 再次感谢大众点评的霸王餐！！！大众点评一生推！！非常幸运第二次被抽中霸王餐，这次是很丰盛的二人餐。因为抽中霸王餐第一次来了华侨城创意园，挺漂亮的地方，来了深圳那么久居然一直没来过这儿。。打的过来的，师傅直接开到了餐厅门外，非常方便，提前一天预约好了，一到店就跟服务员说明是大众点评霸王餐，哈哈，没有受到歧视，店面环境觉得一般，中午过来吃的饭，验证完之后开始上菜，第一道菜是金砖肉，很小的一碟，据说这个是小菜来着，感觉像在零食店买的猪肉干，味道不错，之后上了腰果鸡丁，像宫保鸡丁，这个菜是那么多菜里最喜欢的一个，很下饭，上汤娃娃菜也还好，中规中矩。扇贝很好吃，哈哈哈，不错。最后是木槌海鲜，一个很大盘的菜，原价很贵的，一开始服务员说过有原味和麻辣的，我们要了原味，后来上菜淡然无味。。服务员态度实在太好，很贴心跟我们说，可以给我们加麻辣，感谢你们，服务真是太好。但是木槌海鲜不是很好吃啊，最后吃剩好多，觉得自己好浪费，吃了好多，很值，免费的，感觉不大好意思，哈哈。以后有机会还是会去给老板捧场！！

pass1.label: Location#Transportation
pass1.why: The rule explicitly lists 打车 as applying, and the review praises the taxi driver for driving to the door, so the agent's label follows the rulebook while the gold omits it, which looks inconsistent with the dataset's own convention.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or correct the gold to add Location#Transportation for 打车 comments that praise convenience.

pass2.label: Location#Transportation
pass2.why: The review does say the taxi driver drove right to the restaurant door and that this was convenient, but this is a taxi ride, and the rule treats 打车 as transportation, so the label is arguably defensible; the agent's mistake is minor and the other six arms labelled it differently, pointing to a reading of the gold rather than a clear error.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that a single incidental taxi remark about arrival convenience may or may not count as Transportation.

decisions.label: Food#Portion
decisions.rejected_reason: "很丰盛的二人餐" describes the set meal in general, not a judgement of dish quantity; "吃剩好多" is about the dish being bland, not portion.

pass1.label: Food#Portion
pass1.why: The rule was read and lists 吃不完 as applying, and the review says 吃剩好多 and calls the set 很丰盛, yet the agent rejected both as non-portion judgements, which misapplies the rule's own keywords.
pass1.fix: Add cases to the Food#Portion rule showing that 很丰盛 and 吃剩好多 with a judgement of quantity count as portion.

pass2.label: Food#Portion
pass2.why: The gold tags Food#Portion, but the only quantity-related remarks are about the set meal in general and the uneaten pile being due to blandness, which the rule's 'does not apply' clause on not judging quantity supports; the gold looks debatable.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; clarify in the rule whether 吃剩/吃不完 caused by poor taste counts as a portion judgement.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: "原价很贵的" refers to the original value of the free set item, not a judgement of the restaurant's price level for the diner; the value judgement is already covered by Cost_effective.

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The agent never read the Price#Level rule, so it did not check 贵 as a price-level keyword, and all six arms made the same miss, which points to the flow skipping a needed rule.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt step requiring a keyword scan of every label rule, including 贵, 便宜 and 实惠, before finalising, even when the evaluated price refers to a free or original-value item.

decisions.evidence: 但最不能容忍的就是环境太冷了
decisions.text: 冲着四位小公举五折的活动去的，活动到12月15日。除了刺身一桌只有一份，其他的都随便点，最喜欢牛五花、雪花牛、盐焗大虾、烤鱿鱼，唉其实都喜欢啦。饮料有免费的橙汁、芒果汁、柠檬C、可乐等等，没什么特殊的。但最不能容忍的就是环境太冷了，坐在近门口的位置，感觉和在户外烧烤差不多了，穿着外套也不暖和，而且还限制用餐时间为100分钟，虽然时间够用，但总得记着时间吃饭，不那么放松，不过冲这价钱就忍了吧，如果长时间这活动，考虑会经常去的

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The self-check added this label to a sentence about the room being too cold, which is a temperature complaint, not decoration, and the gold omits all ambience labels here.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt step that the self-check may not add labels, and add a rule that a specific complaint such as temperature or location does not trigger the generic 环境 four-label rule.

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review says only that the environment is too cold, a specific comment on temperature, and the agent added Decoration without reading the rule's general-environment boundary, which applies only to vague praise or criticism of 'environment' with no specific aspect; the self-check added it.
pass2.fix: Add a self-check guard: only add the four general-environment labels when the review judges the environment without naming a specific aspect, and never add them from a self-check on a specific complaint such as temperature.

pass1.label: Price#Level

pass1.fix: Add a prompt step that any price-related phrase triggers reading the Price#Level rule before rejecting it, and add a case where '冲这价钱就忍了' implies an acceptable price level.

pass2.label: Price#Level

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.evidence: 冲着浙大食堂的便宜
decisions.text:
冲着浙大食堂的便宜和有名的浙大烤鸭来的。。后来发现原来三楼的餐厅跟外面价格是一样的。因为是招待餐厅。我们去的时候就有一些学生来聚餐。。大部分也都是附近的居民来吃或者学生带学生家长来
点了有名的浙大烤鸭。听说是北京青睐的师傅，味道还是很不错的。量也挺多的。还有一份鸭骨头会问我们是椒盐还是做汤。其实鸭骨头上面还是会有很多肉的。喜欢吃肉的人的福音啊
还点了在学校里面一般都会点的酸辣土豆丝和干锅包菜。。这两个的味道一般般。。没有很好吃啦
酸菜鱼，油有点多。上酸菜鱼的时候已经被烤鸭吃撑了。也吃不吃到底好不好吃了。。。

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The review does say 冲着浙大食堂的便宜 but that is the reason for visiting, and later the reviewer says the third-floor restaurant has the same prices as outside, so the price judgment is undercut; the self-check added it without weighing that the rule's price-level judgment is not really delivered here, and the model misread the sentence.
pass1.fix: Add a prompt note that a price word stated only as a motive or expectation, and then contradicted by the reviewer's own later statement, should be checked against the full review before labelling; add a few cases of 'chose it for being cheap' that were gold-unlabelled.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The review says the canteen is 便宜 (cheap), which matches the rule's 便宜 trigger, but the reviewer then immediately says the 3rd-floor restaurant prices are the same as outside, so the cheapness is explicitly refuted and the gold label omits Price#Level; the item is debatable, and the same-error arms show the gold and the rule point the same way.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; optionally add a rule note that a 便宜 mention framed as a expectation later contradicted by the reviewer's own price comparison is not a price-level judgement, plus a few cases of this kind.

decisions.label: Ambience#Sanitary
decisions.rejected_reason: “羊蹄收拾的很干净”说的是食材处理干净，规则明确说食材干净不标卫生，且没有评价店内卫生
decisions.text: 凯撒公交车站旁边的银记烩面，烩面不分大小碗，十块钱一碗。一碗面的量好大，都吃不完，面很劲道，里面还有粉条，海带，豆腐皮丝，料很足，味道也好，汤很浓，很美味。还送了小菜和粥。卤菜也很诱人，味道很香，卤豆腐，卤豆腐皮好多人都在点，可惜我只有一个人，点了也妥妥的吃不完啊。没办法，只要了个羊蹄解解馋。真是好久都没有吃过羊蹄了，这家的羊蹄煮的很烂，很入味，羊蹄收拾的也很干净，总之是好吃啊。现在在做活动，吃面送一罐黄金草凉茶。

pass1.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass1.why: The review says the mutton hooves were cleaned well, which is food preparation and the rule says food cleanliness alone does not earn Sanitary, so the agent's rejection follows the rule; the gold label looks inconsistent with that convention, though the 0.913 precision cue shows 干净 usually triggers the label.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or add a boundary case stating that 食材收拾干净 by itself does not trigger Ambience#Sanitary, so gold and rule agree.

pass2.label: Ambience#Sanitary
pass2.why: The review says the lamb hooves were cleaned well (食材收拾干净), which the rule explicitly excludes from Sanitary; the gold label treats the phrase 也很干净 as a sanitary judgment, conflicting with the rulebook's own convention and with the agent's correct reading.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or if the gold is kept, add a boundary case saying that 收拾干净 on a dish that is praised for taste still counts as Sanitary, so the rule and the gold agree.

decisions.label: Price#Level
decisions.rejected_reason: 只写了十块钱一碗的标价，没有贵或便宜的高低评价

pass1.label: Price#Level
pass1.why: The rule says a bare menu price with no high or low judgment usually gets no label, but the review says 十块钱一碗 next to 量好大 and 实惠-like value framing, so the rule's exception for implied value is unclear and all arms missed it.
pass1.fix: Add a rule edit: when a stated price is paired with a value judgment such as 量大、划算 or 十块钱一碗的好吃, label Price#Level, and add two or three cases of that wording to the case library.

pass2.label: Price#Level
pass2.why: The only price mention is the menu price 十块钱一碗 with no high or low evaluation, which the rule says is usually not labelled, yet the gold labels Price#Level; all six arms made the same call, pointing to the gold rather than the model.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; alternatively add a case where a stated per-bowl price alongside a value judgment (for example 量大实惠) is labelled, to show when a bare price counts.

decisions.label: Food#Recommend
decisions.rejected_reason: The reviewer recommends the shop to future visitors (以後來雙廊的朋友可以去這裏啊), not a specific dish. The rule covers dish recommendation, and the dish-related wording is only praise for taste, so no dish recommendation is stated.
decisions.text: 一對退休的江西老夫婦在雙廊開的小店，沒有名字，路過雙廊，沒在古鎮里找吃，反而不起眼的這家店讓我們停下，兩美女剛吃完，介紹了肉末茄子好次，還有紅燒魚也不錯，於是我倆也照來這兩菜。果然，魚燒的很嫩，很鮮美，肉末茄子很香，老公不吃辣，就一點辣味沒有，我就點了那個辣醬次，很香，真的隨你口味煮給你吃，現在哪兒去找這樣的飯館呢？贊阿姨涼菜（老闆娘）說兩人兩菜剛好，不浪費，結果我們次得很飽，也沒浪費，清盤了。以後來雙廊的朋友可以去這裏啊，贊的哦

pass1.label: Food#Recommend
pass1.why: The gold label assigns Food#Recommend to a closing endorsement of the shop, but the rule only applies to explicit recommendation of dishes and says praise without a recommendation statement does not count, so the agent's reading is defensible, and the closing line is a recommendation of the place rather than a dish.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous; alternatively add a rule clarifying whether an explicit recommendation of the restaurant (以後可以去這裏) counts toward Food#Recommend or only dish-level recommendation does.

pass2.label: Food#Recommend
pass2.why: The reviewer explicitly recommends the restaurant to future visitors (以後來雙廊的朋友可以去這裏啊, 贊的哦), which is a clear endorsement, yet the rule's Food#Recommend scope is about dishes, so the agent reasonably rejected it; the gold applies the label to the restaurant-level endorsement, which the rulebook does not clearly cover.
pass2.fix: Add a rule clarification: an explicit endorsement of the restaurant itself (e.g. 推荐大家来、可以去、赞) counts toward Food#Recommend when the review is about the food, and add a few such cases to the library.

decisions.label: Ambience#Decoration
decisions.evidence: 总体服务和用餐环境还是很满意的
decisions.text: 午市代金卷下午5点前能用 我上次大牌团购活动抢了3张100=45的卷 点了养生菌菇锅底 肥牛 aaa羔羊肉 秘制牛羊肉 串串虾 牛骨髓 柳叶苗豌豆苗 有机花菜 秘制蹄花 海带串 秘制龙鱼还有两杯燕麦意仁热饮  首先锅底 饮料还有调料不能用团购卷 锅底45块调料8块一个人饮料18块就另外付现金了 还有那些菜算下来差不多实际价格300多  这样的话卷加付的现金差不多就是吃掉200块 如果没卷的话可想这价格确实贵了  再来说说菜 印象最坏的属牛骨髓和蹄花了 我以为牛骨髓肯定是骨头里的咯连骨头一起拿来的 谁知道牛骨髓的样子像牛肚肠一条一条那种雪白的  直到最后我们东西全烫完吃完都没有吃它 然后我烫熟带回去给我家狗吃 它吃了以后严重拉稀 肚子叽里咕噜的 几天都不肯吃东西了 可想人吃了会有什么后果 再说说那蹄花 以为是蹄筋咯 没想到是猪蹄 而且是那种腌制过的很不新鲜的那种 这两个菜是最不满意的 还有那些还是不错的 特别是柳叶苗和豌豆苗是他们自己种的拿上来的时候他们服务员还要开剪 蛮环保的 串串虾是蛮大蛮新鲜的基尾虾吃的很过瘾 牛羊肉味道也很正宗 龙利鱼做的太咸了点 总体服务和用餐环境还是很满意的 如果今后刚才提到那两个菜能改进下就好了 总之这次用餐还是很愉快的

pass1.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass1.why: The sentence is a general praise of 服务和用餐环境 with no specific aspect, and the rulebook says general 环境 evaluations carry all four environment labels, so the agent applied the rule while the gold omits it.
pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or correct the gold to include the four general-environment labels for this kind of sentence

pass2.label: Ambience#Decoration
pass2.why: The review says '总体服务和用餐环境还是很满意的', a general environment praise that the dataset convention labels with all four environment tags, so the agent's choice matches the convention and the gold appears to omit it, though the agent applied the rule it had not read.
pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; add a note that general '用餐环境' praise follows the four-tag environment convention, and add a few cases where a general environment remark is labelled with all four tags.

pass1.fix: none: document as ambiguous, or correct the gold to match the general-environment convention

pass2.label: Ambience#Noise

pass2.fix: none: document as ambiguous; clarify in the Ambience rules whether general environment praise without specifics tags all four environment labels in this gold set.
